Om arbeidsgiveren:

JAG Assistanse AS (JAG) er en ideell leverandør av brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) og styrer etter non-profitt prinsippet. JAG har bred kompetanse på organisering av BPA-tjenester, spesielt for personer med sammensatte funksjonsnedsettelser, hvorav en kan være av kognitiv art. Vi arbeider for at alle uavhengig av funksjonsnedsettelse skal kunne leve sine liv fullt ut på egne vilkår, og skreddersyr hver enkelt BPA-ordning.

JAG er landsdekkende og arbeidsgiver for over 1000 ansatte, og det legges stor vekt på kvalitetssikring, opplæring og videreutvikling. Verdigrunnlaget i JAG bygger på Independent Living og grunnleggende menneskerettigheter, som også gjenspeiles i JAGs kulturkode.

jobs.title: 100 % fast stilling som sykepleier ved Borgund heimeteneste  ledig
jobs.description:
Vi søker ny kollega!

100 % fast stilling for sykepleier ledig - stillingen er knyttet til Borgund heimeteneste med turnusarbeid. Vi har årsturnus ved avdelingen og ordinære dag-/aftenvakter på hverdagerdag og langvakter 12,5 timer på helg. På grunn av langvakter arbeides det hver 4. helg.  Avdelingen har årsturnus og ved tilsetting vil innspill fra nytilsatt tas med i utarbeidelse.Vi søker engasjert, nytenkende og dyktige sykepleier. Vi har vår base i Vågavegen 27, rett ved NTNU og har ansvar for hjemmetjenester til beboere i området fra Sørneset/Fredsberg i vest til Hatlane/Lerstad i øst. Vi arbeider aktivt med kvalitetsutvikling og personsentrert omsorg står i fokus.Du står på til jobben er gjort, tek ansvar, har gode relasjonelle ferdigheter og samarbeidsevner.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Sikre at pasientar får nødvendig helsehjelp og tenester av god kvalitet i tråd med gjeldande lover, avtalar og retningslinjer
  • Observasjon, kartlegging, iverksetting av tiltak og dokumentasjon i pasientjournal (Helseplattformen)
  • Legemiddelhåndtering, medisinsk behandling og oppfølging
  • Rettleiing av pasientar, pårørande, kollegaer og studentar
  • Bidra til kvardagsmeistring og auka livskvalitet hos pasientar
  • Fremje godt tverrfagleg samarbeid med koordinerings- og tildelingskontor, lege, fysio- og ergoterapeut og anna helsepersonell
  • Samarbeide tett med pårørande og interne/eksterne aktøra
  • Bidra til utvikling, engasjement og fagleg oppdatering på arbeidsplassen
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisasjon som sykepleier
  • Autorisert vernepleier kan tilsettes dersom det ikke er kvalifiserte sykepleiere som søker
  • Relevant erfaring er en fordel
  • God muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne. Krav om norsk språkferdighet tilsvarende B2 muntlig og skriftlig (Europarådet sin nivåskala - CEFR)
  • Beherske IKT-verktøy
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Ved tilsetting kreves politiattest, MRSA- og TBC-egenerklæringer
  • Aktuelle kandidater må ha norsk personnummer eller gyldig D-nummer og formidle dette til arbeidsgiver i god tid før oppstart i jobben.
  • Det forutsettes at den som skal ansettes kan bekrefte sikker identitet i form av gyldig pass (internasjonalt) eller nasjonalt ID-kort (EU/EØS).
  • Det kreves også at personlig BankID eller IDporten kan benyttes som alternativ innlogging mot ulike digitale løsninger ved behov (Helseplattformen, OTTO-app mm)
    Personlige egenskaper
    • Trygg, tydelig og engasjert, med fokus på pasienten
    • Løsningsorientert, fleksibel og glad i nye utfordringer
    • Selvstendig og samarbeidsorientert
    • Bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø
    • Nytenkende og endringsvillig
    • Personlige egenskaper blir vektlagt
    Vi tilbyr
    • En interessant arbeidshverdag med varierte og utfordrende oppgaver i et godt arbeidsmiljø
    • Et støttende og engasjert kollegialt miljø
    • Lønn og arbeidsvilkår etter gjeldende tariff
    • Pensjonsordning i henhold til tariff
    • Bedriftshelsetjeneste
    • IA bedrift
    • Parkering nær arbeidsplassen og kort vei til offentlig transport.
    KontaktinformasjonTonje Brande, Avdelingsleiar, 977 47 679 Ann Elin Melbø Myklebust, Verksemdsleiar, +47 90141650 ArbeidsstadVågavegen 27 6008 Ålesund Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgivar: Ålesund kommune Referansenr.: 5190799029 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 30.11.2026

    Om arbeidsgiveren:

    Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen i Møre og Romsdal og den største byen mellom Bergen og Trondheim med ca. 60 000 innbyggere 

    Det lokale næringslivet er både lokalt, nasjonalt og ikkje minst internasjonalt orientert. Ålesund er «bygd» på fiske og fangst. Framleis er Ålesundregionen er verdsleiande på det marine og maritime området. Fleire av landets største fiskebedrifter og oppdrettsselskap held til i kommunen vår. Ålesund har Noregs største cruisehamn, største fiskerihamn og nest største containerhamn. Vi er og Noregs største eksporthamn på fiskeriprodukter.  Kommunen er det største kollektivknutepunktet i fylket, og tal frå 2016 viser at det årleg er rundt to millionar passasjerer som går av eller på ein buss eller båt i Ålesund.   Ålesund by er viden kjend for sin vakre jugendstil. Tårn, spir og vakre utsmykkingar møter deg som går gatelangs der. Byen ligg som ein døropnar til fjordsystemet på Sunnmøre og strekk seg heilt nord til Ona utanfor Romsdalskysten. Andre attraksjonar i kommunen er Ona fyr og fantastiske fjell, fjordar og natur rett utanfor stovedøra.  Vi er ein universitetskommune og har eit nært samarbeid med NTNU på Campus Ålesund. På Campus Ålesund finn du òg Ålesund framtidslab - U4SSC ip.  

    Kommunen er ein stor arbeidsgjevar med sine over 4.400 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidarar som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglege arbeidet vektlegg vi verdiane våre: open, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet». Ønsker du ein meiningsfylt jobb med varierte og utfordrande oppgåver, er Ålesund kommune eit spennande alternativ.

    Om arbeidsgiveren:

    Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen i Møre og Romsdal og den største byen mellom Bergen og Trondheim med ca. 60 000 innbyggere 

    Det lokale næringslivet er både lokalt, nasjonalt og ikkje minst internasjonalt orientert. Ålesund er «bygd» på fiske og fangst. Framleis er Ålesundregionen er verdsleiande på det marine og maritime området. Fleire av landets største fiskebedrifter og oppdrettsselskap held til i kommunen vår. Ålesund har Noregs største cruisehamn, største fiskerihamn og nest største containerhamn. Vi er og Noregs største eksporthamn på fiskeriprodukter.  Kommunen er det største kollektivknutepunktet i fylket, og tal frå 2016 viser at det årleg er rundt to millionar passasjerer som går av eller på ein buss eller båt i Ålesund.   Ålesund by er viden kjend for sin vakre jugendstil. Tårn, spir og vakre utsmykkingar møter deg som går gatelangs der. Byen ligg som ein døropnar til fjordsystemet på Sunnmøre og strekk seg heilt nord til Ona utanfor Romsdalskysten. Andre attraksjonar i kommunen er Ona fyr og fantastiske fjell, fjordar og natur rett utanfor stovedøra.  Vi er ein universitetskommune og har eit nært samarbeid med NTNU på Campus Ålesund. På Campus Ålesund finn du òg Ålesund framtidslab - U4SSC ip.  

    Kommunen er ein stor arbeidsgjevar med sine over 4.400 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidarar som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglege arbeidet vektlegg vi verdiane våre: open, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet». Ønsker du ein meiningsfylt jobb med varierte og utfordrande oppgåver, er Ålesund kommune eit spennande alternativ.

jobs.title: Online Marketing und E Commerce Manager
jobs.description:
Über Vlitex

Die VLITEX GmbH mit Sitz in Bayreuth entwickelt und vertreibt innovative Brandschutzlösungen aus technischen Textilien mit Fokus auf Lithium-Ionen-Batterien. Zertifizierte "Feuerlöschdecken" und Sicherheitsprodukte des Unternehmens schützen weltweit Leben und minimieren Umweltschäden in Bereichen wie Feuerwehr, Industrie und E-Mobilität.

Deine Aufgaben im Online-Marketing und E-Commerce

· Onlineshop aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Anforderungen definieren, externe Umsetzung koordinieren, Produktdaten pflegen, Kaufprozesse testen und technische Fehler konsequent nachhalten.

· SEO und GEO entwickeln: Suchintentionen recherchieren, Produkt- und Anwendungsseiten optimieren und hilfreiche Experteninhalte erstellen. Inhalte, strukturierte Daten und Unternehmensinformationen so weiterentwickeln, dass VLITEX auch in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT und vergleichbaren KI-Antwortsystemen als relevante Quelle sichtbar wird.

· Google Ads und Paid Social steuern: Kampagnen, Zielgruppen, Anzeigenvarianten und passende Zielseiten entwickeln. Suchanfragen, Kosten und Ergebnisse auswerten und Budgets auf profitable Bestellungen und qualifizierte B2B-Anfragen ausrichten.

· Amazon und Amazon Ads steuern: Produktseiten, Bilder und Texte verbessern, Sortiment und Preise intern abstimmen, Angebotsprobleme lösen und die Verfügbarkeit koordinieren. Kampagnen aufsetzen und optimieren, Suchbegriffe auswerten und Budgets auf wirtschaftliche Verkäufe ausrichten.

· Content und Social Media organisieren: Themenplan führen, Texte und einfache Bild- oder Videoinhalte erstellen, Produktaufnahmen koordinieren und geeignete Inhalte für organische Kanäle veröffentlichen.

· Messung und Reporting sicherstellen: Käufe und Anfragen nachvollziehbar erfassen, Kennzahlen wie Umsatz, Conversion Rate, Werbekosten und Deckungsbeitrag auswerten und daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.

Das bringst du mit

· Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Online Marketing, E-Commerce oder Performance Marketing, idealerweise für erklärungsbedürftige Produkte im B2B- und B2C-Umfeld.

· Nachweisbare operative Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei der Bereiche Amazon, Google Ads, SEO, Onlineshop oder Paid Social sowie die Bereitschaft, die übrigen Kanäle verantwortlich zu steuern.

· Sicherer Umgang mit Webanalyse und Tracking, beispielsweise Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Search Console und den Auswertungen der Werbeplattformen.

Deine Benefits

  • Du erhältst eine Entschädigung für Reisekosten.

  • Ein Firmenlaptop steht dir zur Verfügung.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice sowie Remote arbeiten unterstützen die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Alltag.

  • Kostenlose Getränke und Snacks stehen am Arbeitsplatz bereit, und das Parken ist für dich kostenlos.

  • Es erwartet dich eine lockere Kleiderordnung sowie regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern.

Vergütung

Das Bruttogehalt für diese Position liegt bei EUR 42,000–53,000 per year.

jobs.description:
Jeg er en kvinne i 50-årene som søker assistent til fast deltidsstilling på 10 timer pr. uke og som kunne tenke seg å stå i jobben over en lengre periode. Jeg er rullestolbruker og i jobb.

Arbeidstiden vil hovedsakelig være ettermiddag/kveld mandag og onsdag kl. 14.00 - 19.00. Noe arbeid i helg og helligdager kan forekomme etter avtale.

Aktuelle arbeidsoppgaver vil være:

Assistere i og utenfor hjemmet. Assistanse til transport, alt av husarbeid, matlaging, gjøre innkjøp, noe lettere hagearbeid, være med på ulike aktiviteter, assistere på reise, eller der jeg til enhver tid befinner meg, assistanse ved forflytning. Arbeidsoppgavene kan bli endret over tid. Assisterer i svømmehall og garderobe.

Grunnet arbeidets art vil kvinnelige søkere bli foretrukket, men alle søknader vil bli vurdert. Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt. Dette er et serviceyrke, og det er ikke nødvendig med helsefaglig bakgrunn.

  • Du må kunne snakke og skrive flytende norsk

  • Du må være over 25 år

  • Du er ikke-røyker

  • Du må kunne jobbe i noen ferier etter avtale

  • Du må være fleksibel, pålitelig, serviceinnstilt

  • Førerkort

Du får ordnede tariff lønns- og arbeidsvilkår med Stendi som din arbeidsgiver. Jeg blir din arbeidsleder.

Politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelseSøknader blir vurdert fortløpende.Arbeidssted: Oslo/Søndre Nordstrand

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stendi Assistanse er et av Norges største leverandører av assistanse- og hjemmetjenester til mennesker med hjelpebehov. Vi leverer tjenester på vegne av det offentlige. Gjennom vårt arbeid ønsker vi å gjøre verden litt bedre, ett menneske av gangen. Sammen med våre oppdragsgivere skaper vi en trygg omsorg som ivaretar alle!

Vi har et landsdekkende tjenestetilbud innen brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) og hjemmebaserte tjenester.

jobs.description:
100% stilling vikariat- med mulighet for forlengelse!

Hjemmesykepleien i Saltdal kommune trenger faglig dyktige og selvstendige sykepleiere.

Vi kan tilby en spennende og variert arbeidshverdag i flotte omgivelser sammen med dyktige kolleger. Hjemmesykepleien etterstreber at pasienter skal få bo lengst mulig i eget hjem. Vi jobber etter hverdagsrehabiliteringsprinsippet med fokus på hverdagsmestring. Vi har eget hverdagsrehabiliteringsteam og kreftsykepleier tilknyttet tjenestenVi utfører avansert helsehjelp i hjemmet og etterstreber å legge til rette for palliasjon og hjemmedød.  Hjemmesykepleien leverer helsetjenester i hjemmet i hele Saltdal,  og er også ansvarlig for driften av to omsorgsboliger.

Stillingene er turnus med arbeid hver 3.helg, med rullering mellom omsorgsboliger og utetjeneste. Møtetid fast i turnus med internundervisning og etisk refleksjon. Vi har en egen trivselsgruppe som jobber for et inkluderende, friskt og aktivt arbeidsmiljø.

 

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Ansvar for den sykepleierfaglige oppfølgingen av pasientene.
  • Oppfølging av vedtak og tiltaksplaner for pasienter.
  • Tett samarbeid med eksterne og interne deltakere i pleie og omsorg rundt pasientene.
  • Bidra til en helsefremmende, aktivt og meningsfull hverdag for pasientene ut fra deres ønsker og behov.
  • Bidra til utvikling og engasjement i avdelingen.
  • Delta aktivt i veiledning og opplæring av personell, brukere og pårørende.
  • Plikter å være oppdatert og forholde deg til gjeldende lover, forskrifter og rutiner.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Bachelor sykepleier. Sykepleierstudenter kan også søke.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Ha stor arbeidskapasitet og ha evne til å jobbe målrettet og selvstendig i en hektisk hverdag.
  • Ha en lærende holdning og innstilling.
  • Ha evnen til å jobbe systematisk og være tålmodig.
  • Være positiv og ha gode samarbeidsevner.
  • Være fleksibel, løsningsorientert og jobbe effektivt.
  • Ha gode kommunikasjonsevner.
  • God evne til å jobbe i team og bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Være engasjert og interessert i å jobbe med mennesker.
  • Ha helsefremmende og forebyggende kunnskaper og ferdigheter.
  • Interesse for habilitering.
  • Ha god fremstillingsevne i muntlig og skriftlig norsk.
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli sterkt vektlagt
Vi tilbyr
  • Mentorordning – egen kontaktperson som følger opp den nyansatte det første halve året
  • Kommunen har gunstig pensjonsordning. I disse stillingen har du rett på en av Norges sikreste pensjonsordninger: offentlig tjenestepensjon. Der de fleste tjenestepensjoner kun utbetales i 10 år, er offentlig tjenestepensjon en utbetaling som varer fra den dagen du slutter å jobbe og livet ut. Pensjonen inkluderer også uføre- og etterlattepensjon hvis noe uventet skulle skje. Med pensjonsrett i KLP får du medlemspris og gunstige betingelser på en rekke bank, forsikring og spareprodukter. Hvis du ønsker mer informasjon om KLP gå inn her "Offentlig tjenestepensjon  - kort fortalt"

 

Annen informasjon:

Alle søknader sendes inn elektronisk. Vitnemål og attester må lastes opp i Webcruiter.  Det må påregnes intervju. Oppgi minst to referanser, som er nyere enn 2 år. Helst fra både leder og ansatt.

Alle søknader sendes inn elektronisk. Aktuelle søkere vil bli invitert til intervju.Arbeidsplassene i Saltdal kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile Saltdals befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert, til å søke jobb hos oss, uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Saltdal kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.Faste ansatte i Saltdal kommune som har fortrinnsrett som overtallig, er avklart omplasseringskandidat på bakgrunn av helse eller som ønsker å øke stillingsandel, må oppgi dette i søknaden.Søkere som ønsker å bli unntatt fra offentliggjøring må oppgi dette i søknaden. Søkere kan likevel bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har bed om å bli unntatt for offentlighet. Dersom ønsket ikke etterkommes, vil søkeren bli varslet om dette. (Offentleglova §25).For alle stillinger gjelder de regler som går frem av lover, reglement og gjeldende tariffavtale.

jobs.title: Vil du være med og bygge fremtidens HR - mens vi står midt i endringen?
jobs.description:
HR i Mio er i endring. Vi går fra hovedsakelig reaktiv saksbehandling til en partnerbasert HR-operasjonsmodell, der HR kjenner driften, sitter tett på lederne og kommer inn tidlig – før sakene blir store. Modellen er vedtatt, og nå skal den implementeres og leve i hverdagen.

Vi søker deg som har lyst til å være med på den reisen. Du trives i et selskap som stadig er i utvikling, der ting ikke er ferdig satt, og der du får være med og forme hvordan vi jobber. Har du jobbet som HR business partner og er klar for et neste steg, kan dette være rollen for deg.

Rollen gir stor grad av autonomi. Du inngår i ledergruppen i HR sammen med HMS-rådgiver, som har fagansvaret for HMS, og teamleder for rekruttering. Dere samarbeider tett om å optimalisere HR og setter retning for hvordan vi utvikler fagområdet – med en leder som gir deg tillit og handlingsrom.

Om stillingen

Som teamleder for HR drift og utvikling leder du et team av HR business partnere og HR-koordinatorer. Du kombinerer personalledelse med fagansvar for arbeidsrett og utvikling av HR-tjenestene, og blir en sentral person i å ta den nye HR-modellen ut i organisasjonen. Du rapporterer til direktør HR og HMS.

Dette blir du med på

  • Lede og utvikle teamet: personalansvar, tydelige roller, god arbeidsdeling og en kultur preget av tillit, faglig sparring og felles ansvar.

  • Fagansvar for arbeidsrett: være teamets og ledernes sparringspartner i krevende personalsaker, omstillinger, konflikter, oppfølging av sykefravær og avslutning av arbeidsforhold.

  • HR som partner for driften: sørge for at HR er til stede på ledernes arenaer, ser risiko tidlig og bidrar til at ledere blir trygge i arbeidsgiverrollen.

  • Leder- og organisasjonsutvikling: utvikle og gjennomføre opplæring for ledere og bidra i endrings- og utviklingsprosesser.

  • Kjerneprosesser og forbedring: forenkle og standardisere HR-prosesser og rutiner, og bidra til innføringen av Workday.

  • Samarbeid: jobbe tett med HMS, rekruttering, lønn, drift, tillitsvalgte og verneombud om et godt arbeidsmiljø og høyere nærvær.

Vi ser etter deg som

  • har mastergrad eller tilsvarende høyere utdanning innen HR, rettsvitenskap, organisasjon, ledelse eller lignende

  • har jobbet som HR business partner og kjenner partnerrollen fra innsiden

  • har god arbeidsrettslig kompetanse og erfaring med komplekse arbeidsrettslige saker

  • har erfaring med utvikling av ledere og organisasjon

  • kjenner HR-kjerneprosessene godt og har erfaring med å ta dem ut i organisasjonen

Har du ledererfaring, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav. For en erfaren HR business partner kan dette være et naturlig neste steg. Kjennskap til BPA, omsorg eller andre personalintensive virksomheter er også et pluss.

Som person er du

  • trygg og tydelig, og god til å bygge relasjoner med ledere og medarbeidere

  • strukturert og løsningsorientert, med god vurderingsevne og evne til å forklare kompliserte problemstillinger enkelt

  • motivert av endring og av å gjøre både ledere og medarbeidere gode

Vi tilbyr

  • en sentral rolle i en HR-funksjon som er i endring, med reell mulighet til å påvirke

  • stor grad av autonomi, plass i ledergruppen i HR og en leder som gir deg tillit

  • et engasjert HR-miljø og en virksomhet med samfunnsviktig oppdrag

  • mulighet til å utvikle deg som leder

Søknad og kontakt

Søknadsfrist: 20.11.2026. Vi går gjennom søknader fortløpende, så send gjerne inn tidlig.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, ta kontakt med Ann Magritt Hagerud, Konserndirektør HR og HMS, på telefon 413 49 226 eller e-post ann.hagerud@mio.no, eller kontakt Tilde Bjørum Sandvand, Teamleder rekruttering, på telefon 468 21 222/epost tilde.sandvand@mio.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio gruppen er 100 prosent norskeid og består av selskapene Mio BPA, Mio Omsorg og Mio bolig. Sammen er vi en av Norges største leverandør av hjemmesykepleie, hjemmehjelp og brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA). Vi tilbyr et bredt spekter av tjenester til unge seniorer, eldre og personer med funksjonsnedsettelser. Vi har også et hyggelig seniorpensjonat i Moss.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: DevOps-ingenjör till Arbetsförmedlingen
jobs.description: Är du en erfaren DevOps-ingenjör som vill utvecklas i en miljö där teknik möter samhällsnytta? Vi söker dig som vill bidra till vår satsning att effektivisera myndighetens IT- infrastruktur genom att öka graden av automatisering. Här får du möjligheten att kombinera avancerad teknik med utvecklande samarbete.Tillsammans får vi Sverige i arbete. Vill du bli en av oss?Sektionens uppdragSektionen Applikationsinfrastruktur sköter plattformsmässigt utvecklings- och driftsmiljöer baserade på Linux och Windows, främst i våra egna datahallar. Vi har också huvudansvaret för att utveckla automatiseringen av myndighetens IT- infrastruktur.Vi bygger nu en gemensam automationsbackend där vi valt open source-lösningen Crossplane för provisionering av infrastruktur. Målet är att göra det enklare och snabbare att beställa, etablera och förvalta infrastrukturtjänster genom standardiserade och återanvändbara automationsflöden. Via självservice ska utvecklingsteam få tillgång till de resurser de behöver.Som DevOps-ingenjör får du vara med och utforma, utveckla och driftsätta denna lösning. Arbetetet omfattar bl a att integrera Crossplane med våra befintliga plattformar och API:er samt bygga deklarativa lösningar för provisionering. Du samarbetar nära plattformsteam och specialister för att omsätta manuella arbetsmoment till automatiserade flöden.Vi tar oss an komplexa problem tillsammans, gillar att lära av varandras kompetenser och sätter värde på att ha humorn med oss varje dag. Då och då gör vi aktiviteter utanför jobbet t ex går på konferenser.Vem söker vi?Det viktigaste för oss är att du har en vilja att lära dig nya tekniker och tycker om att lösa problem både själv och tillsammans med andra. Vi ser framför oss att du, liksom vi, inspireras av ständigt nya utmaningar och har en hög motivation. Du är initiativtagande, självgående och lösningsorienterad samt naturligt nyfiken på området som gör att du är van att följa trender inom Open source, DevOps och GitOps. Du har god samarbetsförmåga och är bra på att kommunicera. För att lyckas i denna roll tror vi att du är lika mycket tekniker som människomänniska.Vårt erbjudandeTjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Placeringsorten är Solna.Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att arbeta på en arbetsplats där vi värdesätter balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Du får tillgång till ett generöst semesteravtal, flexibla arbetstider samt möjlighet att arbeta på distans upp till 49 procent på årsbasis. Hos oss ingår även friskvård under arbetstid och ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag.Vi erbjuder kompetensutveckling i den senaste tekniken inom området och karriärmöjligheter finns inom myndigheten. Genom vårt arbete bidrar vi till ett inkluderande och hållbart samhälle, där du får möjlighet att göra en verklig skillnad för individer och för samhället i stortMer om att jobba hos oss Grundläggande krav för tjänsten    Högskoleutbildning som dataingenjör, systemvetare eller arbetslivserfarenhet som motsvarar utbildning    Minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att ha jobbat med Red Hat Linux i en större organisation    Arbetslivserfarenhet av DevOps, IT-Infrastruktur och automatisering    Flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet av automatsering och scriptning t.ex. Python, Terraform, Ansible, Bash    Arbetslivserfarenhet av automatisering, gärna inom IT-infrastruktur    Talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska (non-Swedish speakers will not be considered)Övriga meriter för tjänsten    Erfarenhet av GitOps / infrastructure as code    Erfarenhet av Crossplane, inklusive compositions, providers och integratioer    Erfarenhet av Kubernetes eller OpenShift     Erfarenhet av drift enligt ITIL    Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt och metoder    Erfarenhet av DevOps i en större organisation    Relevanta certifieringarDen statliga värdegrunden guidar oss i vårt dagliga arbete. Som anställd hos oss förväntas du arbeta rättvist, opartiskt och med hög integritet, samt bidra till att upprätthålla och stärka förtroendet för vår myndighet.  Utöver detta har du personlig förmåga och fallenhet att arbeta i enlighet med Arbetsförmedlingens medarbetarkriterier.Läs mer om den statliga värdegrunden och våra medarbetarkriterier på vår hemsida.Som medarbetare på Arbetsförmedlingen förväntas du vara:Ansvarstagande – ta ansvar för ditt arbete, samarbeta och bidra till en god arbetsmiljö.Handlingskraftig – ta initiativ, bidra till förbättringar och hantera förändringar.Resultatfokuserad – planera, följa upp och bidra till verksamhetsnytta och resultat.AnsökanLåter det här som en tjänst för dig? Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026 - 11 - 17.Bifoga ditt CV där du specificerar årtal, månad och arbetsuppgifter för varje anställning, samt intyg som styrker kraven om utbildning och/eller arbetslivserfarenhet i din ansökan. Det är viktigt att du besvarar urvalsfrågorna detaljerat och sanningsenligt, för att vi ska få en tydlig bild av din erfarenhet. Om efterfrågad information inte framgår riskerar du bli bortsållad i urvalet. Du behöver inte skicka in ett personligt brev.Under rekryteringsprocessen kan urvalstester förekomma. Vi kommer att hålla dig informerad genom hela rekryteringsprocessen. Mer om vår rekryteringsprocess. Har du skyddade personuppgifter kontaktar du den rekryteringspartner som finns namngiven i annonsen så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.Vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en myndighet fri från diskriminering. Det är viktigt för oss att all kompetens tas tillvara och vi välkomnar alla sökande. Vi ser positivt på om du har kunskaper i något av våra nationella minoritetsspråk.Mer om vår organisation och vårt uppdrag

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager - Blocket Mobility
jobs.description: THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELLYou? A results-driven sales leader who knows the automotive industry, from working in it or with it. You understand how value is created for car dealers, importers and OEMs, and you thrive leading in change.Role? You will lead our Swedish Advisory team within Mobility: the Key Account Managers who advise Sweden's largest car dealer groups, importers and OEMs on how to get the most value from Blocket (Vend). You will own the team's results, implement sales strategies and drive a group of experienced Key Account Managers to deliver great commercial outcomes, while leveraging our position as trusted advisors. You will also be part of the Nordic Advisory leadership group, shaping how we develop across Norway, Denmark and Sweden.Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need.Location? Join us in our central and modern Stockholm office (hybrid, with remote work flexibility).Why us? Blocket is the leading marketplace for cars in Sweden, and our Advisory team works with the biggest and most strategic players in the industry. This is your chance to lead a team with real market impact, a strong customer base, and a clear Nordic strategy to execute on.WHO ARE YOU?    A proven results driver: You have documented experience leading commercial teams, and are used to coaching and motivating teams to develop. You are forward-leaning, able to set clear priorities and lead by example.    Industry experience and full value chain understanding: You have experience from the automotive industry or adjacent markets. You understand the full value chain and how the dots connect between OEMs, importers, dealers and consumers. You know how value is created within the industry and how decisions are made.    Digital products or services: You have experience with digital products and/or advertising (Display, Programmatic, Content) from Sales, Strategy, Product or Business Development.    Comfortable with change: You have led teams through change and know how to bring people along. Working with AI and evolving technology is a natural part of how you work - we expect you can be a key part of driving adoption in the team.    Data-driven commercial mindset: You actively use data as part of your leadership and are able to take meaningful actions - always with a human touch. You are able to use trends and insights to create real customer value and compelling narratives.    A trusted senior partner: You build long-term relationships with senior decision-makers and are used to handling complex negotiations. You lead by example, and supporting your team in key customer dialogues comes naturally for you.    A Nordic team player: You collaborate easily across departments and borders, and see real value in learning from and sharing with the Advisory teams in Denmark and Norway.    Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken.WHAT'S THE JOB LIKE?The Mobility VerticalAt Vend’s Mobility vertical, we are more than 200 motivated experts across the Nordics, on a mission to empower people to make smart mobility choices. Our family of brands includes FINN, Blocket, Bytbil and DBA/Bilbasen, as well as C2B auction platforms Nettbil and AutoVex.The Sales organisation consists of over 60 dedicated professionals across Oslo, Copenhagen/Århus and Stockholm - split into four departments: Advisory, Outbound, New Car and B2B Marketing. This role will be situated in the Advisory Sales team at Blocket.se and reports directly to the Nordic Advisory Director for the Mobility vertical.In Advisory Sales, long-term relationships and value-driven sales dialogues are the foundation of everything we do. Through unique data and insights, our goal is to help dealers and OEMs improve their ROI and grow their market share. In our department, we value close collaboration, enjoy working together both digitally and in person, and make sure to create regular opportunities to meet and learn from each other.The roleThe automotive industry is undergoing substantial change driven by digitization of car sales and electrification of the car fleet. As a response to this change, we are introducing deep vertical products across the Nordics, helping customers make smarter choices and optimize their business. As a key part of taking these offerings to the Swedish market, while strengthening our position as trusted advisors, we are now looking for a Sales Manager to lead the Swedish Advisory Sales team.As Advisory Senior Sales Manager, you will lead your own team of Key Account Managers and specialists. Your key responsibilities will be:    Results and commercial ownership: Own the Swedish Advisory team's revenue. Set clear priorities and coach the team in delivering on classifieds and advertising targets.    Sales management: Develop and execute strategic sales tactics focused on both client value and revenue growth. Stay on top of KPIs and contribute to monthly financial reviews and forecasts.    Team leadership: Lead, motivate, and develop a team of senior profiles. Contribute to a forward-leaning, positive and collaborative team culture.    Leading the transformation: Turn our Nordic Advisory strategy into action in Sweden, and lead the team through change as the industry, our offering and the way we sell evolve. Adopt AI-driven solutions and ways of working as a key responsibility.    Strategic customer partnerships: Be the senior face of Blocket (Vend) and join key customer meetings, support your team in complex negotiations and help customers see where Vend creates value in their business.

jobs.title: Director of Customer Lifecycle (CRM)
jobs.description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Salary: 120-160k • Total Comp: 200k

We're looking for a highly analytical, data-driven Director of Customer Lifecycle (CRM) who will architect a sophisticated, machine-learning-adjacent customer lifecycle engine designed to maximize long-term retention and engagement across our global user base.

Your mission is to bring structure, rigorous experimentation, and algorithmic scalability to a CRM system that is complex by nature — with many entry points, diverse user flows, and a high bar for automation. You will sit at the intersection of marketing, product, and data science, moving comfortably from high-level retention strategy to hands-on pipeline and campaign execution.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Own Lifecycle Architecture & First-Day Experience: Own the full CRM strategy, with a heavy emphasis on mapping day-0 (d0) user behavior to optimize early-stage retention and long-term user monetization.

  • Build Algorithmic Personalization: Move beyond static batch-and-blast and basic segmentation. You will collaborate with Data Science to deploy predictive logic, user-level personalization models, and behavioral triggers across Email, Push, SMS, and In-App.

  • Drive Rigorous Experimentation: Establish a world-class testing culture. You will design, execute, and analyze systematic experiments that look past surface-level metrics to measure true incrementality and downstream KPI impact (e.g., Day-30, Day-90 retention).

  • Partner on Data Schema: Work directly with Data and Engineering to design, audit, and optimize the CRM data schema, ensuring real-time event tracking is clean, correctly mapped, and actionable.

  • Execute & Scale: While you own the strategy, you are also the primary operator in the early stages. You will build, troubleshoot, and optimize complex logic loops and API-triggered campaigns yourself.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Data Fluency & Measurement Rigor: You speak the same language as data scientists. You have a deep understanding of statistical significance, multi-variant testing, and how to isolate incremental lift.

  • Hands-on Platform Mastery: Mastery of omnichannel orchestration platforms (e.g., Braze). You have a proven track record of personally building complex liquid logic, API-triggered webhooks, and multi-step Canvas flows without needing an intermediary team to execute for you.

  • Complex Data Architecture Instincts: You know how to structure customer data so it scales. You can pinpoint exactly when a downstream personalization failure is an execution problem versus an underlying data pipeline or schema issue.

  • High-Volume B2C Experience: Experience managing high-volume engagement at companies with large, active user bases where lifecycle complexity is real and data clean-room hygiene is paramount.

  • Bonus: Experience overhauling a fragmented, "spaghetti-logic" CRM setup into a clean, scalable lifecycle engine, or experience writing basic SQL to query your own engagement data.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Full Stack & Hands-on Ownership: You take complete accountability for the post-install world. If a flow breaks or a tracking event drops off, you are eager to jump into the data logs, diagnose the issue, and fix it yourself.

  • Product-Led Retention Mindset: You look at CRM through a product lens. You understand that great retention starts at onboarding (d0) and that communication instruments are an extension of the product experience.

  • Thrive in Building Phases: You are comfortable working in a high-growth environment where data frameworks are still evolving. You can hold a vision for predictive, automated systems while building tight, pragmatic short-term workflows that don't add technical debt.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €120K – €180K • Total Comp: 220k

jobs.title: Talent Lead
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs has grown to over 1,000 in three years, and the rate of growth is not slowing down. As Talent Lead, you will be in charge of one of the most visible and impactful functions in the company: hundreds of hires a quarter across Research, Engineering, GTM and Operations, in one of the most competitive talent markets in history. You’ll move Talent from a high-volume recruiting engine to a strategic partner that tells leaders what is achievable, and you’ll rebuild how we hire using the same AI products we make.

You'll run the entire Talent team (currently 20 - 30 recruiters, sourcers, and talent operations) across verticals, setting the strategy, building the systems, and staying hands-on where it matters. You'll report directly to the Operations Lead and be a close partner to the People team. This isn't a pure executive role - we want someone who still loves the craft of recruiting and can model what great looks like for the team around them.

The right person has done this before at scale - at a company that grew fast and hired harder. Your team will look to you not just for direction, but as someone they can genuinely learn from. This will be an opportunity to shape the direction of Talent at ElevenLab; where we go, how we get there and who we get there with. If you want to shape the future of the Talent industry by building industry-defining playbooks using the latest technology and AI solutions, whilst building an expert team - this might be your best fit yet.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the full talent function across Research, GTM, Engineering & Product, and G&A hiring - setting strategy, managing team performance, building a recruiter capacity engine, and driving outcomes across all verticals.

  • Shape Talent Operations: ATS (Ashby) configuration, headcount tracking, hiring velocity metrics, and recruiter tooling - ensuring the function runs with precision and minimal friction.

  • Identify innovative ways of approaching Talent: design the next-gen Talent org structure, envision how Talent processes can be agentified and work with the team to build ElevenLabs products throughout.

  • Act as a strategic partner to department heads and hiring managers, bringing market intelligence, pipeline health visibility, and honest counsel on what it takes to consistently win the best people in the market.

  • Build and maintain a strong talent brand through thoughtful candidate experience, community engagement, building a Talent events program and creative sourcing strategies.

  • Coach and develop a team of recruiters, establishing clear standards for quality of hire, speed, and candidate experience.

  • Partner with functional leaders across Research, Engineering, GTM, and Operations - acting as a trusted advisor who can challenge, align, and mobilize leaders around talent priorities and workforce strategy.

We’re moving quickly on this search. Applications close on 13 November 2026, and we’ll start reviewing right away, so we’d encourage you to apply early.

Requirements

  • Proven track record leading large TA functions at high-growth companies, with direct experience filling hundreds of roles per year across multiple functions and geographies.

  • Hands-on recruiting instincts - comfortable being in the weeds on critical searches, not just managing from a distance.

  • Strong people leader who builds, develops, and retains recruiting talent.

  • Sharp on process: able to design and iterate on systems, tooling, and workflows that make a team of 20–30 perform at a high level with AI.

  • Close collaborator with People, Finance, and business leaders - comfortable operating at the intersection of headcount planning, compensation, and hiring strategy.

  • Held a high bar for quality of hire while hitting aggressive volume, with the metrics to show it.

  • Advised founders and executive suite on workforce planning, and changed a plan with your judgment.

  • Worked with Finance, People and RevOps on headcount planning, capacity modelling, compensation and offer strategy.

  • Has recruited across the Americas, EMEA and APAC and understands the differences between markets.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate from New York or London strongly preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Operations Research
jobs.description:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

What you'll do

CircuitHub builds circuit boards on demand, every order different. Each day thousands of decisions are made: which orders run on which machines, which parts to buy and when, what to promise a customer and what to charge. You'll build the models behind those decisions.

  • Plan the factory. Schedule orders, panels and machines across our factories for throughput and on-time delivery, and know days ahead when we will run out of work or capacity.

  • Model the Grid. The Grid is our factory-scale robot: dozens of movers, gantries, printers and ovens. Model how work flows through it, find the bottlenecks, and tell us what the next machine or change is worth.

  • Price and promise. Estimate what an order really costs in labour, machine time and parts, and help set prices and lead times that win work and make money.

  • Buy smarter. Decide what parts and consumables to stock, when to order them, and how much risk of a shortage to accept.

  • Put it into production. Your models don't live in a spreadsheet: they run every day, feed the planning and quoting systems, and get checked against what actually happened.

What we look for

  • A quantitative background in operations research, applied maths, statistics, quantitative finance, economics or a similar field, and a record of models that changed real decisions.

  • Optimisation: linear and integer programming, constraint programming, or heuristics, and judgement about when a simple rule beats a solver.

  • Simulation and forecasting: building a model of a messy system, calibrating it to data and saying how far to trust it.

  • Strong Python and SQL. You write code other people can run and rely on.

  • You use coding agents to move faster and take full ownership of what they produce.

  • Curiosity about how things are physically made. You'll spend time in our factories in the US and UK.

Manufacturing experience is welcome but not required. If you have priced risk, optimised a portfolio or forecast demand, the problems here will feel familiar.

Stack

  • Modelling: Python, OR-Tools, simulation

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Snowflake, dbt, Dagster

  • Agents: Claude Code and Codex throughout

Location

Remote anywhere, or from our offices in London or Cambridge (UK) if you prefer, with regular visits to our factories in the UK and US.

jobs.title: Group Financial Accountant
jobs.description:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

Remote within the UK, or from our offices in London or Cambridge if you prefer.

The opportunity

CircuitHub is trying to solve a difficult problem: why can software engineers iterate almost instantly while hardware engineers can still wait weeks or months to manufacture a new design?

The company was founded by engineers who had experienced that frustration first-hand. What began as software to make ordering electronics easier has evolved into a much more ambitious manufacturing platform, combining software, robotics and automation to redesign the production process itself.

Today CircuitHub operates an automated electronics manufacturing platform serving hardware businesses across areas including robotics, autonomous systems and other advanced technology applications. Its proprietary Grid system is a factory-scale robotic assembly platform designed for rapid, high-mix electronics production.

The business is now scaling quickly. CircuitHub has raised $45 million to expand manufacturing capacity in both the US and Europe, building on operations in Massachusetts and its growing UK presence. Cambridge is becoming an increasingly important hub alongside London and the company's distributed team.

That growth creates a corresponding need to strengthen the operating infrastructure behind the company. Finance is one of the areas where CircuitHub has deliberately remained lean for longer than it probably should have.

Context: where finance is today

The finance team is led by a Finance Director and Management Accountant, both experienced, qualified accountants. This role brings dedicated financial accounting and technical reporting capability into the team, taking ownership of the books, the audit and the technical questions that come with a growing international group.

CircuitHub uses NetSuite to operate its inter-company financial model across the UK and US. A significant amount of day-to-day UK finance activity is outsourced, while the internal team takes greater ownership of the larger US operation, group reporting and consolidation. This role will be the main point of contact for the outsourced firm, reviewing their work and making sure it meets the standard the group needs, while also working across the US side and the wider mechanics of an international business.

Just as importantly, CircuitHub is thinking carefully about what the next generation of finance roles should look like. AI and automation are already being deployed across the company, including in areas where repetitive finance work can be made considerably more efficient.

That makes strong technical accountants even more important. CircuitHub needs people who understand the numbers well enough to judge whether automated output is right, and who can use technology to improve how finance works without weakening control.

That combination of technical accounting, real ownership and a technology-enabled way of working is a central part of the opportunity.

The mandate

The Group Financial Accountant will take ownership of CircuitHub’s financial accounting across the UK and US. That means understanding how the books are put together, running a reliable close and being the person the Finance Director, the auditors and the outsourced accounting firm rely on for accurate, well-supported numbers.

Alongside the core accounts, the role will lead on technical accounting as the business scales. CircuitHub is investing heavily in manufacturing capacity and moving towards more flexible commercial models, which raises questions around revenue recognition, capitalisation and intercompany that need a clear owner.

The candidate must be willing to get their hands dirty to get a full appreciation of the sales cycle & work with the Finance Director to improve our systems and controls to improve our collection cycle, reducing DSO & further automation for our credit offering.

The candidate should have a good technical understanding in accounting that can lead to developing financial operations without complicating or delaying the reporting process. Developing our systems to improve the speed and efficiency of areas such as revenue recognition, R&D capitalisation & the consolidation process.

What you will work on

The precise balance will evolve with the candidate, but the remit is expected to include:

  • Financial accounting and close. Own month-end, including journals, accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations, with a clear understanding of how the accounts fit together.

  • Audit and statutory reporting. Act as the first point of contact for the auditors, manage their requests and prepare supporting schedules under UK GAAP and IFRS.

  • Technical accounting. Lead projects such as IFRS 15 revenue recognition, the capitalisation policy and the treatment of intercompany transactions as the business and its commercial models develop.

  • Group reporting. Support reporting across the UK and US entities, including intercompany reconciliations, and contribute to group consolidation in NetSuite where experience allows.

  • Outsourced provider management. Manage the relationship with the UK outsourced accounting firm, reviewing their output and holding it to the standard the group needs.

  • NetSuite and finance systems. Work directly in NetSuite and across the different systems and platforms that feed into it. Understand how data moves through the business rather than treating the accounting system in isolation.

  • AI and automation. Review and take ownership of automated and AI-generated finance output, making sure it is accurate and properly controlled, and help identify where further automation makes sense.

What success looks like

The first objective is to be a safe pair of hands. That means solving outstanding technical issues, taking ownership of monthly & quarterly close, a well-run audit and numbers the Finance Director and the team can trust without needing to revisit them.

From there, success means taking ownership of the technical agenda: a clear approach to revenue recognition as commercial models change, a robust capitalisation policy as CircuitHub invests in capacity, and clean intercompany accounting across the UK and US.

Over time, the finance team should have the capacity to report more frequently, stronger oversight of outsourced work and less technical accounting sitting with the Finance Director simply because nobody else can own it.

Processes should improve as well as move faster. Automation should remove low-value work without weakening financial control.

This is a role to build into over time. The scope will grow with the finance function and with the contribution the individual makes to it. As the business scales, the role is expected to grow into Group Financial Controller.

The person we are looking for

CircuitHub is looking for a qualified or near-qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) with strong technical foundations. The specific qualification matters less than acumen, drive and personal qualities.

You are likely to have trained in practice, whether at a Big 4 or a top 20 firm, and be looking for your first move into an operating business. Alternatively, you may already be working in industry, in which case you will be qualified or close to qualifying.

The strongest signals are:

  • Relevant exposure. Experience getting the most out of NetSuite, working in a finance team to produce accounting information & ability to work autonomously and conscientiously to meet deadlines.

  • Technical grounding. Strong knowledge of UK GAAP and IFRS and a clear understanding of how a set of accounts is put together.

  • Technology fluency. You are comfortable working across systems and genuinely interested in how AI is changing finance. You see automation as a tool, not a substitute for judgement.

  • Practical curiosity. When something does not reconcile or a process feels unnecessarily difficult, your instinct is to understand why.

  • Commitment to building. You are motivated by breadth and ownership, and you want to build something over time in a growing business.

  • Interest in the business. CircuitHub sits at the intersection of software, robotics and physical manufacturing. You do not need an electronics background, but an interest in technology and how real products are built will make the environment much more compelling.

Why CircuitHub

This is a chance to join a profitable, fast-growing robotics and manufacturing business at a pivotal stage of scale, in a role with genuine technical ownership.

You will work closely with experienced qualified accountants and gain a breadth of exposure that is rare this early in an industry career: revenue recognition, capitalisation, intercompany, audit and reporting across a UK and US group.

You will also build for where finance is going next. CircuitHub is already using AI, automation and connected systems across the business, creating the opportunity to combine strong technical accounting with skills in systems, data and automation.

For someone with the capability and drive, there is real scope to grow as CircuitHub scales and the finance function builds out around it.

Pay

£75k–£85k, depending on experience, plus equity.

The Role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io: the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

What You'll Do

  • Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.

  • Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.

  • Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.

  • Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.

  • Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.

  • Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.

  • Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience.

  • Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • At least five (5+) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms.

  • Real ownership of a content model in Sanity. You've designed schemas other people had to live with, and you have opinions about references vs. embedded objects, when a variant belongs in the schema versus at runtime, and how to stop a section library sprawling. GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory.

  • Deep front-end expertise: expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript, with a strong command of component API design and the developer experience of a shared library.

  • You can work end to end. Comfortable owning the server side as well as the front end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, a SQL database, secrets and CI. You should be able to take a feature from schema to component to the route that serves it without handing off, and be happy debugging something that only reproduces in production.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance, and comfortable building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass.

  • A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the judgement to balance design intent against engineering constraints.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. You explain your reasoning, review generously, and treat levelling up the people around you as part of the job.

  • Cloudflare Workers, or another edge or serverless platform.

  • Experience with localisation and internationalisation at scale for a global audience.

  • Analytics and tag management implementation: dataLayer events, server-side tagging, getting attribution right without hurting performance.

  • Create and maintain a qualified pipeline through targeted prospecting, local industry relationships, partner collaboration (consultancies, advisory firms, technology partners), and customer referrals.

  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through negotiation and close, working with customers' technical, legal, third-party risk, and procurement teams.

  • Connect Chainalysis solutions to customer outcomes, including managing exposure to crypto-asset service providers and their customers, meeting AML / CFT and sanctions obligations, supporting the safe launch and scaling of digital asset offerings, and investigating illicit activity.

  • Engage customers on how MiCA, the Transfer of Funds Regulation (Travel Rule), DORA, EU AML rules and evolving French and Italian supervisory expectations affect their business needs, working with Chainalysis specialists where appropriate.

  • Position Chainalysis as a partner for both worlds: help banks build confidence in digital assets, and help large Web3 players meet the compliance expectations of banks, regulators and institutional counterparties. Coordinate with the wider crypto native coverage to avoid overlap on mid-market and early-stage Web3 accounts.

  • Maintain accurate forecasts and clear account plans, with consistent visibility into opportunities, risks, and next steps.

  • Work with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to develop proposals and support customer adoption.

  • Represent Chainalysis at customer meetings and industry events across France and Italy, sharing market feedback to inform regional positioning and messaging.

We're looking for candidates who have

  • 7+ years of B2B enterprise software or SaaS sales experience, including significant experience selling to banks or other regulated financial institutions (AML / financial crime, risk, compliance, fraud, or cybersecurity solutions) and/or to large crypto native organisations.

  • A record of exceeding quota through consultative selling, new business development, and account growth in long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Experience developing enterprise accounts in France and/or Italy, with an understanding of local banking and Web3 market practices, procurement and vendor-onboarding processes.

  • A solid understanding of the crypto ecosystem and of the compliance, risk and security challenges facing both banks engaging with digital assets and large exchanges, custodians and infrastructure providers.

  • The ability to translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes for different stakeholders, from compliance officers to CISOs to C-level executives.

  • Experience using a structured enterprise sales methodology to qualify opportunities, develop customer champions, and manage complex deals.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to engage senior executives and explain complex concepts clearly.

  • Professional fluency in English and either French or Italian, with the ability to sell effectively across both markets.

  • The ability to work independently across a defined territory while collaborating with regional and global teams.

  • A willingness to travel regularly across France and Italy and occasionally elsewhere in the SEMEA region.

Nice to have

  • Professional fluency in both French and Italian.

  • Established relationships within French and Italian banks, payment institutions, large crypto platforms, and financial services associations.

  • Experience selling blockchain analytics, financial crime, KYC / transaction monitoring, fraud prevention, cybersecurity, or data analytics solutions to banks.

  • Familiarity with MiCA, the Travel Rule, DORA,European AML requirements, and the roles of relevant French and Italian authorities (e.g. ACPR, AMF, TRACFIN, Banca d'Italia, CONSOB, UIF).

  • Experience selling to banks launching digital asset services (custody, trading, tokenisation, stablecoins), or to large Web3 players serving institutional clients.

  • Experience working with local industry associations, advisory and Big 4 firms, and technology partners to develop a territory.


AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here.

We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

jobs.title: Head of Financial Controller
jobs.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

As Head of Financial Controller, you will own the full accounting function across Filigran's entities, including revenue recognition, consolidation, monthly and year-end close, and internal controls. You will act as the finance function's technical backbone building the infrastructure, controls, and processes needed to support a fast-scaling, multi-entity, international organization.

You will report directly to the VP of Finance. The team is small so this role demands both strategic ownership and significant hands-on execution.

💼 Your Responsibilities

General Accounting Operations

  • Own the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all financial transactions across Filigran entities

  • Continuously improve a scalable monthly/quarterly close process

  • Ensure revenue recognition is correctly applied and documented

Multi-Entity Oversight

  • Lead consolidation across Filigran's growing international entity structure (including new entity set-ups as the company expands)

  • Partner with the VP of Finance on transfer pricing, inter company transactions, and cross-border compliance matters

Controls, Risk & Governance

  • Perform ongoing gap analyses of accounting processes and proactively design and implement internal controls and policies

  • Manage the yearly financial audit end-to-end, acting as the primary point of contact for auditors

  • Own the relationship with the external accounting firm, holding them to a high standard of accuracy and responsiveness

Systems & Scalability

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting workflows

  • Build documentation that make the accounting function auditable and transferable

Leadership & Cross-Functional Support

  • Act as a thought partner to the VP of Finance on technical accounting matters and process design

  • Manage a current team of 3 general accountants.

  • Grow the team to help support scalability and growth.

  • Support ad hoc business requests, including finance topics adjacent to accounting (e.g., payroll coordination)

🔎 Preferred Experience

  • 10+ years in accounting roles, including senior/lead or controller-level experience

  • Strong knowledge of French accounting standards; exposure to multi-GAAP/consolidation environments is a strong plus

  • Proven ability to build processes and internal controls from scratch in a fast-growing or scaling environment

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy and ambiguity; adapts quickly to change

  • Prior people management experience

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

jobs.description:
About The Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We're growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we're looking for an HR Intern to be Taktile's ambassador to our future employees.

You will collaborate closely with our People team to ensure the efficient management of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to ongoing feedback and support. You will play a crucial role in maintaining our HR systems, keeping employee data accurate, and supporting the administrative tasks that keep our people operations running smoothly. By handling these essential tasks, you will contribute significantly to shaping the company's growth and ensuring we maintain a high standard of employee satisfaction and performance. You will work closely with colleagues across all departments to manage various HR activities.

What You'll Do as an HR Intern

  • Employee Onboarding: Once candidates join our team, take the lead in preparing and coordinating first-day agendas for new hires, managing communication to ensure a smooth onboarding experience.

  • Database and Profile Management: Maintain and update HR-related content on our internal databases and manage employee profiles in our HRIS (HiBob), ensuring all data is accurate and up-to-date. This is crucial for consistency and compliance with company policies.

  • Administrative Support: Prepare documents for various processes (internal transfers, mobility, etc.).

  • Employee Benefits Management: Assist in managing and communicating benefits for employees, ensuring they are well informed about their entitlements and processes.

  • General HR Support: Assist with any HR-related queries, providing timely and accurate information to employees and managers.

  • Process Improvement & AI Enablement: Help identify opportunities to streamline HR workflows, including building and refining AI tools (e.g. Claude skills) to make our people operations more efficient.

About You

  • Strong time management and multitasking abilities.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

  • Collaborative attitude and willingness to assist team members in achieving common goals.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (German is a plus).

  • Excited to learn about new concepts, tools, and processes and eager to challenge the status quo.

Ideal Qualifications (but not required)

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Familiarity with HR software and tools.

What We Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator.
