Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Your rights.

Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent.

Automated decision-making.

We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Media Director
jobs.description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

The Integrated Media Senior Director is a senior leadership role accountable for the effective delivery, performance, and integration of all paid media activities across an assigned account or portfolio of accounts. Acting as the operational and strategic lead for media investment, this role ensures that media budgets are planned, deployed, optimized, and measured effectively to drive client growth and business outcomes.

The Integrated Media Senior Director oversees the full spectrum of paid media activity, including Search, Social, Programmatic, Direct Buys, Retail Media, Retail Operations, Media Strategy, and Investment Analytics. The role is responsible for ensuring strategic alignment, investment effectiveness, operational excellence, and cross-channel collaboration across the client portfolio.

While channel specialists remain directly managed within their respective functions, they maintain a dotted-line relationship with the Integrated Media Senior Director to support client-centric accountability and integrated media delivery.

 

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Governance

  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for paid media delivery and performance across assigned accounts.

  • Translate client business objectives into integrated, cross-channel media strategies.

  • Establish clear performance goals, KPIs, and measurement frameworks to evaluate media effectiveness.

  • Drive operational excellence through consistent implementation of processes, infrastructure, workflows, pacing disciplines, and optimization routines.

  • Ensure alignment and coordination across all paid media functions to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Investment & Planning

  • Partner with Strategy teams to define roles, responsibilities, and planning approaches based on client needs and organizational structure.

  • Lead cross-channel media planning and investment allocation to maximize business outcomes.

  • Collaborate with Client Teams to identify optimization opportunities and innovative media solutions.

  • Oversee forecasting, budget pacing, and performance reporting across assigned accounts.

  • Partner with Investment Analytics to improve the adoption and effectiveness of reporting and pacing solutions.

  • Champion the use of data, automation, and platform capabilities to maximize return on investment and efficiency.

Cross-Functional Integration

  • Foster collaboration and alignment across all relevant media and client-facing teams.

  • Partner with Channel Leads to ensure best practices, standards, and operational consistency are implemented across accounts.

  • Facilitate cross-channel planning, learning, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

  • Promote continuous capability development and client education on media investment and performance.

Client & Partner Leadership

  • Act as a senior client contact for media investment, planning, and performance discussions.

  • Build trusted relationships with clients and key partners.

  • Translate complex media performance data into actionable business recommendations.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve media effectiveness and client outcomes.

 

Success Measures

The success of the Integrated Media Senior Director will be evaluated against the following key performance indicators:

Performance Efficiency

  • Achieve or exceed client spend and performance targets.

  • Ensure budget pacing and optimization activities align with client objectives and agreed benchmarks.

  • Measured through quarterly and annual business reviews.

Client Satisfaction & Retention

  • Achieve a client Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 9 or higher within the first year.

  • Drive proactive performance insights and continuous improvement in client communications.

  • Assessed through semi-annual client feedback and satisfaction surveys.

Operational Excellence

  • Deliver media plans, forecasts, and pacing reports accurately and on schedule.

  • Maintain greater than 95% accuracy in forecasting and less than 2% variance against agreed projections.

  • Evaluated through monthly performance and delivery reviews.

Team Alignment & Capability Development

  • Facilitate quarterly cross-channel planning and learning sessions.

  • Lead monthly performance review discussions with relevant stakeholders.

  • Measured through participation levels, stakeholder feedback, and business impact.

Innovation & Growth Contribution

  • Develop and implement innovation initiatives, automation solutions, or process improvements that enhance client results or team efficiency.

  • Demonstrate measurable business impact within 12 months.

  • Reviewed as part of annual performance and goal-setting processes.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Integrated Media VP

Direct-Line Relationships:

  • Search Directors

  • Social Directors

  • Programmatic Directors

  • Retail Media Directors

Key Stakeholders & Partnerships:

  • Client Leadership Teams

  • Strategy Teams

  • Project Management

  • Investment Analytics

  • Partnership Teams

  • Channel Leadership Teams

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

📈 Growth, Your Way: Accumulate one paid day each month (2 hours per week) for self-development and access to Jellyfish Learn.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

DevOps at SkinVision

As a DevOps Engineer at SkinVision, you will play a key role in building, scaling, and securing the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven health platform. You’ll design and maintain our cloud-based systems in AWS, implement CI/CD pipelines, enhance observability using Datadog, and drive operational excellence through automation and monitoring.

Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of a medical-grade system that serves users globally. You’ll collaborate closely with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure smooth delivery, rapid deployments, and resilient operations — ultimately enabling us to deliver life-saving technology with confidence.

Beyond hands-on expertise with AWS and modern DevOps tooling, we’re looking for someone who thinks architecturally. You’ll get to know our current setup, form your own view of how it should evolve, and help define a target vision for our infrastructure, then drive its implementation. Day-to-day operational work is part of the role, but we value someone who thinks before building and takes ownership of where our infrastructure goes next.

What you will do

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

  • Design, build, and manage AWS-based infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  • Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

  • Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments using CI/CD pipelines.

  • Ensure system resilience, security, and performance through automated monitoring and alerting.

CI/CD & Deployment

  • Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reliable, and safe deployments across environments.

  • Manage deployment workflows using Argo CD and Kubernetes.

  • Collaborate with developers and ML engineers to streamline build, test, and release processes.

  • Integrate automated testing, rollback strategies, and version control into the deployment lifecycle.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Build a comprehensive observability stack using Datadog for metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.

  • Define service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and dashboards for system performance.

  • Proactively detect and resolve performance bottlenecks, capacity issues, and reliability risks.

  • Create automated health checks and ensure visibility across production systems.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement security best practices for AWS, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Manage identity, access, and secret handling (IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store).

  • Ensure compliance with medical device standards and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).

  • Partner with the Information Security Officer to embed security controls across infrastructure and deployments.

Reliability & Incident Management

  • Lead incident response and root cause analysis for infrastructure or deployment-related issues.

  • Establish SLAs and operational runbooks for production environments.

  • Continuously improve system reliability through chaos testing, redundancy, and fault tolerance.

  • Mentor engineers on DevOps principles, observability practices, and infrastructure automation.

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture

  • Assess the current infrastructure and deployment setup, and form a well-reasoned view of how it should evolve.

  • Define and maintain a target architecture for our cloud platform, balancing reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Translate the target vision into a practical roadmap and drive its implementation incrementally, alongside day-to-day operations.

  • Document and communicate architectural decisions, aligning with engineering and leadership on technical direction.


Essential skills

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles.

  • Strong expertise with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc.).

  • Expert in Kubernetes and Argo CD, deploying and managing production-grade custom Helm charts with secure, automated GitOps workflows in EKS

  • Advanced knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar).

  • Proficiency in Datadog for observability, monitoring, and alerting.

  • Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go.

  • Experience managing infrastructure with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible.

  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals, load balancing, and API gateway configuration.

  • Excellent problem-solving and incident management skills.

Desirable skills

  • Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, MedTech, or FinTech.

  • Familiarity with multi-environment architecture (staging, pre-prod, production) and blue-green deployments.

  • Exposure to event-driven systems, message queues, and data streaming (Kafka, SNS/SQS).

  • Understanding of Zero Trust networking and cloud security best practices.

  • Experience in cost optimization and performance tuning in AWS.

Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or Terraform Associate are a plus.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy

  • A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam

  • An enthusiastic, professional, and international team

  • Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities

  • Unlimited skin checks for you

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Are you an ambitious growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit and a track record of scaling customer acquisition? Do you love diving into data, spotting opportunities, and turning ideas into measurable growth? Are you excited by opening new acquisition channels and finding smarter ways to grow in an AI-driven world?

AIHR is looking for an experienced Senior Growth Marketing Manager to help accelerate growth across our B2C and B2B businesses. You'll work across the entire acquisition funnel, from scaling paid media and improving conversion to launching new growth initiatives that drive MQLs and revenue.

You'll join an ambitious, results-driven Growth Marketing team, working closely with our specialists to challenge existing approaches, experiment with new ideas, and deliver results. You'll have the autonomy to lead initiatives, the support of an experienced team, and the opportunity to make a direct impact on a global e-learning business.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and the potential to craft your own role.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll play a key role in accelerating customer acquisition across our B2C and B2B businesses. Working closely with the Head of Growth Marketing and VP of Marketing, you'll help us achieve our ambitious growth targets, improve acquisition efficiency, and identify new opportunities to scale.

A core part of your role will be diving into performance data to understand what's working, what's not, and where our biggest growth opportunities lie. You'll work closely with our Performance Marketing Specialist to scale paid acquisition, challenge existing strategies, test new approaches, and support campaign execution where needed. You'll also collaborate with our CRO Specialist to identify opportunities across landing pages, website journeys, and conversion funnels, turning insights into experiments that drive more leads and revenue.

You'll bring a strong growth perspective to our email marketing efforts, working with the team to analyze nurture flows, promotional campaigns, and audience segments, and identify opportunities to improve performance. Beyond optimizing existing channels, you'll explore, launch, and scale new acquisition opportunities, including those emerging from the changing AI- and LLM-driven marketing landscape.

Most importantly, this is a hands-on role where you'll do more than develop strategies and bring ideas to the table. You'll actively execute initiatives yourself or work closely with the wider team to bring them to life. Whether you're launching a new campaign, testing an acquisition channel, or improving conversion, you'll take ownership of turning opportunities into measurable business results.


On a typical week

It's Monday morning, and you start the week with a coffee and a look at last week's acquisition performance. You open GA4, HubSpot, and your marketing dashboards to see how we're tracking against our B2C and B2B MQL targets. While digging into the data, you notice that one of our paid campaigns is generating plenty of traffic, but conversions have dropped. You investigate further, identify a few potential causes, and head into the Growth Marketing stand-up with some ideas to improve performance.

After the stand-up, you catch up with our Performance Marketing Specialist to review campaign performance and discuss opportunities to scale. You identify a promising new audience and agree to test a different creative approach. Rather than just handing over your ideas, you jump into the advertising platform to help set up the campaign and work with the team to get the new creatives ready for launch.

On Tuesday, you're focused on improving our B2B acquisition funnel. You've spotted an opportunity to increase conversions on the AI for HR Boot Camp landing page. You meet with our B2B Marketer and CRO Specialist to review the data, discuss your hypothesis, and agree on an experiment. You brief the team, align with sales on the proposed changes, and help move the experiment towards launch.

Wednesday is a work-from-home day, giving you time to dive deeper into our acquisition strategy. You've been exploring how AI and LLMs are changing the way HR professionals discover training providers. You identify a potential new acquisition opportunity, research the market, and put together a practical plan to test it. Later, you meet with the Head of Growth Marketing to challenge your assumptions, refine the approach, and agree on the next steps.

On Thursday, you review the performance of our B2C email nurture flows with the Email Marketing team. You notice an opportunity to improve conversions from leads to MQLs and propose a change to the messaging and sequence. After lunch with colleagues in the office, you turn your attention to an upcoming quarterly campaign, working with the wider Marketing team to finalize the messaging and coordinate the launch. You also start investigating new channels that could help expand the campaign's reach and attract new audiences.

Friday starts with reviewing the results of a recent landing page experiment. The changes have improved conversion, so you work with the CRO Specialist to roll them out more broadly. You also catch up with our BizOps team to improve HubSpot reporting, ensuring we have better visibility into acquisition performance and opportunities for growth. Before wrapping up the week, you review progress against our growth priorities, share your findings with the team, and identify the next opportunities worth pursuing.

After a productive week of analyzing, experimenting, and driving initiatives forward, you close your laptop and join your colleagues for Friday drinks.

We offer

  • A revenue-generating role in a fast-growing scale-up company; 

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a satellite office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work at AIHR

  • Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;

  • Pension plan;

  • 4 Trust days per year (ad-hoc recovery days to take whenever you're overwhelmed, exhausted, or need to deal with something personal);

  • Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Get a taste of AIHR experience and check out our AIHR Benefits Guide!


Who you are

We're looking for an ambitious, data-driven, and commercially minded growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit. Someone who loves identifying opportunities, challenging existing approaches, and turning ideas into measurable results. You're not just a strategic thinker; you're equally excited about getting operational, executing ideas yourself, and making things happen.

You have:

  • 8+ years of experience in growth marketing, with a proven track record of scaling customer acquisition, ideally across both B2C and B2B businesses in SaaS, e-learning, or other high-growth industries;

  • Demonstrable experience scaling paid acquisition campaigns, including managing or scaling advertising budgets of €100,000+ per month;

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to dive into performance data, identify growth opportunities, and translate insights into actionable initiatives;

  • A strong understanding of full-funnel marketing, including paid acquisition, CRO, landing page optimization, email marketing, and growth economics such as CAC and LTV;

  • Strong experience with HubSpot or comparable CRM platforms, including segmentation, automation, lifecycle marketing, attribution, and reporting;

  • Experience identifying, testing, and scaling new acquisition channels and growth opportunities;

  • Strong AI proficiency, with experience using ChatGPT and Claude to analyze data, improve workflows, and accelerate execution;

  • An understanding of how AI and LLMs are changing customer acquisition, with a forward-thinking approach to emerging marketing channels;

  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to independently lead and execute initiatives while collaborating effectively with the wider team;

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and a hunger to grow;

  • Bonus: Experience in event marketing, community-led growth, or account-based marketing (ABM).

Apply for the job

Are you excited to become our new Senior Growth Marketing Manager? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.

You help evolve a mature monolithic codebase into a more modular, testable and future-proof architecture. By modernising the foundation of the product, you directly enable better user experiences, faster iteration and higher overall product quality.

jobs.title: wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken
jobs.description:
wo-afstudeerstage/praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten?
Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes.

Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig?

Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water.

Je gaat onder andere:

  • bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid;

  • onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten;

  • een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid;

  • de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête;

  • onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn;

  • je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS.

Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. Als blijkt dat de milieukosten betrouwbaar kunnen worden berekend, kunnen de uitkomsten bovendien worden gebruikt om de bestaande afval- en waterstatistieken te controleren.

In het meest gunstige scenario kan de aparte enquête naar milieukosten gedeeltelijk of helemaal vervallen. Dat betekent minder administratieve lasten voor bedrijven, efficiënter gebruik van beschikbare data en mogelijk betrouwbaardere statistieken.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Leefomgeving bij team Milieu. Met 20 gedreven professionals werken we aan milieu gerelateerde statistieken en doen we onderzoek naar actuele thema’s zoals klimaat(verandering) en circulaire economie. We werken nauw samen met andere teams binnen het CBS.

We werken hard aan het continu verbeteren van onze statistieken en de cijfers beschikbaar te stellen voor het publiek. Voorbeelden van recente publicaties uit ons team zijn:

  • Bedrijven investeerden in 2024 minder in milieu | CBS

  • Bijna 2 procent meer bedrijfs- en industrieafval in 2021 | CBS

  • Milieukosten en -investeringen van bedrijven | CBS

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een wo-opleiding milieukunde, economie, technische bestuurskunde, data science of een aanverwante opleiding.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met het onderwerp circulaire economie.

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe vraagstukken gestructureerd onderzoeken en vertalen naar heldere inzichten.

  • Je kunt goed programmeren in R.

  • Je bent sociaal en communicatief vaardig en kunt je ideeën en bevindingen helder overbrengen aan verschillende gesprekspartners.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw competenties in kwantitatieve data-analyse versterkt door gebruik te maken van milieustatistieken en economische databronnen;

  • jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden aanscherpt op het gebied van de circulaire economie en levenscyclusanalyse;

  • jouw programmeervaardigheden in R verder ontwikkelt;

  • ervaring opdoet met het interpreteren van verschillende datasets om betrouwbare profielen op te stellen.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

Your main focus will be the development assurance and certification of airborne electronic hardware. You will work closely with Hardware, Systems Engineering, Safety, Verification & Validation and Certification teams to ensure that hardware development and verification activities fulfil the applicable certification objectives.

You will translate certification and safety requirements into practical engineering activities and help ensure that the required compliance evidence is complete, consistent, traceable and ready for review by certification authorities.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Plan, coordinate and support DO-254 / ED-80 hardware certification activities throughout the hardware development lifecycle.

  • Develop, review and maintain certification artefacts such as the Plan for Hardware Aspects of Certification (PHAC), Hardware Verification Plan (HVP), Hardware Configuration Management Plan (HCMP), Hardware Accomplishment Summary (HAS) and supporting compliance evidence.

  • Define and maintain DO-254 compliance matrices and ensure that applicable objectives are addressed by appropriate engineering evidence.

  • Support determination and justification of the applicable Hardware Design Assurance Level (DAL) together with Systems and Safety Engineering.

  • Ensure bidirectional requirements traceability between system requirements, hardware requirements, design data and verification evidence.

  • Review hardware requirements, conceptual and detailed designs, verification activities and lifecycle data against DO-254 objectives.

  • Define and review hardware verification methods, test cases, procedures, analyses and results, including the required level of independence.

  • Support compliance of FPGA, programmable logic, complex electronic hardware and electronic assemblies, as applicable to the individual programme.

  • Assess COTS, reused or previously developed hardware and define appropriate certification and compliance activities.

  • Support configuration management, problem reporting, change control and lifecycle data management required for certification.

  • Perform compliance reviews, gap analyses and change-impact assessments and track findings through closure.

  • Work closely with Hardware Development, Systems Engineering, Safety, Test & Verification and Configuration Management to integrate certification activities into the engineering lifecycle.

  • Support certification reviews, audits and authority engagements and provide clear technical justification for the selected means of compliance.

  • Continuously improve the organisation's DO-254 processes, templates, tooling and certification methods.



What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Professional experience in airborne electronic hardware development, hardware verification, aerospace certification or development assurance.

  • Strong practical knowledge of RTCA DO-254 / EUROCAE ED-80 and its application to airborne electronic hardware.

  • Experience with hardware certification planning, requirements management, verification and compliance evidence.

  • Good understanding of FPGA / CPLD or complex electronic hardware development, electronic hardware and PCB development, hardware requirements and design reviews, requirements-based verification, configuration management, change control, requirements traceability, verification independence, and COTS or reused hardware assessment.

  • Experience creating or reviewing DO-254 lifecycle documents such as PHAC, HVP, HCMP and HAS is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with AC 20-152A or comparable authority guidance for airborne electronic hardware is an advantage.

  • Knowledge of related aerospace development and safety standards such as ARP4754A, ARP4761 / ARP4761A and DO-178C is advantageous.

  • Experience working with aviation certification authorities or within a DOA or military airworthiness environment is advantageous.

  • Structured and analytical working style with a strong focus on traceability, evidence and technical correctness.

  • Ability to communicate complex certification requirements effectively to hardware engineers and other engineering disciplines.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken. German language skills are beneficial.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

jobs.title: Senior Penetration Tester API, Web & Cloud – Contract (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting.

  • Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing.

  • Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation.

  • Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported.

  • Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug.

  • Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface.

  • Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end.

  • You have deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10, WSTG and ASVS, including authentication/authorization models (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, injection and XSS.

  • You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech.

  • You are fluent with Burp Suite Pro (or similar) and write your own scripts and tooling (Python, Go or similar).

  • You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.

  • You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • You are available to start at short notice.

  • Bonus Points: OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or similar certifications; experience red-teaming LLM applications or AI agents; testing in PCI-DSS environments.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

jobs.title: Voksen, blind kvinne søker assistenter!
jobs.description:
Jeg er en sosial, kreativ og aktiv kvinne på snart 60 år som søker etter BPA-assistenter. Jeg har redusert hørsel og har en førerhund som er med meg overalt, derfor er det viktig at du ikke er allergisk mot hund. Jeg har behov for personlig assistanse i hverdagen – slik at jeg kan leve et fritt og selvstendig liv slik jeg ønsker!

Jeg liker å strikke, gå på tur, delta på kulturelle arrangement og aktiviteter, treffe venner og familie. Jeg søker assistenter som er tilgjengelige to formiddager og en ettermiddag i uken, samt noe på helg. 

Jeg liker godt å hagearbeid – så det er et stort pluss om du liker å være aktiv og har «grønne fingre».

Jeg søker etter tilkallingsassistenter.

Arbeidsoppgaver:
  • Bistå ved transport
  • Ledsage meg og synstolke omgivelsene
  • Bistå på tur sammen med førerhunden min
  • Bistå i sosiale sammenhenger
  • Bistå ved matlaging og tilberedning
  • Praktisk hjelp i og utenfor hjemmet
Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:
  • Førerkort klasse B og egen bil
  • Gode norskkunnskaper
  • Liker fysisk aktivitet og trening
  • Kreativ og estetisk sans
Personlige egenskaper:
  • Omsorgsfull
  • Energisk
  • Kreativ
  • Løsningsorientert
  • Positiv innstilling og evne til å jobbe selvstendig
Vi tilbyr:
  • Muligheter for egenutvikling
  • Kompetanseheving
  • E-læringskurs via NHI.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Send en kort søknad og fortell litt om deg selv - jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!

Ta gjerne kontakt med koordinator Agnethe Johanne Lynn Ytrøy ay@assent.no hvis du har spørsmål.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Assent har organisert BPA-tjenester siden 2014. I dag har vi konsesjon på levering av BPA i flere kommuner over hele landet. Vi har medarbeidere med god kjennskap til ordningen og arbeidsgiverrollen, samt lang erfaring med organisering av individuelle tjenester både i og utenfor hjemmet. For oss er det viktig at arbeidleder i størst mulig grad kan leve et uavhengig og selvstendig liv. Assent er medlem i NHO og våre tjenester er i henold til ISO 9001,ISO 14001 og OHSAS 18001.

jobs.title: Heimehjelp i heimetenesta
jobs.description:
Om avdelinga:

Heimetenesta i Øygarden kommune er under kommunalsjefområde helse og velferd og er inndelt i fire avdelingar, Skogsvåg, Ågotnes, Straume og Bildøy. Som heimehjelp i heimetenesta vil ein jobbe tett på brukarane i deira heim og møte dei i ulike livssituasjonar og ulike utfordringar. I heimetenesta jobbar ein strukturert innanfor geografiske avdelingar i team og aleine. Vi treng deg som kan utføre tildelte oppgåver i brukars heim. Vi ønskjer at du er dyktig og engasjert i oppgåver som du vil møte.

Avdeling Bildøy har ledig ein 50% og ein 65% fast stilling som heimehjelp

Avdeling Skogsvåg har ledig ein 50% fast stilling som heimehjelp.

Stillingane er ledig frå no. Anna stillingsprosent kan bli ledig ved eventuelle interne søkjarar.

Kven ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som trivs med mange ballar i lufta, som er robust og positiv på krevjande dagar og som trivs best når du arbeider i eit aktivt miljø. Dine kommunikasjon/samarbeidsevner er gode. Som heimehjelp i heimetenesta får du høve til å utfordre, utvikle og tileigne deg mykje erfaring og kunnskap i ei teneste som stadig er under utvikling og vekst. Vi har fokus på å gje brukaren god livskvalitet, oppretthalde eigne ressursar og gje dei høve til å bu heime så lenge som mogleg gjennom førebyggjande behandling/ tiltak.

Kva får du hos oss?

 I heimetenesta vil du få arbeide med dyktige og løysingsorienterte medarbeidarar, og det er kort veg mellom leiing og dei tilsette. Årsturnus med 16 arbeidshelger (eventuelt fleire mot kompensasjon), årleg fagdag, internundervisning og mentorordning for nytilsette.

Du vil arbeide med praktisk bistand (heimehjelp) i kombinasjon med heimesjukepleie på helg/høgtid. Du vil møte motiverte og kunnskapsrike kollega, interessante utfordringar og ha høve til personleg og fagleg utvikling. Som tilsett hos oss vil du og ha gode pensjons – og forsikringsordningar. Du har høve til å søke startlån utan krav til eigenkapital gjennom kommunen (sjå Startlån for å rekruttere og behalde helsepersonell - Øygarden kommune), samt ha tilgang til gratis parkering.

Kven er så du?

Det er ønskeleg med fagbrev innan reinhald eller at du har anna relevant fagbrev innan helse. Relevant arbeidserfaring kan kompensera for manglande formell kompetanse. Du må ha førarkort. Du har gode norskkunnskapar og beherskar språket både munnleg og skriftleg. Du er strukturert og evnar å halde oversikt. Vi legg vekt på personleg eignaheit  Du må kunne arbeide sjølvstendig og saman med andre, samt bidra til eit godt arbeidsmiljø. Du trivs med å tenke nytt, samstundes som du tar vare på dei gode løysingane som allereie eksisterer.

Som vår nye kollega er det viktig at du kjenner deg igjen i våre verdiar; omsorg, livsglede, mot, raus og engasjement.

Om du kjennar deg igjen, bli med oss på laget!

Kontakt:

Ass einingsleiar Kate S. Løland 56 16 05 02 / 95 07 11 21

Øygarden kommune ønskjer eit arbeidsmiljø prega av mangfald, og at våre medarbeidarar i størst mogleg grad skal spegla mangfaldet i befolkninga. Vi oppmodar alle som er kvalifiserte til å søkja jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn. Som IA-verksemd ønskjer kommunen å leggja til rette for arbeidsforholda dersom du har behov for det.

Etter utløpet til søknadsfristen, vert det sett opp ei offentleg søkjarliste med namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bustads- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. Det kan gjerast unntak frå innsyn for opplysningar om ein søkjar dersom vedkomande sjølv ber om det. Opplysningar om ein søkjar, kan verta offentlege sjølv om søkjaren har bede om ikkje å vert ført opp på søkjarlista. Dersom oppmodinga ikkje vert teken til følgje, vert søkjaren varsla om dette. Ved vurderinga av om ei slik oppmoding skal takast til følgje, skal det leggjast vekt på om det knyter seg særleg offentleg interesse til stillinga.

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Øygarden kommune er den nest største kommunen i Vestland fylke med om lag 40 700 innbyggjarar og om lag 2 800 tilsette. Straume er kommunesenter (ca. 15 minutt køyring frå Bergen) med kommunedelsenter på Rong, Ågotnes og i Skogsskiftet. Administrasjonsspråket i Øygarden er nynorsk. Øygarden kommune har sett seg som mål å vera ein framtidsretta og kunnskapsbasert samfunnsutviklar med fortrinn innanfor energi, teknologi og marine ressursar. Kommunen skal løfta fram viktige verdiar som felles kultur, språk og identitet. Vi har ambisjonar om å vera ein handlekraftig og effektiv organisasjon med god leiing, høg kompetanse og kvalitet.

jobs.title: Vil du gjøre en forskjell i hverdagen til en aktiv og herlig gutt på 8 år?
jobs.description:
Vi søker en trygg, leken og omsorgsfull ekstravakt, med mulighet for fast stilling!

Hvem er gutten?

Han er en aktiv og herlig gutt på 8 år som bor i vakre og fredelige omgivelser på Mosterøy, sammen med foreldrene sine og to yngre søsken.

Han er glad i å være i aktivitet! Han liker å leke, sykle, bade, hoppe på trampoline og oppleve nye ting. Han har mye glede og energi å by på, og trenger noen som har lyst til å bli med på det han liker aller best.

Gutten har autistiske trekk og trenger støtte, veiledning og forutsigbarhet i hverdagen. Han har behov for hjelp med blant annet personlig stell, påkledning, måltider, kommunikasjon og språk. Det er viktig at han blir møtt med trygghet, forståelse og tålmodighet, og at den som jobber med ham tar seg tid til å bli kjent med hans behov og måte å kommunisere på.

Med riktig støtte og tilrettelegging får han mulighet til å oppleve mestring, utvikling og gode dager fylt med aktiviteter han trives med.

Hvem er du?

Det aller viktigste for oss er ikke hvor mye erfaring du har, men hvem du er som menneske.

Vi ser etter deg som har et genuint ønske om å gjøre en forskjell i livet til et barn. Du som ikke bare ser arbeidsoppgaver som skal utføres, men et barn som fortjener å bli sett, forstått, inkludert og heiet på.

Du er til stede, tar initiativ og finner glede i de små og store øyeblikkene. Du er trygg, tålmodig og leken, og forstår at det å skape gode relasjoner tar tid.

Du evner å møte gutten på hans premisser, lese signalene hans og tilpasse deg dagsformen og behovene hans. Du forstår viktigheten av forutsigbarhet, samtidig som du har lyst til å bidra til lek, aktivitet og nye opplevelser.

Vi ønsker oss noen som gleder seg til å komme på jobb, som engasjerer seg i guttens utvikling, og som virkelig ønsker å bidra til at han får en trygg, aktiv og meningsfull hverdag.

Du vil jobbe tett på en familie på fem, og derfor betyr personlig kjemi, tillit og god kommunikasjon veldig mye.

Hva skal du gjøre?

  • Hjelpe gutten med personlig stell, hygiene og påkledning.

  • Støtte og veilede ham i matsituasjoner.

  • Være en aktiv og engasjert lekekamerat.

  • Bidra til å fremme språk og kommunikasjon.

  • Skape trygghet, struktur og forutsigbarhet i hverdagen.

  • Legge til rette for mestring, selvstendighet og gode opplevelser.

  • Delta i aktiviteter både inne og ute, som sykling, bading, trampoline og turer.

  • Være med på turer og reiser etter avtale.

  • Avlaste foreldrene med praktiske oppgaver som husarbeid og matlaging.

Arbeidstid:

Vi søker i første omgang ekstravakt/tilkallingsvikar, med mulighet for fast stilling på sikt.

Aktuelle vakttider er:

  • Hverdager: kl. 16.00–22.00

  • Lørdag og søndag: kl. 09.00–21.30

Arbeidsstedet er hjemme hos familien på Mosterøy, omtrent 25 minutter med bil fra Stavanger sentrum.

Hva ønsker vi av deg?

  • Du har førerkort.

  • Du behersker norsk godt (minimum B2).

  • Du er omsorgsfull, leken, trygg og tålmodig.

  • Du er pålitelig, ansvarsbevisst og ønsker å bygge en god relasjon over tid.

  • Du er komfortabel med å bistå med personlig stell og omsorgsoppgaver.

  • Du tar initiativ og ser hva som trengs, uten alltid å måtte bli fortalt det.

  • Du møter barn med ulike behov med forståelse, respekt og varme.

  • Du kan fremlegge gyldig politiattest før oppstart.

Erfaring med barn med særskilte behov eller autistiske trekk er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Personlig egnethet og et ekte engasjement veier tyngst.

Du vil få god opplæring, så du trenger ikke kunne alt fra før.

Det viktigste for oss

Vi søker ikke bare noen som kan fylle vakter. Vi søker noen som ønsker å bli en trygg og positiv person i guttens liv.

Noen som ser ham for den han er, som heier på fremskrittene hans, møter utfordringer med tålmodighet og som har lyst til å skape gode minner sammen med ham.

For oss handler dette om mer enn praktisk hjelp. Det handler om trygghet, livskvalitet, mestring og ekte omsorg.

Vi håper å finne en person som ønsker å engasjere seg, bygge en god relasjon og bli en viktig støtte i guttens hverdag.

Kanskje er du akkurat den personen vi leter etter?

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Vil du hjelpe sykemeldte tilbake til arbeid og aktivitet?
jobs.description:
Vi søker en engasjert veileder til et vikariat med varighet på ett år ved avdelingen for sykefraværsoppfølging Hos oss får du en meningsfull og variert arbeidshverdag, der du bidrar til at mennesker får muligheten til å bruke sine ressurser og komme nærmere arbeid og aktivitet.Som veileder vil du følge opp personer med ulike utfordringer og behov, og hjelpe dem med å finne veien videre gjennom målrettet veiledning, tett oppfølging og samarbeid med arbeidsgivere, helsetjenesten og andre aktører.Vi ser etter deg som evner å se muligheter hos mennesker, bygger gode relasjoner og motiveres av å skape resultater sammen med andre. Hvis du ønsker en rolle hvor du kan kombinere faglig kompetanse, relasjonsarbeid og samfunnsengasjement, kan dette være stillingen for deg.Høres dette ut som en spennende mulighet? Ønsker du å bidra til NAVs viktige samfunnsoppdrag, håper vi at du blir vår nye kollega.Ved NAV Madla er vi rundt 60 engasjerte og kompetente medarbeidere fordelt på tre avdelinger. Sammen jobber vi for å gi mennesker muligheter og støtte på veien mot arbeid og aktivitet.Våre lokaler ligger sentralt i Madlakrossen, med gode kollektivforbindelser og enkel tilgang til arbeidsplassen Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Kartlegging av menneskers ressurser, muligheter og oppfølgingsbehov.  
  • Veilede og motivere mennesker mot arbeid.
  • Veilede og gi informasjon etter gjeldende regelverk.
  • Informere om rettigheter og plikter på en god og enkel måte, skriftlig og muntlig.
  • Helhetlig oppfølging av mennesker som av ulike årsaker står utenfor arbeidslivet.
  • Se muligheter, tross helseutfordringer.
  • Samarbeid, samhandling og relasjonsbygging med ulike aktører som arbeidsgivere, helsetjeneste, tiltaksarrangører og kommunale tjenester.
  • Økonomisk råd og veiledning.

NAV er i stadig endring og utvikling, og andre arbeidsoppgaver og ansvarsområder kan bli aktuelle.

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser etter deg som har:

  • Fullført utdannelse tilsvarende bachelor, fortrinnsvis utdanning innen arbeids- og velferdsfag, sosiologi og sosialt arbeid. Relevant arbeidserfaring/eller annen utdanning kan kompensere for utdanningskrav.
  • Erfaring med sykefraværsoppfølging.
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner og veiledningskompetanse.
  • God muntlig og skriftlig kommunikasjons- og fremstillingsevne (norsknivå på B2 eller tilsvarende nivå må kunne dokumenteres for søkere uten norsk som morsmål).
  • Du må kunne formidle informasjon klart og lett.
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter. Du må kunne sette deg raskt inn i og håndtere flere ulike fagsystem. 

Vi ønsker at du har: 

  • Kjennskap til offentlig sektor.
  • Kjennskap til Nav, næringslivet og samarbeidspartnere innenfor kommunen.
  • Erfaring med lovanvendelse og saksbehandling.

Utenlandske grader må være godkjent av NOKUT eller direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som har følgende personlige egenskaper:

  • Motstandsdyktig - Å jobbe med mennesker i utfordrende situasjoner over tid kan være krevende. Derfor er det viktig at du også klarer å se muligheter, er positiv og har pågangsmot, også i slike situasjoner.
  • Nettverksbygging -  I rollen din som veileder vil du kommunisere og samhandle med mennesker i ulike situasjoner. Du vil samarbeide med kolleger, arbeidsgivere og andre aktører både internt og eksternt i Nav. Derfor er det viktig at du har evnen til å kommunisere godt og tydelig med menneske både i og utenfor organisasjonen. For deg er det naturlig å oppsøke andre for å utvikle nye relasjoner og samtidig ivaretar eksisterende relasjoner til næringsliv og arbeidsgivere. 
  • Initiativtaking - I rollen som veileder er det viktig at du er proaktiv og selvstendig. Du evner å se muligheter, forutse utfordringer og setter i gang nødvendige tiltak uten å vente på instruksjoner. Du tar ansvar for egne oppgaver, bidrar der det er behov og arbeider målrettet for å finne gode løsninger for brukere og samarbeidspartnere.
  • Planlegging og organisering - Hos oss styrer du i stor grad arbeidshverdagen din selv, og derfor er det viktig at du er selvgående, klarer å ha god oversikt og planlegger ukene, møter og oppgavene dine på en effektiv måte slik at du kommer i mål med oppgavene dine. Arbeidshverdagen din som veileder gir stor variasjon i arbeidsoppgaver, og det er viktig at du har en stor arbeidskapasitet og er strukturert.

Personlige egenskaper vektlegges sterkt.

Vi tilbyr
  • Spennende arbeidsoppgaver med mulighet for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Dyktige medarbeidere og et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Mulighet til å benytte én time per uke i arbeidstiden til fysisk aktivitet.
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid og gode velferdsordninger.
  • Hjem- jobb- hjem avtale.
  • Vikariat som veileder i stillingskode 1434 rådgiver, med årslønn fra 640.000 - 680.000.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom Statens Pensjonskasse (SPK).
KontaktinformasjonElisabeth V. Barka, Avdelingsleder, 472 31 889, Elisabeth.Veland.Barka@nav.no ArbeidsstedMadlakrossen 6-8 4042 HAFRSFJORD Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Nav Referansenr.: 5206246307 Stillingsprosent: 100% Vikariat Søknadsfrist: 19.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nav søker ansatte med hjerte for mennesker og våre fagområder. Vår visjon er å gi mennesker muligheter, og dette gjør vi ved å utvikle Norges beste arbeids- og velferdstjenester.

Nav består av 22 000 kompetente og engasjerte medarbeidere. Vi jobber tverrfaglig i sterke fagmiljøer. Hos oss skal arbeidsmiljøet preges av involvering, åpenhet og tillit.

Mangfold er viktig i Nav. Mangfold bidrar til bedre problemløsing, økt kreativitet, større fleksibilitet og styrker kulturen og arbeidsmiljøet på arbeidsplassen. Vi oppfordrer derfor kandidater med ulik bakgrunn til å søke på stillinger hos oss, spesielt om du har hull i CV-en, innvandrerbakgrunn eller nedsatt funksjonsevne.

Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste. Ønsker du å bli unntatt fra offentlig søkerliste må du begrunne dette. Del gjerne ditt vitnemål eller karakterutskrift via vitnemålsportalen.no.

jobs.title: Project Lead Equipment Installation (Málaga)
jobs.description:
Oversee contractor-led tool installations for the Málaga cleanroom (Fab 5) project, with a focus on safety and conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines.

What you will doFor the Málaga Fab 5 project, tool installations will be performed by the contractor. imec’s role focuses on safety oversight and validating that the installations conform to imec’s required standards and guidelines. That’s where you come in. Onboarding and training will take place in Leuven, Belgium until mid-2028, after which the position location will transfer to Málaga, Spain.  As Project Lead, your role combines contractor oversight, safety follow-up and installation conformity validation on behalf of imec. The contractor is responsible for installation execution and day-to-day coordination of the installation works. You will monitor progress, review safety and quality matters, and coordinate interfaces with imec stakeholders, keeping a clear distinction between contractor execution and imec oversight. Your focus is to validate conformity with imec’s installation standards, guidelines and safety requirements. You will review contractor deliverables and installation evidence, follow up deviations and corrective actions, and support installation acceptance by imec rather than directly managing execution. You will:

  • Oversee contractor-led installations and coordinate interfaces with imec
  • Review contractor schedules and monitor progress against agreed milestones
  • Flag scope deviations and their impact on timelines, budgets and priorities
  • Validate installation conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines through reviews, inspections and supporting records
  • Provide safety oversight and follow up contractor actions on safety and quality findings
  • Keep internal stakeholders and external partners informed
  • Escalate risks and non-conformities, track corrective actions and review evidence for installation acceptance

Who you are

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering.
  • You have at least 5 years of relevant technical experience.
  • You have experience overseeing contractor-led technical projects and reviewing installations against defined standards and guidelines.
  • You communicate openly and proactively with both internal customers and external partners about the status of ongoing work, and you escalate issues promptly when needed.
  • You adapt easily to changes and time pressure and combine a practical mindset with a strong focus on safety, quality and conformity.
  • You are fluent in English and Spanish.

jobs.title: Make an impact with us at Kongsberg Maritime.
jobs.employer: KONGSBERG MARITIME AS AVD CARPUS KONGSBERG
jobs.description:
We're seeking talented individuals to help us shape the maritime future. If you're ready to be part of this exciting journey, your adventure begins here!

The Global HSE Manager – Operational Safety is responsible for developing, maintaining and improving KM’s global approach to operational safety, with emphasis on preventing serious injuries and fatalities, strengthening operational risk management and ensuring effective implementation of operational control requirements across divisions, business units and sites.

The position supports the Global Director HSE in strengthening KM’s operational safety performance, ensuring consistent expectations for high-risk activities, incidents, investigations, learning and corrective actions, and enabling the organisation to manage operational safety risks through clear requirements, practical guidance and effective follow-up.

What you will be doing• Risk Management: Own the HSE Risk Management process, maintain the Global HSE Risk Register, and facilitate risk reviews and assurance activities.• Operational Control: Own the operational control process and coordinate the development, implementation and continuous improvement of global HSE operational controls.• Learning and Improvement: Own the global lessons learned and HSE Subject Matter Expert frameworks and facilitate HSE forums and meetings to strengthen knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.• Safety Culture: Drive Human and Organisational Performance (HOP) initiatives to strengthen KM’s safety culture.• Systems and Tools: Act as system owner, where assigned, for HSE tools and applications, including governance, development, supplier management, budgets and improvement roadmaps.• HSE Assurance and Support: Conduct audits and inspections, lead or support incident investigations, provide subject matter expertise, and deliver HSE training, advice and professional support.

We think you should have• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent relevant experience.• Solid experience with HSE risk management, operational controls and high-risk work activities.• Experience with incident reporting, serious incident investigations, corrective actions and sharing of lessons learned• Good knowledge of ISO 45001 and practical application of HSE management system requirements. Knowledge of ISO 14001 is an advantage• Good business understanding and ability to translate operational safety requirements into practical and effective ways of working• Experience from an operational HSE role is an advantage

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.

At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!

You are able to• understand the organization's informal rules and structures and utilize political processes effectively to get things done• act on own initiative, make things happen and accept responsibility for the results• make an impact, convince and persuade others and promote plans and ideas successfully• use a methodical and systematic approach, plan ahead, define clear priorities and allocate your time effectively• demonstrate specialist knowledge and expertise in own area• communicate in a clear, precise and structured way

Why join us• An exciting and important position working for the world-leading supplier of maritime solutions• Be part of a diverse team spread across several countries, embracing collaboration and cultural diversity.• We offer flexible working hours.• We offer hybrid working arrangement.

Kongsberg Maritime’s strength lies in unity. Diverse minds, developing technologies for sustainable oceans, drive innovation worldwide

Where you will be workingAny KM location in Norway, Sweden, Finland, UK or Poland. Other global locations may be considered for strong internal candidates, though Europe is preferred due to time zones.

Interested in knowing more? ContactMagnus Soon ArnhusGlobal Director HSE +47 408 85 376

Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than 8,300 employees in 35 countries.

Technologies for sustainable oceans

Our People and Corporate Affairs Division is a key enabler to the Kongsberg Maritime strategy, unifying the support functions to deliver the business strategy and goals. We are closely connected to the operations and cover a wide breadth of different functions, with common themes of global functional and business support, external relations development, safety, security, people enablement and communications, operational excellence, and license to operate. The division includes People, HSE, Quality, Compliance, Export Control, Facility, Supply Chain, Communication and Public Affairs.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Worum geht es?

Wenn in der Schweiz eine Feuerwehr alarmiert wird, läuft die Meldung mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit über unsere Systeme. Rund 400 Feuerwehren in 16 Kantonen arbeiten mit unseren Lösungen, von der Alarmierung über die Einsatzführung bis zur Einsatzplanung.

Das heisst: Unsere Software muss funktionieren, auch nachts um 3 Uhr. Diese Verantwortung prägt, wie wir entwickeln.

Wir suchen dich als Software Engineer, der unsere Plattform mitträgt. Nicht als weitere Person im Team, sondern als eine tragende Säule in unserem Team.

Über uns

Die EvoSys AG wurde 2011 gegründet und entwickelt seit 2016 eigene Software für Behörden und Organisationen für Rettung und Sicherheit (BORS). Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen in Thun mit 9 Mitarbeitenden und in unserem Markt führend.

Unsere Produkte heissen AlarmHub, Intervento, FloriPlan, AlarmDisplay und SpotPilot. Sie decken den ganzen Ablauf ab, von der Alarmierung bis zur Auswertung nach dem Einsatz. 2028 kommt mit Respondo eine weitere Lösung dazu.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst unsere bestehenden Plattformen weiter und setzt neue Funktionen von der Idee bis in den Betrieb um.

  • Du prägst unsere Architektur mit. Unsere Kundenbasis wächst stark, und unsere Systeme müssen mitwachsen. Konkret bereiten wir den Schritt auf Kubernetes vor und bauen Dienste so um, dass sie zuverlässig skalieren.

  • Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zu Einsatzzentralen, Partnersystemen und Behördenplattformen.

  • Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge im Entwicklungsalltag ein, so wie wir alle.

  • Du nimmst an Code Reviews teil und trägst zu Qualität und Dokumentation bei.

  • Du unterstützt bei anspruchsvollen technischen Fragen aus dem Betrieb.

Perspektive

Mit der Zeit kannst du die fachliche Verantwortung für einen Produktbereich übernehmen. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, ist längerfristig auch eine technische Führungsrolle denkbar. Solche Rollen besetzen wir aus dem Team heraus. Voraussetzung für diese Stelle ist das aber ausdrücklich nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Rund 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Webanwendungen. Die ersten Jahre hast du hinter dir und arbeitest selbständig, ohne enge Begleitung.

  • Erfahrung mit Node.js und Vue.js, dazu Berührungspunkte mit PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux und Git.

  • Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich und kannst beurteilen, wann du ihrem Ergebnis trauen kannst und wann nicht.

  • Verständnis dafür, was im Produktivsystem passiert, wenn dein Code dort ankommt.

  • Lust, Verantwortung für ein Thema zu übernehmen, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englischverständnis.

  • Interesse am Blaulichtumfeld. Eigene Erfahrung in einer Feuerwehr oder im Zivilschutz ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.

Unser Technologiestack

  • Node.js, TypeScript, Vue.js

  • PostgreSQL und Redis

  • Docker - auf dem Weg zu Kubernetes

  • Linux, Git, CI/CD-Pipelines

  • REST-APIs und Schnittstellen zu Drittsystemen

  • KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Kurze Wege. Ein Standort, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsleitung. Entscheide fallen am selben Tag, nicht im nächsten Gremium.

  • Sichtbare Wirkung. Was du baust, ist innert Wochen bei Feuerwehren im Einsatz. Du bekommst Rückmeldungen von Menschen, die damit arbeiten.

  • Weiterbildung, die wir ernst meinen. Wir unterstützen berufsbegleitende Studiengänge.

  • 5 Wochen Ferien, bei Teilzeit anteilig.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz.

  • Mitgestaltung. Technologieentscheide treffen wir gemeinsam, nicht von oben herab.

  • Thun. Arbeiten zwischen See und Bergen, 10 Minuten vom Bahnhof, 20 Minuten von Bern.

Ein Hinweis mit Ehrlichkeit

Wir arbeiten überwiegend vor Ort. Einzelne Homeoffice-Tage sind möglich, reine Remote-Arbeit passt nicht zu uns. Die kurzen Abstimmungswege in der Entwicklung gehören zu unserer DNA.

Vergütung

Der Lohn für diese Stelle liegt bei CHF 68'000-80'000 pro Jahr bei einem Pensum von 100%.

So läuft die Bewerbung ab

  1. Bewerbung über die Plattform. Lebenslauf genügt, ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Links zu Projekten oder Repositories schauen wir uns gerne an.

  2. Kurzes Kennenlernen, rund 30 Minuten per Video oder Telefon.

  3. Gespräch in Thun mit dem CTO und dem Entwicklungsteam, inkl. Blick in unsere Codebasis.

  4. Fachlicher Austausch anhand einer kleinen, realistischen Aufgabe. Kein Whiteboard-Rätsel, sondern etwas aus unserem Alltag.

  5. Entscheid spätestens 7 Tage nach dem letzten Gespräch.

Wir melden uns auf jede Bewerbung zurück, auch bei einer Absage.

jobs.title: Socialsekreterare enhet vuxna mottag - inriktning våld i nära relation
jobs.description: Välkommen till Alingsås! Som medarbetare i vår kommun har du alla möjligheter att vara med och utveckla verksamheten och din arbetsplats. Med nära 4000 anställda är vi tillräckligt stora för att driva förändring och samtidigt tillräckligt små för att var och en ska kunna påverka och få utrymme för sina idéer. Här finns plats för nytänkare. Tillsammans skapar vi Alingsås!Enhet vuxna ansvarar för myndighetsutövningen för personer från 18 år som har ett skadligt bruk och beroende och samsjuklighet samt för personer med en socialpsykiatrisk problematik och personer som önskar stöd utifrån våld i nära relation. Vi ansvarar sedan nyligen även för myndighetsutövningen gällande bistånd till boende. Enhet vuxna är uppdelad i en utredargrupp och en mottagsgrupp. Enheten har många erfarna socialsekreterare och en närvarande och stödjande arbetsledning. Metodstöd sker varje vecka i grupp och du får ärendehandledning med en av våra två 1:e socialsekreterare anpassat efter ditt behov. Vi har även extern processhandledning. Vi strävar efter att vara en socialtjänst i framkant och vi ser samverkan med våra utförarenheter som en värdefull grund i vårt arbete vilket också avspeglar sig i det strukturerade utvecklingsarbete som pågår. Då vi har medarbetare som har gått vidare till andra tjänster internt hos oss söker vi nu en ny kollega i rollen som socialsekreterare i mottaget med inriktning våld i nära relation. Hos oss får du som socialsekreterare ingå i ett engagerat och sammansvetsat team där trivsel och omtanke om varandra är högt prioriterat. Du arbetar teambaserat och tvärfunktionellt, med kollegor både inom socialförvaltningen och andra delar av kommunen. Här sitter alla geografiskt nära varandra, vilket underlättar samarbete och ger dig en meningsfull och rolig arbetsvardag.När du börjar hos oss så erbjuder vi dig bland annat:    • Trygg anställning med erfaren arbetsledning     • Utbildning inom MI, ASI samt Yrkesresan skadligt bruk och beroende    • Mentorskap    • En mycket god möjlighet till att utvecklas, bidra och känna stolthet över ditt arbete    • Extra semesterdagar när du fyllt 40 och 50 år    • Föräldrapenningstillägg    • Friskvårdsbidrag och förmånliga rabatter via E-passi    • Cykelförmån    • Tillgång till arbetscyklarVi arbetar i en gammal karamellfabrik med takterass där vi kan avnjuta en härlig kaffe i solen emellanåt. Vi har en levande fikatradition där det ofta bjuds på hembakat. Kontoret ligger centralt med gång  och cykelavstånd till många möten, centralstationen och även till ett levande centrum som erbjuder restauranger, caféer och shopping. Arbetsplatsen ligger i direkt närhet till Nolhaga park som erbjuder härlig natur för lunchpromenaden. Där finns även motionsspår och utomhus gym och vi har tillgång till dusch. En större gymkedja finns i samma byggnad som vårt kontor och erbjuder förmånspris. För dig som kör bil erbjuder vi gratis parkering.Din närmsta chef: "Hej! Jag heter Jenny och är chef för socialförvaltningens enhet vuxna. Jag drivs av att vi har en hög kvalité i arbetet på enheten och för dem vi är till för. Vi ska ha en trygg arbetsmiljö där vi har rimlig arbetsbelastning och trivs tillsammans. Som chef är jag handlingskraftig, nära och tillgänglig i vår vardag och jag ser dig som en värdefull del av det viktiga arbete vi gör tillsammans. Jag ser fram emot att välkomna en ny kollega till vårt team, varmt välkommen med din ansökan!1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERSom socialsekreterare på enhet vuxna och i mottaget arbetar du med att bedriva ett kvalificerat mottagnings-, utrednings- och uppföljningsarbete för hela vår målgrupp. I mottaget hanteras skyddsbedömningar inom ramen för LVU och LVM samt risk- och skyddsbedömningar för personer utsatta för våld i nära relation. Du kommer att arbeta med helheten inom mottaget tillsammans med dina nära kollegor. Inriktningen på din tjänst kommer att vara myndighetsutövning gällande våld i nära relation, både i det akuta skedet samt i utredningsarbetet framåt.  Du arbetar självständigt men också i samverkan med kollegor och samverkanspartners, alltid med klienten i fokus.KVALIFIKATIONERKrav för tjänsten:    • Socionomexamen eller annan likvärdig utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet inom området    • B-körkort.    • Du ska behärska svenska språket väl i både tal och skrift och du tycker om att skriva.Meriterande:    • Erfarenhet av några års arbete med myndighetsutövning inom vuxenområdet eller den sociala barnavården särskilt inom området våld i nära relation.Vi söker dig som har ett genuint engagemang för vuxna inom socialtjänstens område och som drivs av att göra verklig skillnad i människors liv. Du är ansvarstagande, professionell och möter både kollegor och klienter med respekt och ett gott bemötande.Du trivs i samarbete med andra och bidrar aktivt till vårt positiva arbetsklimat, samtidigt som du har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och fatta egna beslut när situationen kräver det. Med trygghet i din yrkesroll är du flexibel och anpassningsbar i en verksamhet där förutsättningarna ibland förändras snabbt.Hos oss är samarbete en självklarhet och vi arbetar tillsammans för klientens bästa och värdesätter att du ser styrkan i lagarbete.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och söker dig som med engagemang, professionalism och omtanke vill vara med och utveckla vår verksamhet vidare.Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse .Rekrytering sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan!För att underlätta rekryteringsarbetet ber vi dig att bifoga relevanta intyg och betyg för tjänsten du söker samt vid eventuell intervju ha möjlighet att uppvisa giltig ID-handling såsom pass eller nationellt ID kort.Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du INTE söka via systemet utan kontakta ansvarig rekryterande chef för hantering av din ansökan.Vi har endast möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via Visma Recruit.
