Sales Support Defense (m/f/x)
=============================

Your responsibilities
---------------------

* You will support the Key Account Managers in maintaining customer relationships and ensuring efficient communication and follow\-up with designated Defense customers;

* You will assist in gathering and consolidating customer information, requirements and business data to support commercial activities and opportunity management;

* You will contribute to the monitoring of market developments, customer activities and competitor trends to support strategic decision\-making and business growth;

* You will support the preparation and maintenance of customer action plans, reports and commercial documentation in alignment with company objectives;

* You will coordinate and prepare customer reviews and strategic meetings to support long\-term customer relationships and business development;

* You will support bid preparation, proposal management and quotation activities by coordinating internal contributors, collecting required information and ensuring timely submissions;

* You will collaborate closely with management, product sales teams and other internal stakeholders to align customer requirements with company capabilities and priorities;

* You will support commercial reporting and sales performance tracking through data preparation, analysis and regular updates of relevant systems and tools;

* You will ensure compliance with applicable Defense, security and regulatory requirements while handling sensitive information with the highest level of professionalism and confidentiality.

Your profile
------------

* You hold a degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a comparable field.

* You have initial experience in sales support, project coordination, account management or a similar commercial environment.

* You possess initial knowledge of the Defense industry or have a strong interest in developing expertise in this field.

* You are organized, detail\-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

* You possess strong communication and interpersonal skills and enjoy collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders.

* You have a customer\-oriented mindset and take a proactive approach to supporting business activities.

* You demonstrate discretion and professionalism when handling confidential and sensitive information.

* You are fluent in English and German; French is considered an asset.

Our offer
---------

Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family\-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us.

 

In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email.

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sina WAUSCHKUHN.

**One Passion. Many Opportunities.**

The company
-----------

​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace.

Key Account Manager (f/m/x)
===========================

Your Responsibilities
---------------------

* You will drive business growth by identifying, qualifying, and converting new sales opportunities across assigned markets and key accounts
* You will develop and maintain long\-term customer relationships, ensuring high customer satisfaction, retention, and sustainable business growth
* You will prepare and present technical and commercial proposals, tenders and quotations, lead contract negotiations, and manage sales opportunities throughout the entire sales cycle
* You will define and execute the territory sales strategy, ensuring the achievement of sales, profitability, and growth targets
* You will manage and develop a strong sales pipeline, maintain CRM transparency, and ensure accurate forecasting and opportunity tracking
* You will promote aftermarket solutions and services, including spare parts, maintenance, LTSA business, overhauls, upgrades, retrofits, and digital services in collaboration with the Aftermarket Business Development Manager
* You will analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive activities to identify new business opportunities and support strategic decision\-making
* You will foster cross\-functional collaboration to ensure seamless project execution, successful customer handovers, and equipment reliability


Your Profile
------------

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering Business Administration, or an equivalent commercial or technical qualification with relevant professional experience
* You have proven experience in the diesel and gas engine business, combined with strong market knowledge about the energy sector
* You bring extensive experience in sales, key account management, and the successful delivery of complex commercial and technical projects
* You possess advanced negotiation and contract management skills, enabling you to successfully manage complex commercial agreements and customer relationships
* You demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders and foster alignment across functions
* You build strong and trusting relationships with customers and stakeholders through active listening, clear communication, and constructive feedback
* You proactively take ownership of initiatives, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive solutions to successful outcomes
* You are fluent in English and German; French language skills is considered an asset


Our Offer
---------

Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family\-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us.

In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email.

*This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent.*

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sylvain STUDER.

**One Passion. Many Opportunities.**

The company
-----------

​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace.

jobs.title: Head of Footwear Development - Football
jobs.description: In short- Based at our Zurich HQ, you will be the visionary force and executive technical leader driving On’s entry and dominance in Football footwear. In this pivotal role, you will champion groundbreaking creation, build a world-class team, and fearlessly disrupt traditional manufacturing processes to engineer the most premium, disruptive performance products in the industry.- As Head of Football Footwear Development, you will seamlessly connect the granular with the macro-strategic—serving as the ultimate technical authority while shaping the long-term vision for On’s newest and most critical category. By ensuring absolute synergy between radical design vision, elite biomechanical performance, and next-generation manufacturing feasibility, you will set the benchmark for football footwear creation. You will provide the technical governance, cross-functional leadership, and pioneering strategy needed to build our football department from the ground up, driving innovation straight into our inline product strategy while scaling the category globally.- This role reports directly to the Head of Innovation Footwear, leading the dedicated Zurich-based Football Development team and partnering closely with global footwear leadership.Your Mission- Strategic & Disruptive Leadership: Define and execute the overarching technical and development strategy for Football footwear. Pioneer the adoption of agile, disruptive manufacturing methods and next-generation tooling to bypass traditional constraints.- Inline Innovation Engine: Drive category-defining innovation directly from the inline development process, elevating brand equity, performance standards, and technological capabilities across the broader organization.- Technical & Category Governance: Serve as the final technical authority during briefing, design, and execution phases—ensuring football-specific demands (traction, stud configuration, upper lockdown, ball feel, and touch) meet rigorous scientific standards.- Strategic Global Synchronization: Lead high-level alignment between Zurich-based Design, Product Management, Biomechanics, and Asia-based development and manufacturing partners, safeguarding the performance "soul" of the football category across all franchises.- Team Building & Talent Empowerment: Build, mentor, and scale a elite team of developers and engineers, inspiring a culture of relentless curiosity, technical rigor, and hands-on experimentation.- Manufacturing & Supply Chain Evolution: Identify technical bottlenecks and transform global supply chain capabilities by partnering with tier-1 suppliers and novel manufacturing vendors to enable quick-turn, high-agility production.- Elite Performance & Quality Assurance: Establish and oversee category-wide validation benchmarks for fit, feel, traction, energy return, and long-term durability across all factory partners.Your Story- Experience: 10–15+ years of deep expertise in footwear development, with a proven track record specifically within high-performance Football (Soccer) footwear.- Disruptive Mindset: Highly adaptable with demonstrated experience implementing unconventional, agile, or disruptive manufacturing methods (e.g., advanced automation, additive manufacturing, 3D/textile innovation, automated bonding).- Proven Executive Leadership: Experience building, leading, and mentoring technical teams, with the executive presence to influence product management, design, and external partners at the highest levels.- Deep Domain Mastery: Comprehensive understanding of football-specific biomechanics, plate dynamics, stud pressure distribution, specialized last development, and upper material behavior under match conditions.- Systemic & Commercial Vision: Exceptional ability to balance high-risk/high-reward innovation with commercial viability and global supply chain scalability.- Collaborative & Culturally Agile: A natural bridge builder capable of translating creative vision into technical reality across diverse, multi-regional teams (HQ to Asia execution).- Communication: Fluency in English (verbal and written) with exceptional consultative and strategic presentation skills.Attributes of a successful candidate:- The Master Craftsman & Innovator: Deeply knowledgeable in football footwear heritage, yet obsessed with tearing down old rules to build radical new systems.- The Visionary Architect: Focuses on both the "how" and the "where next," ensuring the football category’s technical roadmap pushes the limits of physics and athlete capability.- The System Disrupter: Thrives on agility—able to pivot quickly, challenge traditional manufacturing timelines, and integrate cutting-edge concepts into inline production.Your Team- You will lead the Zurich-based Football Footwear Development team.- We are an innovative, creative, and science-driven team dedicated to converting cutting-edge ideas into high-performance footwear. Driven by constant curiosity and an unrelenting ambition, we are a collective built to disrupt: constantly breaking the system only to rebuild it as the most innovative brand in football.- In Zurich, our team acts as the primary link between Biomechanical Research, Material Science, Design, and Sourcing, ensuring that every innovation is grounded in technical reality before it reaches the pitch. Our team combines deep expertise in engineering, development, and product management to create gear that meets rigorous scientific and technical standards. We foster a hands-on, highly collaborative environment where experts work alongside the very best in their respective fields.- United by a shared obsession with excellence, we will never stop on our quest to redefine the game and create the world’s best football products, time and time again. As the Head of this team, you will lead this high-performance heart of the category, ensuring our technical standards and performance identity remain uncompromised as we expand.

jobs.title: Head of Product Brand, Performance Running
jobs.description: In ShortOn has the ambition to become the leading global running brand. In this role, you will directly contribute to defining and realizing that vision. You will own the business strategy for a premier portfolio of Product Franchises, driving commercial objectives while elevating On's brand credibility within the running community.You will work at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Commercial, and Athlete strategies to ensure we deliver exceptional experiences to runners and retail partners alike.Your Mission- Strategic Leadership: Leading a cross-functional team of experts across Product, Marketing, Commercial, and Athlete strategy teams to define and execute a category plan that establishes On as the world’s leading running brand.- Commercial Ownership: Own the business plan and financial targets for a dedicated footwear portfolio, leading different franchises.- Business Performance: Drive franchise growth, track financial targets, and regularly communicate performance metrics and actionable insights to key stakeholders in business reviews (e.g., MBR, QBR)- Product Alignment: Lead the product vision and positioning with Product Management to optimize the product tree, deploying a deep understanding of the underlying consumer segments to maximize reach while ensuring efficiency and sustainable product lifecycles.- Brand Storytelling: Partner with Marketing Strategy to craft inspiring franchise narratives that resonate deeply with runners, and work with Apparel/Accessories teams to build cohesive, head-to-toe consumer stories.- Commercial & Regional Strategy: Align with Commercial teams and regional merchandisers to deliver optimal product assortments across diverse distribution channels, adapting franchise personalities to regional needs.- Omnichannel Experience: Partner with DTC (Retail and Digital) to provide premium, seamless experiences for runners exploring your franchises.- Community & Influence: Collaborate with Athlete Strategy and Global Partnerships to amplify brand credibility, and cultivate strong relationships with running communities to enhance cultural relevance.- Go-To-Market Excellence: Lead process excellence across the product creation calendar and GTM strategy, ensuring deadlines are met for the sales† season.Retail Presentation: Represent the brand at strategic key account previews, pre-lines, and sell-in events.- Operational Management: Maintain key product documents, tools, and communications for the product strategy pod with a high level of attention to detail.Your Story- Experience: 8+ years of experience in brand management, go-to-market (GTM), product management, or strategy ideally within the running or sportswear industry.- Market Expertise: Deep understanding of the global running market, with the ability to interpret consumer insights across both sports performance and fashion products.- Leadership & Influence: Strong presentation and interpersonal skills, with a proven track record of influencing and leading cross-functional teams. Ability to engage across the spectrum of the organization, including senior leadership. - Mindset: Highly independent, solution-oriented, and driven by a positive, proactive work ethic.- Skills: Strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and a quick adaptability to new systems.- Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. - Travel: Ability to travel both domestically and internationally as required.Your TeamAs the Product Strategy team, we’re responsible for managing product creation to facilitate go to market efforts; concept to consumer. Our cross functional interaction is driven by a consumer-focused mindset to ensure we create a product line that sells in and through.What We OfferOn is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

System Identification Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Paris, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

 

Responsibilities

  • Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

  • Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

  • Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

  • Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

  • Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

  • New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

  • Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

  • System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

  • Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

  • Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

  • Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

Nice to have

  • Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

  • Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

  • Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

  • Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Drone System Reliability Technician and Pilot
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Drone System Validation Technician and Pilot, you will be at the front line of our quality, safety, and reliability efforts. Your primary mission is to ensure that our defense-grade products meet rigorous operational standards before they are cleared for active duty.

Working within a dedicated flight testing team, you will manage, prepare, and operate fleets of newly assembled drones or related product during intensive field validation campaigns. By logging massive operating hours, you will actively hunt for rare, hard-to-replicate system bugs and edge-case anomalies. We are looking for operators who combine rigorous testing discipline with the hands-on piloting expertise required to accurately assess and validate nominal drone behavior in flight. Your technical feedback will directly enable our engineering teams to secure and polish our next-generation defense systems.

 

Responsibilities

  • Intensive Flight Testing: Conduct high-volume flight testing of newly assembled interceptors to log hours, validate systems, and actively hunt for rare, intermittent flight anomalies.

  • Aviation Performance Assessment: Manually operate, stress-test, and critically evaluate the flight dynamics of various platforms (multirotors, fixed-wing, flying wings, and RC planes) to ensure they handle exactly as designed.

  • Field Deployment: Lead and execute demanding on-site flight missions, sometimes lasting several weeks, under diverse weather and environmental conditions.

  • Mission Safety & Logs: Rigorously follow test checklists, maintain safety protocols during high-throughput flight operations, and accurately report flight observations to the engineering, production and industrialisation teams.

Candidate Requirements

  • Good RC/UAV Piloting Skills: You have extensive hands-on experience piloting RC planes, flying wings, or multirotor UAVs. Manual piloting dexterity and a deep instinct for flight mechanics are the absolute priorities for this role.

  • Rigor & Endurance: Strong discipline to run repetitive, structured test cycles with consistent attention to detail and unwavering focus on safety.

  • Adaptable Mindset: You thrive in fast-paced, lean startup environments where initiative, quick decision-making, and teamwork are valued over rigid hierarchy.

  • Field-Ready & Mobile: You possess a valid driver’s license (Permis B) and are ready to drive team vehicles, transport flight gear/drones. You are looking for a highly active, hands-on role where you will be out in the field on a daily basis, all year round.

  • Technical background: Any technical degree or professional experience in electronics, RC modeling, mechanics, or aeronautics is a great plus, but passionate self-taught pilots are highly encouraged to apply.

  • Basic Technical English: Capable of understanding technical guidelines and writing flight reports in English.

Nice-to-have

  • Certifications & FPV: Official drone pilot certifications, instructor ratings, or solid FPV (First Person View) racing/freestyle experience.

  • Military or Field Background: Past experience in specialized military units or demanding field-oriented professions.

  • Basic data/technical literacy: a basic grasp of autopilot systems, telemetry or flight-log reading, to help bridge the field and R&D. This is what turns an operator into a genuine validator, and is worth probing even if not required.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: AI & Automation Lead (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. We enable everyone to be an investor.

lemon.markets builds infrastructure for financial services and technology companies powering the next generation of investment products. From enabling a FinTech to launch their first investment product, over allowing e.g. a Neobank to embed investing into their product to bringing investing into a completely new context. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months.

We have experienced first hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that we make investing more accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional (& diverse) people like you.

Your Mission:

As AI & Automation Lead, you will establish and lead lemon.markets’ first dedicated AI function, making AI a safe, practical and measurable part of how the whole company works. Reporting directly to the VP Engineering and operating across the first line, you will identify high-value opportunities across Engineering, Finance, Operations, Compliance, Product, Sales, Partner Management and People and turn them into solutions that improve efficiency without compromising quality or control.

You will build on the foundations already being established, including a governed AI platform, an inventory of current use cases and an initial risk assessment aligned with the EU AI Act. A key part of your role will be creating the standards, measurement framework and decision processes that determine which use cases are scaled, improved or stopped.

Working closely with Engineering, Finance, Risk Management and Compliance, you will balance innovation with data protection, operational resilience, cost discipline and regulatory expectations. This is your opportunity to shape how a regulated financial company adopts AI responsibly, while building a function that leaves lasting capability across the organisation.

In this role you will

  • Lead the AI function and work with department heads across lemon.markets to identify, prioritise and deliver use cases that create measurable business value beyond Engineering.

  • Build a transparent, evidence-based portfolio of AI initiatives with business owners, baselines, success metrics and appropriate guardrails, ensuring that promising ideas become sustainable improvements.

  • Enable teams across the company to use AI effectively themselves by developing practical workflows, guidance and capabilities that reduce manual effort without creating dependency on the AI function.

  • Set the standards for our governed AI platform with Engineering, including model selection, evaluation, access controls, data protection, human approval points and reliable fallback processes.

  • Partner with Risk Management, Compliance and Finance to ensure AI use cases meet regulatory expectations, remain within agreed risk and cost boundaries, and receive the appropriate independent review and sign-off.

  • Establish a measurement framework that connects efficiency gains to quality, risk and customer outcomes, enabling clear decisions about when to scale, improve or stop an initiative.

  • Lead and grow a team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists, setting priorities and using demonstrated demand and measurable impact to guide future investment.

You’ll be successful in this role if

  • You have shipped applied AI or data solutions into production and managed use cases from discovery through implementation, measurement and improvement.

  • You have driven adoption beyond Engineering, helping teams such as Finance, Operations, Compliance, Sales or Product improve how they work.

  • You have experience in a regulated or highly controlled environment and understand the importance of governance, independent scrutiny and clear lines of responsibility.

  • You are rigorous about measurement, establishing baselines, defining quality guardrails and assessing the full impact of a solution before scaling it.

  • You understand the economics of AI, including inference costs, model routing, evaluation and the difference between an assistant and an autonomous workflow.

  • You are technically credible and hands-on enough to work effectively with engineers, with a working understanding of topics such as retrieval, access controls, evaluation and AI security risks.

  • You take ownership and communicate clearly, challenging assumptions, stopping initiatives when the evidence does not support them and building trust with senior stakeholders and control functions.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and change, and enjoy building a new function while balancing practical delivery with long-term standards.

  • You are fluent in English. Knowledge of German is a major advantage given our regulatory environment and our parent company.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As a Product Manager in the Investing domain, you will contribute to the product scope our largest partners depend on, as well as our side of the joint dwpbank x lemon.markets suite. Your remit will include working with some of the biggest financial institutions in Europe to deliver core capabilities. These include trading mechanics, tax, corporate actions, and the investing capabilities we're building jointly with dwpbank. You will scope them, prioritise them, and deliver them.

Reporting to the Senior Product Manager, Investing, you'll drive complex, multi-stakeholder commitments end-to-end. You'll work across internal teams at lemon.markets, our largest partners, and dwpbank counterparts in the group. Success looks like partners shipping compliant products on our infrastructure without us being the bottleneck.

In this role you will:

  • Own the roadmap for a set of partner-critical Investing capabilities, from problem framing through to launch, adoption, and iteration.

  • Be embedded in a cross-functional crew including operations and engineering, while engaging with other product teams, solutions engineering, external partners, and colleagues in risk, finance, and compliance.

  • Prioritise commitments against the domain strategy using quantitative and qualitative evidence, and share your trade-offs internally and externally.

  • Ensure that any partner-specific integrations have longevity within our platform.

  • Engage directly with enterprise partners and prospects - scope requirements, negotiate delivery, prioritise.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance. Beyond the plant itself, you will help develop innovative grid-facing capabilities and online services, exploring new ways for power generation assets to create value through advanced connectivity, flexibility, and participation in the evolving energy ecosystem.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define and develop the plant's electrical architecture, ensuring reliable and efficient operation across diverse electrical loads and systems.

  • Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments.

  • Specify and oversee the integration of electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and power conversion technologies.

  • Establish monitoring, diagnostics, and condition-based maintenance approaches to improve asset reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

  • Develop predictive maintenance frameworks using operational and equipment health data.

  • Evaluate and develop opportunities for advanced grid services, including flexibility, ancillary services, demand response, and other emerging market offerings.

  • Explore innovative digital and online services that can enhance plant performance, operational visibility, and value creation within future energy systems.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science or equivalent

  • You have a strong background in electrical engineering, control systems, or a related field, with hands-on experience in industrial environments

  • You are adaptable and motivated to grow with evolving technologies and increasing system complexity

  • Experience in grid integration, or electrical infrastructure for industrial, utility-scale, or energy-related facilities is a plus

  • Knowledge of reactive power compensation is a plus

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. jobs.title: Endear - Product Designer
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Systems Architect - Workday
jobs.description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

  • Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

jobs.title: Senior Fleet Manager
jobs.description:
Ben jij een vooruitdenker die complexe data moeiteloos vertaalt naar glashelder advies? Neem jij van nature de regie, ben je sterk in stakeholdermanagement en heb je affiniteit met de dynamische wereld van Schiphol? Lees dan snel verder!

Binnen Orion Fleet Management zijn we op zoek naar een proactieve Senior Fleet Manager met een specifieke focus op onze klant Schiphol en ons label AirportPartners. Waar een reguliere Fleet Manager sterk leunt op de dagelijkse operatie, sta jij als Senior Fleet Manager daarboven. Jij kijkt verder dan de waan van de dag, anticipeert op wat komen gaat en gebruikt keiharde data om onze klant op strategisch niveau te adviseren.

Wat ga je doen?

In de rol van Senior Fleet Manager ben jij de absolute eigenaar van de vlootbeschikbaarheid voor Schiphol. Met ons label AirportPartners beheren wij hier de unieke en bedrijfskritische vloot van Schiphol: van de brandweerwagens en de onmisbare sneeuwvloot tot de personenwagens van het KLM-personeel. Jouw werk draait niet om achteraf reageren, maar om proactief sturen. Omdat jij de operationele basis feilloos begrijpt en beheerst, kun jij de vertaalslag maken naar optimalisatie en strategisch partnership. 

Jouw takenpakket als Senior Fleet Manager bestaat uit de volgende pijlers:

Datagedreven Regie & Strategie:

  • Proactieve advisering: Je wacht niet tot de klant belt met een probleem, maar je adviseert hen ongevraagd over rendementsverbetering en risicobeperking op basis van jouw data-analyses;

  • Datagedreven regie: Je gebruikt voorspellende data om de vloot optimaal in te zetten en stilstand te minimaliseren. Vooruitdenken is jouw tweede natuur;

  • Bewaking van SLA’s en KPI’s: Je monitort continu de prestaties, stuurt bij waar nodig en garandeert dat we onze beloftes aan de klant waarmaken (of overtreffen);

  • Rapportage en overleg: Je zit regelmatig aan tafel met het management van klanten en leveranciers. Je presenteert heldere rapportages en treedt op als een volwaardig en strategisch gesprekspartner.

Operationele Excellentie:

Om op strategisch niveau te kunnen adviseren, zorg jij dat de basisprocessen, de motor van de afdeling, vlekkeloos verlopen:

  • Triage en analyse: Je overziet de storingsmeldingen en zorgt voor een feilloze initiële beoordeling.

  • Slimme planning: Je overziet de planning van (preventief) onderhoud, altijd met de impact op de 24/7 luchthaven operatie en veiligheid op Schiphol in je achterhoofd;

  • Toetsing en beoordeling: Je beoordeelt complexe reparatie aanvragen kritisch op basis van historie, vastgelegde afspraken en toekomstige inzet van het voertuig;

Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor de rol van Senior Fleet Manager zoeken we iemand die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat. Je overziet het grote geheel, maar snapt de details die de data beïnvloeden. Verder zien wij graag het volgende terug:

  • Denkniveau: Je beschikt over HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Sterk analytisch: Je bent een kei in het analyseren van data en haalt hier moeiteloos de juiste conclusies en actiepunten uit;

  • Proactieve mindset: Je wacht niet af, maar signaleert kansen en knelpunten voordat ze een probleem vormen;

  • Kennis & Ervaring: Je snapt hoe onderhoudsprocessen (triage, MTTR, MTBF) werken. Ervaring als Fleet Manager is een must en ervaring in de automotive of specifiek de OV-sector (bussen) is een zware pré;

  • Overtuigingskracht: Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden. Je kunt draagvlak creëren en complexe technische of data-gerelateerde zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen aan directie, klanten en leveranciers.

Ben jij klaar voor deze stap als Senior Fleet Manager en wil je bouwen aan de toekomst van ons wagenparkbeheer op Schiphol? Druk dan snel op de sollicitatieknop en laat jouw cv en motivatie achter!

Wat bieden wij

Een leuke en uitdagende baan met veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Je komt te werken in een professionele en stabiele kantooromgeving. Orion is een sterk groeiend bedrijf binnen de Pon-onderneming en biedt doorgroeimogelijkheden in de toekomst.

Wat bieden we nog meer voor de functie van Senior Fleet Manager:

  • Een goed salaris tussen de € 4.579,- en € 6.538,- o.b.v. fulltime. Uiteraard is dit afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 28 vakantiedagen* en 6 ADV dagen;

  • Een individueel keuzebudget (o.a. te besteden voor het aankopen van verlof);

  • Directe en korte lijnen; je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Operations;

  • De mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken;

  • Een enthousiast, gezellig, compact en ambitieus team;

  • Een ruime Pon-pensioenregeling;

  • Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis waarbij Pon €300 per jaar bijdraagt;

  • Pon Fit: sportieve activiteiten waar je aan kan deelnemen! Van bootcamp tot golfclinic;

  • Korting op eigen producten van Pon (bijv. een nieuwe Gazelle fiets of privé lease auto), €500 per jaar;

  • Lease-a-bike regeling voor het leasen van een Pon-fiets.

Over de organisatie

Orion ontzorgt bedrijven met grote complexe wagenparken door het reparatie- en onderhoudsproces optimaal te structureren.

Binnen het netwerk heeft Orion een 15-tal eigen werkplaatsen onder de labels: AirportPartners, BusPartners en WastePartners. Onze werkplaatsen zijn gevestigd in: Almere, Amersfoort, Badhoevedorp-Schiphol (2 locaties), Ede, Emmeloord, Helmond, Leeuwarden, Leiden, Lichtenvoorde, Middelburg, Montfoort, Oosterwolde, Utrecht en Zwolle. Deze vacature is gericht op ons hoofdkantoor in Barneveld!

Met circa 250 collega’s zetten wij ons dagelijks in om ervoor te zorgen dat onder andere huis en bedrijfsafval opgehaald kunnen worden, vliegtuigen kunnen blijven opstijgen en landen en OV-reizigers in veilige en betrouwbare bussen kunnen reizen. Wij staan midden in de maatschappij en spelen in op trends als verstedelijking, elektrificatie, duurzaamheid en digitalisering. 

Iedereen is welkom !

Bij Orion en Pon maken de mensen het verschil. Wij geloven dat een diverse en inclusieve organisatie zorgt voor meer werkplezier, creativiteit en betere resultaten. Welke achtergrond, leeftijd of identiteit je ook meebrengt: als jij de motivatie en het talent hebt, horen we heel graag van je.

About us

Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable teams to capture, automate, and integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations. 

We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle.

We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2026 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board!

About the role

We're looking for an exceptional Go-To-Market Associate who will be the engine of our commercial team. As part of the top 1% of Commercial talents globally, you'll combine systematic prospecting with creative outreach to build relationships with decision-makers who need AI solutions.

This is not a classic sales role. We're looking for a builder with a commercial brain and an enormous drive, someone who combines hustle, strategic creativity, and genuine curiosity about what makes businesses tick.

You might come from a classic sales background, or you might have built your commercial instincts in a completely different arena. What matters far more than your CV is your drive, your entrepreneurial instinct, and the kind of work ethic that makes people wonder how you get so much done.

In a single day you might: map a new industry vertical for outreach opportunities, run a consultative discovery call with a Head of Operations at a manufacturing company, develop a proposal for a new channel, follow up on an active deal in scoping, and draft a business case for entering a completely new market.

You won't have a large team behind you. You will have full autonomy, meaningful equity, direct access to the founding team, and the freedom to experiment with what works.

Why Lleverage?

  • Change the world, literally: 2026 is the year AI works, and Lleverage.ai has the best AI platform (according to industry veterans)

  • Work, learn, have fun: You'll be part of a top-notch commercial team that operates at the highest level of performance

  • Build a unique network: Connect with decision-makers and operational leaders across traditional industries who are eager to implement AI solutions

  • Get autonomy & ownership: Design your own strategies and own your pipeline development

  • Compensation: We pay top of market cash and equity, with compensation tied to the pipeline value you create

Responsibilities

  • Own our top of funnel: which segments we go after, how we reach the COOs and CFOs of manufacturers and distributors, and how many qualified opportunities land in the pipeline every week. That's your number.

  • Sit in on live deals from day one: discovery calls, account plans, proposals and PoC scoping with our delivery team. Within 6 to 12 months you run your first deals yourself.

  • Build the playbook with the GTM lead and CCO: positioning per sector, messaging per persona, pricing experiments, the business cases we win with.

  • Run experiments across the whole funnel: outbound campaigns, events, partnerships with ERP partners and PE firms, LinkedIn content. Measure everything, scale what works.

  • Use AI-native tooling (Clay, lemlist, our own agents) to research, personalise and scale what a team of five used to do by hand, and help us figure out what GTM looks like when AI does the grunt work.

En tant qu'Ingénieur Hydrogéologue, vous piloterez des projets d'aménagement et de gestion des eaux souterraines, de l'étude initiale à la présentation des résultats pour tous types de projets (espaces publics, bâtiments industriels, tertiaires, résidentiels, ouvrages souterrains, etc.).   • Rédiger des rapports techniques et présenter vos conclusions aux équipes de projets (MOA/MOE/AMO) et autorités (DREAL, DDT(M)).

  • Travailler en synergie avec les expertises du Groupe (géotechniques, environnementales, géophysiques, …) pour proposer des offres complètes et identifier de nouvelles opportunités.

jobs.title: Chef de produit digital F/H
jobs.description:
LIANAKA est une filiale du Groupe Fondasol, spécialiste de l’ingénierie conseil de la construction.

Allier le meilleur des données de sols, de l’IA et de l’analyse humaine dans une plateforme technologiquement avancée, pour permettre aux porteurs de projets de construction d’anticiper les risques et de saisir les opportunités liées à l'environnement des sites de leurs projets : tel est l’engagement de LIANAKA.

Dès la recherche foncière, notre plateforme délivre aux acteurs de la construction un accès direct à une information globale, qualifiée et synthétique des risques et opportunités du sous-sol.

Chaque phase du projet est également l’opportunité d’optimiser les hypothèses techniques et les solutions de travaux.

Les bénéfices directs pour nos clients? Une fiabilité des données du sous-sol optimisée, sur les critères eau, pollution des sols, géotechnique et géothermie. Une meilleure anticipation et maitrise de leurs projets. Des décisions prises plus rapidement. Une identification immédiate des gains financiers. Une contribution à l’empreinte environnementale des projets. Le tout dans un environnement digital convivial et agile. 

Soyez le pivot stratégique de notre transformation numérique : entre expertise technique et performance commerciale, portez le succès d'une solution SaaS qui révolutionne l'analyse des risques de la construction.

Le Projet

Dans le cadre de notre développement numérique, le Groupe FONDASOL a déployé une plateforme SaaS innovante LIANAKA dédiée à la modélisation et l’analyse des risques du sous-sol. Elle offre aux acteurs de la construction une information fiable, rapide et optimisée en amont de leurs projets.

Vos missions

En tant que Chef de Produit, vous êtes le chef d'orchestre de cette solution et votre rôle est transverse :

  1. Comprendre le terrain et l'attente de nos clients

  2. Piloter la technique et l'évolution de la plateforme

  3. Booster le business et la commercialisation de cet outil

Rattaché à la Direction Commerciale et sous la responsabilité du Responsable de la Filiale Digitale, vous êtes au cœur de notre stratégie de croissance et de transformation digitale.

  • Vous recueillez et analysez les besoins clients : compréhension des usages et contraintes des promoteurs, entreprises de TP, collectivités, aménageurs fonciers, ou tout acteur ayant besoin d’anticiper les risques liés au sous-sol dans ses projets

  • Vous transformez les besoins utilisateurs en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et tranchez sur les fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée

  • Vous portez la vision et la roadmap de la plateforme Saas et pilotez l’évolution du produit de la conception au déploiement

  • Vous travaillez main dans la main avec les équipes techniques (Dev, Data, IT, ect.) et garantissez l’adéquation parfaite entre les contraintes techniques et les objectifs business

  • Vous pilotez la croissance du produit en contribuant à sa stratégie commerciale et aux argumentaires commerciaux, tout en accompagnant les équipes marketing et ventes dans le lancement des nouveautés et l'optimisation des performances via le suivi des KPI (adoption, usages, ventes, satisfaction client).

  • Vous êtes le trait d’union entre les clients, les équipes techniques et commerciales

  • Vous sensibilisez les équipes interne aux enjeux du digital tout en étant force de proposition pour optimiser les processus et l’expérience utilisateur.

Ce que nous vous offrons ?

  • La possibilité de participer à la création et au déploiement d’un produit numérique innovant à fort impact

  • Être au cœur de la transformation digitale du Groupe

  • Travailler sur des enjeux concrets liés à l’aménagement du territoire et à la gestion des risques

  • Bénéficier d’une forte autonomie et d’un rôle stratégique dans le développement du produit


Votre profil

  • Issu d'une formation Bac+5 (Ingénieur, Commerce ou Université) avec une spécialisation en digital ou innovation

  • Vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée de 3 à 7 ans en tant que Product Manager, idéalement sur un produit SaaS.

  • Curieux, rigoureux et attiré par l'innovation à fort impact terrain, vous disposez idéalement d'une connaissance du secteur de la construction, du BTP ou de l'aménagement.

  • Doté d'un fort esprit entrepreneurial et d'une grande autonomie, vous maîtrisez le pilotage de produits numériques (roadmap, MVP, itérations) et possédez une réelle capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques ou data complexes.

Les qualités qui feront votre réussite

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne avenante, communicante et orientée terrain. Vous aimez aller à la rencontre des clients, comprendre leurs enjeux et créer du lien avec des interlocuteurs variés.

jobs.title: Senior adviseur ecologie (Den Bosch)
jobs.description:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Met jouw ecologische expertise geef je richting aan de bescherming en versterking van natuur binnen uiteenlopende projecten. Je borgt kwaliteit, brengt ecologie strategisch in en zorgt dat natuur volwaardig wordt meegenomen in ontwerp- en besluitvorming.

Je schakelt intensief met verschillende stakeholders en bent van begin tot eind betrokken bij projecten. Je adviseert over vraagstukken rondom beschermde gebieden (waaronder stikstof), houtopstanden en (zeldzame) beschermde soorten, zoals zandhagedis, rugstreeppad, vuursalamander, das en bever;

  • een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het begeleiden van junioren en medioren. Je ondersteunt hen in projecten, bespreekt resultaten, bewaakt de kwaliteit van rapportages en stimuleert hun inhoudelijke groei. Je draagt bij aan de verdere opbouw van kennis in het team en helpt om ecologie stevig te verankeren binnen integrale projectteams;

  • de projecten waar je aan werkt zijn divers: van damwandvervanging in stedelijke parken tot spoorvernieuwingen door het hele land en de renovatie van bruggen in grote steden. Jij brengt ecologie op een natuurlijke manier in als volwaardig onderdeel van het ontwerp- en besluitvormingsproces. Daarnaast kijk je altijd verder dan de wettelijke eisen en onderzoek je hoe projecten extra natuurwaarde kunnen creëren. Dat vertaal je naar concrete maatregelen, zoals faunapassages, wadi’s of groene gevels;

  • rapportages, ecologische beoordelingen en stikstofonderbouwingen behoren tot je vaste werkzaamheden. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in de kwaliteitsborging binnen het team en binnen de projecten waarin je meedraait;

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

jobs.title: Ontwikkelaar vastgoed
jobs.description:
Wil jij bouwen aan de vastgoedopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als ervaren ontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na acquisitie en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting verkoop en realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met adviseurs én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

 

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na acquisitie / tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de het ontwikkelteam om projecten succesvol verder te brengen.

 

Wat ga je doen
De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen of een acquisitie is verworven en projecten daadwerkelijk ontwikkeld gaan worden. Je werkt aan (middel)grote vastgoedontwikkelingen en ben je de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het uitwerken van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

·       Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning/acquisitie, naar omgevingsvergunning tot aan de start van de verkoop;

·       Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces;

·       Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

·       Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

·       Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

·       Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

·       Je werkt nauw samen met makelaars, verkoopmanagers en notarissen om projecten succesvol in verkoop te brengen;

·       Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

·       Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


Dit breng jij mee

·       Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar;

·       Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

·       Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen;

·       Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe projecten;

·       Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten;

·       Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie.

Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt om projecten na tendergunning/acquisitie verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je komt het beste tot je recht wanneer met alle betrokken partijen, de complexe projecten succesvol weet te ontwikkelen én realiseren.
