jobs.title: Data Center Technician
jobs.description: AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.We are looking for Data Center Technicians to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Technicians are the primary resolver and troubleshoot and solve a range of datacenter infrastructure issues including, but not limited to: hardware, fiber, networking, and related problems. You will be part of the Data Center Operations (DCO) team, overseeing the operation and maintenance of the IT infrastructure and hardware for data centers in AWS Cloud regions. You will become the primary resolver for your support team, and gain troubleshooting skills on different hardware and software cases. You will be able to troubleshoot and solve most infrastructure issues and engage other appropriate solutions groups on more complex problems to drive solutions..Key job responsibilities• SAFETYFollow and maintain the highest safety standards and diligently encourage a world-class safety culture. Own the safety initiatives and projects to foster a strong safety culture.• DATA CENTER OPERATIONS (DCO)This position involves:    Diagnosing hardware and network problems followed by physical repairs    Troubleshooting events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)    Performing root cause analysis of equipment failures    Manual handling and lifting of equipment may be required (weight limits in accordance with regulations)    Working rotating shifts (morning/night) as well as weekends to maintain the 24/7 data center environment    A valid (EU) driving license is required as Data Centers may not have any public transportation available nearby.Location Requirements:Our data centers are located in remote areas where access via public transport may be limited. Therefore, a valid EU driving license is required for this role.Work Schedule:This is a 100% onsite in-person position due to the hands-on nature of managing mission-critical infrastructure and data center industry.A day in the lifeIn this role, you'll be working on our advanced ticketing system, managing a diverse workload and solving complex server hardware issues.You'll be part of a collaborative team that keeps our cloud infrastructure running smoothly, responding to both automated directives and team leadership with exceptional time management and adaptability.Your expertise in problem ticket tracking and escalation procedures will be crucial as you consistently meet and exceed Amazon's high standards for technical proficiency and operational excellence. This role is vital in maintaining the efficiency and reliability of our sophisticated data center infrastructure – you'll be working and supporting the face of Cloud technology in the region.We're looking for skilled technicians with a passion for technology to help us expand our Cloud to the next level.About the teamDiverse ExperiencesAWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.Why AWS?Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.Inclusive Team CultureAWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.Mentorship & Career GrowthWe’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.Work/Life BalanceWe value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

jobs.title: HR Consultant
jobs.description:
De functie

Als HR Consultant zorg je ervoor dat de dagelijkse HR-processen binnen Interconnect soepel en zorgvuldig verlopen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een correcte personeelsadministratie, bewaakt de kwaliteit van HR-processen en ondersteunt leidinggevenden en medewerkers bij uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je werkt aan verschillende onderdelen van de employee journey, waaronder in-, door- en uitstroom, verzuimadministratie, personeelsmutaties en werving & selectie. Daarnaast denk je actief mee over het verbeteren van processen en het verder professionaliseren van de HR-dienstverlening.

Je maakt deel uit van een betrokken HR-team, bestaande uit een HR Teamlead, HR Business Partner en HR-medewerker. Het team valt onder de afdeling Business Support.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Beheren en bewaken van de kwaliteit en volledigheid van personeelsdossiers.
  • Verwerken en controleren van personeelsgegevens in HR-systemen, waaronder Nmbrs.
  • Ondersteunen bij de salarisverwerking en uitvoeren van administratieve controles.
  • Adviseren over personeelsregelingen, arbeidsvoorwaarden en HR-procedures.
  • Beantwoorden van HR-gerelateerde vragen van leidinggevenden en medewerkers.
  • Verzorgen van administratieve processen rondom in-, door- en uitstroom en verzuim.
  • Bijdragen aan HR-projecten en de realisatie van HR-doelstellingen.
  • Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden en optimaliseren van HR-processen en werkwijzen.

Wie ben jij?

Je houdt van structuur, werkt zorgvuldig en vindt het leuk om collega's verder te helpen. Tegelijkertijd kijk je kritisch naar bestaande processen en denk je actief mee over hoe zaken slimmer en efficiënter kunnen worden georganiseerd.

Je beschikt over:

  • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding.
  • Kennis van HR-processen, personeelsadministratie en relevante wet- en regelgeving.
  • Bij voorkeur enkele jaren werkervaring als HR-medewerker, HR Consultant of in een vergelijkbare functie.
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling.
  • Een proactieve, nauwkeurige en resultaatgerichte werkhouding.
  • Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 32 uur per week.
  • Ervaring met Nmbrs is een mooie aanvulling.

Wat biedt Interconnect?

Je komt terecht bij een stabiel en groeiend familiebedrijf waar samenwerking, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en een prettige werksfeer centraal staan.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tot € 4.250 op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis, ervaring en opleidingsniveau.
  • Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus die kan oplopen tot één bruto maandsalaris.
  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling waarbij Interconnect gemiddeld twee derde van de premie betaalt.
  • 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis, met de mogelijkheid om maximaal 10 extra dagen bij te kopen.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,21 per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van het openbaar vervoer.
  • Mogelijkheid om maximaal 40% van de contracturen vanuit huis te werken.
  • Een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan en mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Een moderne werkomgeving in het hoofdkantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch, inclusief lunch-/werkcafé, gaming room en skybar.
  • Een eigen fitnessruimte met moderne apparatuur en groepslessen onder begeleiding van een professionele trainer.
  • Regelmatige teamactiviteiten, waaronder een zomer-BBQ, game nights, vitaliteitsdagen en teamuitjes.

Over Interconnect

Interconnect is een Nederlands familiebedrijf dat sinds 1995 actief is in de wereld van IT-infrastructuur, datacenters en clouddiensten. Met ongeveer 130 medewerkers en eigen Tier III-datacenters in ’s-Hertogenbosch en Eindhoven levert Interconnect veilige en betrouwbare IT-oplossingen aan onder andere managed service providers, softwarebedrijven en zakelijke eindgebruikers. De organisatie speelt een belangrijke rol in de digitale infrastructuur van Nederland en combineert technologische expertise met de betrokkenheid en korte communicatielijnen van een familiebedrijf.

Interesse?

Ben jij een ervaren HR-professional die klaar is voor een leidinggevende rol met impact?

Druk op de knop en solliciteer! Heb je nog vragen neem dan contact op met Staffplaninng.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer

In this role, you will work closely with colleagues throughout the delivery chain, turning customer needs into tailored technical solutions. You will have the opportunity to develop both your design expertise and your involvement in customer projects while contributing to innovative, sustainable industrial solutions.Your responsibilities    You will create detailed drawings and technical documentation that support purchasing, manufacturing, and assembly of tissue machines.    You will collaborate with engineers, project managers, production teams, and pre-assembly functions to deliver high-quality customer solutions.    You will contribute to the ongoing development, maintenance, and improvement of products, machine sections, and components.    You will translate customer requirements into practical and effective mechanical design solutions.    You will support customer projects from design through delivery and occasionally travel when required.Expectations for you    You hold a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering and have experience in mechanical design.    You have experience and a strong interest in mechanical product development and design engineering.    You communicate confidently in written and spoken English.    Experience from the paper, tissue, or process industry is considered a strong advantage.    Some travel may be required as part of the role.To succeed in this roleYou enjoy combining technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and take ownership of your work from concept to delivery. Strong communication skills, problem-solving ability, and a structured approach will help you succeed in a role that involves close interaction with colleagues across engineering, production, and project teams. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve products and processes.We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles, practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:    Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through    Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly    Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety    Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer valueWe offerYou will join one of four engineering teams consisting of approximately 60 engineers working on world-leading tissue machine technology. The team combines expertise in mechanical design and technical project management, creating excellent opportunities for professional growth and knowledge sharing. As your experience grows, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of specific machine sections and components, becoming a key technical expert within your area. The role provides close collaboration with production and pre-assembly teams, giving you a valuable end-to-end understanding of the products you help create.At Valmet, you'll work in an international and people-focused environment where innovation, sustainability, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do. We value continuous learning and offer opportunities for professional development, modern work tools, and a supportive culture where your ideas and contributions matter.Want to know more?Please send your application as soon as possible via the link provided, but no later than November 19th, 2026.If you have any questions about the position, please contact Lars Gustavsson, Manager Dry End Section, at lars.o.gustavsson@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace. When everything works together Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. Join the team and lead the way with us! www.valmet.com/careers

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - 20675
jobs.description: Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.Job OverviewRole SummaryOur client is seeking an experienced Design Engineer for a long-term consulting assignment focused on chassis integration for battery-electric heavy-duty vehicle solutions. The role covers the mechanical design and integration of components and systems within the chassis, including sheet metal structures, brackets and installation solutions, pneumatic components and installations, component packaging, and chassis integration. Experience in at least one of these areas is required, while broader experience spanning multiple areas is advantageous.Key Responsibilities    Design and develop mechanical components, brackets, and installation solutions for heavy-duty vehicle chassis.    Produce and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V5 and applicable design standards.    Manage component packaging, mechanical interfaces, tolerances, and installation requirements within the chassis environment.    Develop solutions involving sheet metal, plastic, and pneumatic components, with consideration for manufacturing feasibility.    Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the development process.    Participate in design reviews, validation activities, and technical investigations.    Maintain accurate technical and engineering documentation.    Provide technical support to production when required.    Independently plan and drive assigned design activities while contributing to technical knowledge sharing within the team.Technical Stack & Requirements    CAD: CATIA V5 for both 3D modeling and 2D engineering drawings.    Mechanical design: Strong competence in sheet metal design and/or pneumatic system design.    Engineering analysis: Practical experience with tolerance analysis and the management of mechanical interfaces.    Vehicle integration: Understanding of component packaging, installation constraints, and chassis integration.    Manufacturing: Knowledge of design-for-manufacturability principles, particularly for sheet metal, plastic, and/or pneumatic components.    Development environment: Previous R&D experience involving heavy-duty vehicle development.Qualifications & ExperienceA Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline is required, together with at least three years of design engineering experience. Candidates must have previous research and development experience from heavy-duty vehicle development, hands-on CATIA V5 competence, and a strong background in sheet metal and/or pneumatic design. Previous experience with chassis design and installation for heavy-duty vehicles is advantageous, as is experience combining several of the relevant technical disciplines. The role requires the ability to drive design work independently and collaborate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional teams. Fluency in English is required.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, DACH
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:



Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €174,000 - €186,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

security dependencies.    Lead technical testing and readiness activities ahead of the pilot and each production deployment.    Plan and coordinate go-live execution, post-launch hypercare, issue or existing archival solution.    Maintain consolidated ownership of the IT workstream and ensure that technical prerequisites and key decisions are resolved at the appropriate stage.Technical Stack & security: Ability to coordinate security requirements and technical controls within a regulated implementation environment.    Technical testing: Experience planning and governing technical testing, jobs.description: Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.The RoleWe are looking for a highly technical and strategic Product Owner to lead our search experiences. Your mission is to build an independent, ML-driven distribution architecture that tackles complex, industry-wide flight distribution challenges. Success in this role requires balancing deep technical execution with high-level strategic thinking. You will own the development of modern search experiences designed to deliver exceptional speed, quality, and accuracy in flight content for our major enterprise partners. As the central driver of this initiative, you will expertly manage communication and collaboration across internal teams and external stakeholders and partners applying a strong product and commercial mindset to align technical deliverables with broader business goals using product and commercial mindset.ResponsibilitiesWith an entrepreneurial mindset you will be responsible for:    Maximizing the value of the product resulting from work of the Development Team.    Forming the long term product/domain plan and requirement assessment process.    Inspiring and motivating the team with vision, long term direction, ambition and making the dev team accountable for the delivery .    Continuously prioritizing and following up activities in ongoing product development.    Facilitating in order to create a stimulating and creative work environment and accountable teams by focusing on the needs rather than providing solutions.    Coordinating, steering and interacting with multiple stakeholders and facilitating a joint understanding by tailoring the language to the audience.    Providing post-release and day-to-day support by collecting, filtering, organizing, prioritizing and following up bug reports and questions.Requirements    At least 3 years of experience within the Airline Travel Industry.    Proven experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner, successfully driving product development from ideation to launch.    Ability to break down a complex concept/process into simpler parts and present it to someone with less insights.    You are used to working with people and have excellent communication skills (verbal and written communication), being able to tailor your language to the audience you refer to.    You thrive when taking on new responsibilities and feel comfortable making decisions.    Ability to deliver a data driven approach with a customer-first mindset.Meritorious:    Technical knowledge of how GDS and/or LCC booking processes work.    Previous experience around Flight search will be a big plus.    Experience of working in documentation programs such as Atlassian or Figma.    Previous experience working in an Agile world with Scrum and/or Kanban.BenefitsThe culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company. With us you can enjoy:    A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you will have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location    Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner.    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.Diversity disclaimerAt Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.#LI-JW1

jobs.title: Kundsupport inom Travel Tech
jobs.description: Etraveli Group är en ledande global leverantör av flygteknologi, specialiserad på flygförsäljning samt leverans av flyginnehåll och fintech-produkter. Vi finns till för att lösa komplexitet genom att koppla samman miljontals flyg och resenärer över hela världen – från sökning och urval till själva resan och därefter.Vi samarbetar med stora globala plattformar som Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner och Kayak, och erbjuder sömlös flygbokning och relaterade tjänster. Vår B2B-portfölj inkluderar en separat fintech-verksamhet (Precision), Sveriges ledande flygjämförelsesajt Flygresor.se, Tripstack (vår leverantör av B2B-flygtjänster och världsledare inom virtuell interlining) samt Wenrix, en integrerad AI-plattform för flyg. Vi driver även våra egna onlineresebyråer, inklusive varumärken som Gotogate, Mytrip och Flightnetwork.Av våra 3200 anställda arbetar cirka 30 personer på vår kundtsupport centralt i Uppsala. Vi sitter i moderna, ljusa lokaler med en fantastisk takterrass, bara fem minuters promenad från centralstationen. Hos oss blir du en del av ett ungt och dynamiskt team som värdesätter gemenskap, där vi ofta anordnar aktiviteter och afterworks tillsammans.Om rollenI rollen som Kundsupport (Travel Agent) fungerar du som den viktiga länken mellan oss och våra kunder. Arbetet är varierande och fokuserar på problemlösning i en tekniskt avancerad miljö. Du kommer att arbeta i flera parallella system samtidigt som du hjälper våra kunder via telefon.Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:    Hantera inkommande samtal som rör exempelvis ombokningar, inställda flyg, bagagefrågor och namnändringar.    Navigera i avancerade, komplexa bokningssystem samt säkerställa korrekt teknisk och administrativ hantering av kundens resa.    Arbeta målmedvetet för att nå och överträffa uppsatta nyckeltal (KPI:er) gällande kvalitet, effektivitet och kundnöjdhet.    Rapportera tekniska problem och kundfeedback vidare inom organisationen.Betald utbildning och arbetstider: För att du ska känna dig trygg i rollen inleds din anställning med en betald utbildning på åtta veckor. Här får du lära dig våra system och arbetssätt från grunden tillsammans med en engagerad utbildare. Ingen tidigare erfarenhet krävs, men det är avgörande att du kan närvara på plats under hela utbildningsperioden.Vi arbetar kontorstider, 08:00–17:00 på vardagar. Du är alltid ledig på helger och röda dagar.Vem söker vi?Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du trygg i dig själv, stresstålig och har en stark problemlösande förmåga i en tekniskt utmanande miljö. Då vi arbetar i en resultatdriven organisation mot tydligt definierade KPI:er, motiveras du starkt av att följa upp din egen prestation, ta ansvar för dina resultat och ständigt utvecklas.Vi söker dig som:    Har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.    Har god datorvana och lätt för att sätta dig in i nya system.    Har en positiv grundinställning och en stark servicekänsla.Det är meriterande om du har:    Tidigare erfarenhet av kundservice, gärna via telefon.    Kunskaper i bokningssystem som Sabre eller Amadeus.    Relevant utbildning inom resor/turism.    Kunskaper i finska, danska eller norska.Vi erbjuder Att jobba hos oss innebär att vara en del av ett stort, internationellt bolag med ambitionen att fortsätta växa. Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats med flera utvecklingsmöjligheter och kollegor som stöttar varandra.Dina förmåner inkluderar:    Hybridarbete - Möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån upp till 2 dagar i veckan (efter avslutat provanställning)    Möjlighet till månads- och kvartalsbonus, utöver fast månadslön    Högt friskvårdsbidrag    Tjänstepension med personlig rådgivning och bra försäkringar    Frukostbuffé varje morgon på kontoret.Praktisk information Startdatum: Runt 11 januari Plats: Uppsala (Centralt) Omfattning: HeltidVälkommen med din ansökan!As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.Diversity disclaimerAt Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

jobs.title: Global Implementation Specialist
jobs.description: About the roleAs a Global Implementation Specialist you will play a key role in developing and continuously improving Instabee's global merchant offering through API integrations. You will be responsible for ensuring a seamless integration experience, enabling merchants to quickly launch and scale Instabee's delivery services across markets.Working closely with our Commercial, Product, Tech and Operations teams, you will act as the link between business needs and technical solutions. You will support complex commercial deals by translating merchant requirements into effective integration solutions, removing technical barriers and accelerating go-to-market timelines.From initial discussions and technical onboarding to launch and ongoing optimization, you will take ownership of the integration journey and build strong, long-term relationships with our global merchants. This is a cross-functional role where you will combine technical understanding, commercial awareness and project management to create scalable solutions and an excellent merchant experience.What you’ll doIn this role, you will:    Drive the technical value proposition in complex commercial deal cycles, aligning integration roadmaps with business objectives to remove technical barriers and accelerate merchant launches.    Take full ownership of onboarding and API integrations for new global merchants, ensuring a smooth and successful launch experience.    Partner closely with Commercial teams to accelerate go-to-market timelines and enable merchants to quickly start using Instabee's services.    Collaborate cross-functionally with Tech, Product and Operations to simplify complex integrations, resolve technical challenges and ensure effective solutions.    Monitor integration performance and analyze relevant data to identify improvement opportunities and continuously strengthen our global integration processes.    Act as a trusted partner to global merchants, building strong relationships and supporting their needs beyond the initial launch.What we're looking forWe believe you are a driven and solution-oriented person who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and business. You are comfortable navigating complex technical discussions, managing multiple stakeholders and taking ownership of projects from start to finish. You combine strong communication skills with a structured approach and a genuine interest in creating great customer experiences.We also believe you have:    A university degree in Business, Engineering or a related field.    4–6 years of relevant experience within e-commerce or logistics, preferably in implementation, Technical Account Management or Commercial Excellence.    A solid understanding of API integrations. Hands-on experience with Postman or similar tools is a plus.    Experience working with global merchants and/or cross-border commercial setups.    Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive initiatives forward in a cross-functional environment.    A commercial mindset and the ability to understand business needs and translate them into practical technical solutions.    Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.What you’ll getWe can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:    🏢 Brand-New Office — More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.    👶 Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.    🎂 A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!    ⏰ Hybrid setup and flexible working hours.Get to know usIn 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.

jobs.title: Fysioterapeut sökes till vårdcentralen Breared, Varberg
jobs.description: Nu söker vi en fysioterapeut som vill bidra med sin kunskap och kompetens till vårt team! Låter det spännande? Passa då på att söka dig till oss på Vårdcentralen Breared redan idag!ArbetsuppgifterSom fysioterapeut på vår vårdcentral kommer du att arbeta med en bred patientgrupp, från unga idrottare till äldre personer som behöver hjälp med rehabilitering efter en operation eller skada.Du ger individuell bedömning och behandlingsplaner där du vägleder patienterna till att påverka sin egen hälsa. Vidare innebär det att utföra behandlingar, planera och samordna fysioterapeutiska insatser, ge konsultation samt hålla i gruppverksamhet. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår även att göra en första bedömning vad gäller patienter med besvär från rörelse-stödjeorganen.  Ditt arbete sker i nära samarbete med andra professioner för att kunna ge en heltäckande vård till våra patienter.Om arbetsplatsenVi på Breared har nu vuxit oss tillräckligt stora för att vara en självständig vårdcentral, från att tidigare varit en filial till Västra Vall. Vi ligger i ett expansivt område vara fem minuter från centrum. Personalen består av en samling erfarna och kvalificerade läkare, sjuksköterskor och administrativpersonal som alla har en passion för att ge den bästa möjliga vården till sina patienter.Vårdcentralen har också en varm och välkomnande atmosfär, med ett fokus på att skapa en personlig och empatisk relation med varje patient. Personalen arbetar tätt tillsammans för att se till att patienterna får den omsorg och stöd som de behöver för att återhämta sig och förbättra sin hälsa. Just nu expanderar vårdcentralen och vi kommer att få större utrymme med bl.a. egen träningslokal.KvalifikationerVi söker dig som är leg. fysioterapeut eller sjukgymnast och vi ser gärna att du har yrkeserfarenhet från primärvård. Meriterande är om du har utbildning i akupunktur. För tjänsten krävs att du har goda kunskaper i svenska språket i såväl tal som skrift. Det är viktigt att du har en god förmåga att kommunicera med patienter och andra vårdpersonal, samt har en förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta beslut om patientvård. Du måste också ha en hög grad av empati och förståelse för patienternas behov. Ett stort plus är om du är en driven person som gillar att jobba med utvecklingsarbete. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!Vårt erbjudandeFör oss är det viktigt att du ska trivas och utvecklas i ditt arbete. Läs mer om vad Region Halland kan erbjuda dig som medarbetare här Om Region HallandRegion Halland är till för alla som bor och arbetar här i Halland. Vi är över 8 000 medarbetare inom 370 olika yrken som alla arbetar för att erbjuda en god hälso- och sjukvård och att främja tillväxt och utveckling. Vi ansvarar också för kollektivtrafiken i Halland och driver frågor inom områden som näringsliv, kultur och utbildning. Vår vision är ”Halland ­ – bästa livsplatsen” och med det menar vi att Halland ska bli den bästa platsen att bo på, utbilda sig, arbeta och driva företag i. Vi har kommit en bra bit på vägen, välkommen att följa med oss på vår resa! Läs mer om Region Hallands organisation, vårt uppdrag och vår vision.Strävan efter jämställdhet, mångfald och likvärdiga villkor är både en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av Region Hallands värdegrund.Region Halland krigsplacerar all tillsvidareanställd personal.Region Halland följer främst det centrala kollektivavtalet HÖK (Huvudöverenskommelsen) med bilagor som AB (Allmänna bestämmelser), i vissa fall kan även avtalet BEA användas. HÖK med bilagor hittar du på www.skr.seTill bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. Region Halland har upphandlade avtal.

jobs.title: Senior LCI Specialist
jobs.description: The opportunityHVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group within Hitachi Energy that develops, manufactures, and delivers DC transmission systems worldwide. HVDC technology enables the efficient transmission of electricity over long distances, through submarine cables, and between interconnected power systems.Join our team as a Senior LCI Specialist and help us drive innovation in the Engineering, Procurement and Construction industry!  As part of the LCI team, you will be at the forefront of our efforts to coordinate all activities related to Life Cycle Information (LCI), Asset Information Management (AIM) and Data Quality. Your main responsibility will be to support project execution and ensure effective LCI coordination across all phases of a project, from tendering to final handover to the client.You will play a critical role in aligning data handling strategies and practices with key stakeholders, including the Building Information Modelling (BIM), Service, Digital, and PLM organizations, to ensure we provide the best possible support to our customers and stay ahead in an industry that is increasingly driven by information rather than documents.To succeed in this role, you should be resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced project environment. You need to effectively manage multiple project stakeholders simultaneously and ensure they have everything they need to deliver their part of the project.How you’ll make an impact    Ensure all project stakeholders understand and comply with the client’s LCI/AIM requirements.    Oversee the collection, validation, and maintenance of asset information, including equipment specifications, maintenance records, and performance data.    Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including engineering, operations, maintenance, SCM, and IT teams, to integrate asset information processes into project workflows and systems.    Develop and implement strategies for the successful adoption and integration of LCI/AIM concepts, systems and processes across various functions within Hitachi Energy.    Establish and enforce quality standards for asset data accuracy, completeness, and integrity to support reliable decision-making and regulatory compliance.    Develop and deliver training on LCI/AIM systems and processes in collaboration with the Training Development Lead.    Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and innovation in LCI/AIM practices to drive operational efficiency and cost savings.    Lead and manage LCI related continuous improvement projects from initiation to completion, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.    Maintain effective communication with project stakeholders to ensure alignment on LCI objectives, progress, and outcomes.Your background    Bachelor's degree or higher in engineering, computer science, information management, or a related field. Advanced degree or certification in asset management or data analytics is an advantage.    3-5 years of experience in a senior technical role within Asset Information Management, Life Cycle Information, or related fields in the energy, utilities, or manufacturing industries.    In-depth knowledge of AIM systems and technologies, such as AVEVA AIM, Omega365, IBM Maximo, digital twin platforms or similar solutions.    Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks for asset management, such as IEC 61970-301, ISO 55000 and IEC 62443.    Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management.    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels of the organization.    Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.    Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement and innovation in LCI/AIM processes and practices.More About Us​We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​    Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​    Health care and wellness allowance ​    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​    Psychological support program ​    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. ​Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Sara Wendel, sara.wendel@hitachienergy.com​. Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Nawzad Rashid, +46 (10) 7389148; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107-38 70 43; Unionen: Karin Ulvemark, +46 107-38 51 42 and Ingrid Rinaldo, +46 107-38 58 19.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - 20682
jobs.description: Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.Job OverviewRole SummaryOur client is seeking an Electrical Design Engineer to develop electrical and automation solutions for advanced industrial products. The assignment covers electrical design, control systems, machine safety, and technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle. Working in an international engineering environment, the engineer will collaborate closely with multiple technical disciplines to deliver robust, standardized, modular, and compliant solutions for industrial machinery and automation systems.Key Responsibilities    Design electrical systems, automation control panels, and electrical installations for advanced industrial products.    Create and maintain electrical schematics, technical specifications, engineering calculations, and test documentation.    Develop control-system and automation solutions in collaboration with other engineering disciplines.    Perform risk assessments and participate in technical design reviews.    Plan and execute testing, verification, and troubleshooting of electrical and automation solutions.    Support machine-safety activities and ensure that designs meet applicable technical and regulatory requirements.    Contribute to modularization and standardization initiatives for electrical designs and engineering methods.    Maintain accurate technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle.Technical Stack & Requirements    Electrical engineering: Industrial electrical design, electrical installations, control panels, schematics, calculations, sensors, instrumentation, and electrical components.    Automation and control: Practical experience designing solutions for industrial machinery or automation systems.    Electrical CAD: Professional experience with EPLAN Electric P8 or an equivalent electrical CAD platform.    Advantageous engineering tools: EPLAN Pro Panel, Cogineer/eBuild, and Autodesk Inventor.    Product lifecycle systems: Experience with Teamcenter or another PDM/PLM platform is advantageous.    Additional advantageous areas: Agile development practices, project coordination, and IoT solutions.Qualifications & ExperienceA degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline is required, together with relevant experience in electrical design for industrial machinery or automation systems. Candidates must have practical knowledge of electrical components, sensors, instrumentation, testing, and troubleshooting. Knowledge of EN 60204-1, EN ISO 13849, CE compliance, and machine-safety principles is required. Experience with marine approvals, engineering verification, and associated technical documentation is considered advantageous. Fluency in English is required for collaboration and documentation within the international engineering environment.

jobs.title: Etsimme vahvistusta Factoryn HR-tiimiin!
jobs.description: Etsimme vahvistusta Factoryn HR-tiimiin!Oletko ihmisläheinen tekijä, joka viihtyy ravintoloiden arjessa, innostuu asioiden järjestämisestä ja uskaltaa tarttua haastaviinkin tilanteisiin? Meillä voisi olla sinulle paikka!Factorylla on 28 ravintolaa Helsingissä, Espoossa, Vantaalla, Salossa, Hämeenlinnassa ja Lahdessaja kasvumme jatkuu!Meillä työskentelee paljon pitkäaikaisia työntekijöitä, joiden osaaminen ja kokemus ovat tärkeä osa Factorya.Nyt etsimme HR-tiimiimme uutta työkaveria tukemaan henkilöstömme ja ravintoloidemme arkea.Meillä henkilöstötyötä tehdään lähellä ihmisiä: ravintoloissa, esihenkilöiden rinnalla ja yhdessä monikulttuurisen työyhteisömme kanssa.Päiviin mahtuu kohtaamisia, käytännön järjestelyjä, uuden ideointia ja yhdessä onnistumisen iloa.Millaista arkea sinulle olisi luvassa?Olet tärkeä tuki ravintoloidemme esihenkilöille niin päivittäisissä kysymyksissä kuin haastavammissakin henkilöstötilanteissa.Työhösi kuuluu:- Esihenkilöiden ja henkilöstön tukemista arjessa: kuuntelemista, neuvomista ja käytännön ravintolatilanteiden ratkomista yhdessä.- Innostavaa rekrytointia, jossa Factoryn työkulttuuri pääsee näkyviin, sekä perehdyttämistä ja uusien työntekijöiden tukemista, jotta he tuntevat itsensä tervetulleiksi ja pääsevät sujuvasti osaksi työyhteisöä.- Toimipistekierroksia ja henkilöstön kohtaamista ravintoloiden arjessa. Hahmotat toiminnan kokonaisuuden, ymmärrät työhön kohdistuvat odotukset ja asiakkaan polun sekä tartut reippaasti havaittuihin kehityskohteisiin yhdessä henkilöstön ja esihenkilöiden kanssa.- Uusien ravintoloiden avausten valmistelua ja avauksissa mukana olemista, henkilöstön perehdyttämistä sekä päivittäisen työohjelman ja arjen toimintatapojen rakentamista. Luoden hyvää työilmapiiriä ja yhteistä Factoryn toimintakulttuuria.- Esihenkilöiden tukemista henkilöstötarpeiden ennakoinnissa, työntekijöiden koordinoinnissa toimipisteiden välillä sekä lomien ja sijaistusten järjestelyissä.- Työsuhteen eri vaiheisiin liittyvien asioiden hoitamista, työsopimusten huolellista valmistelua sekä henkilöstötietojen tarkkaa ja ajantasaista ylläpitoa eri järjestelmissä.Lisäksi tehtäviin kuuluu työnteko-oikeuden ja oleskelulupien tarkistamista.- Henkilöstöviestintää, aktiivista kommunikointia ja ohjeistusten päivittämistä. Varmistat, että tieto kulkee ja ohjeet ymmärretään huomioimalla ihmisten erilaiset oppimistavat ja tuen tarpeet.- Tiivistä yhteistyötä palkanlaskennan kanssa, palkkoihin liittyvien kysymysten selvittämistä sekä molemminpuolista tukea ja apua arjen työtehtävissä.- Työkyvyn ja työhyvinvoinnin tukemista sekä esihenkilöiden tukemista varhaisen tuen keskusteluissa. Meille välitön välittäminen tarkoittaa huolten huomaamista, kuuntelemista ja tuen tarjoamista ajoissa.- Esihenkilöiden tukemista henkilöstön johtamisessa, nopeaa reagointia arjen tilanteisiin sekä vaikeiden asioiden puheeksi ottamista. Tässä tarvitaan taitoa kuunnella, rohkeutta keskustella ja halua löytää ratkaisuja.- Koulutusten ja harjoittelujen koordinointia sekä henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämistä. Meille on tärkeää, että työntekijämme saavat mahdollisuuksia oppia uutta, kehittyä ja edetä urallaan.- Yhteistyötä kumppaneidemme, kuten oppilaitosten ja työterveyshuollon, kanssa. Huolehdit avoimesta yhteydenpidosta ja sujuvasta yhteistyöstä, jotta asiat etenevät ja tuki tavoittaa oikeat ihmiset.- HR-käytäntöjen ideointia ja kehittämistä, jotta arki pysyy sujuvana ja toimintatapamme kehittyvät yrityksen kasvun mukana.Kaiken keskiössä ovat ihmiset ja arjen sujuminen. Tehtävässä pääset sekä suunnittelemaan että tarttumaan käytännön tekemiseen, oman tiimin tuella.Millainen työkaveri sopisi meidän HR-tiimiin?Toivomme, että olet helposti lähestyttävä, oma-aloitteinen ja luotettava.Pidät monta lankaa käsissäsi ja kohtaat ihmiset lämpimästi myös kiireen keskellä. Innostut uusista asioista ja tuot rohkeasti omia ideoitasi esiin.Teet töitä pilke silmäkulmassa ja tuot huumorillasi hyvää fiilistä arkeen!Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi, sillä saat tiimiltämme tukea työtehtäviisi.Tehtävässä tarvitset:- Hyviä tietoteknisiä taitoja ja valmiutta oppia käyttämään erilaisia HR- ja rekrytointijärjestelmiä.- Erinomaista suomen ja hyvää englannin kielen taitoa, ilmaiset itseäsi sujuvasti sekä kirjallisesti että suullisesti molemmilla kielillä.- Oman auton ja ajokortin, sillä työ sisältää liikkumista toimipisteidemme välillä.- Valmiutta ja joustavuutta työskennellä pääsääntöisesti pääkaupunkiseudulla sekä tehdä käyntejä ja yrityksen laajentuessa työskennellä myös sen ulkopuolella.- Ravintolan toimintatapojen tuntemusta ja valmiutta perehdyttää työntekijöitä. Ravintola-alan työkokemus on meille ehdoton plussa!- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja organisointitaitoja sekä hienotunteisuutta henkilöstöasioiden käsittelyssä.- Aikaisempi kokemus tiimin johtamisesta ja kokonaisuuden hallinnasta.Mitä saat meiltä?- Rempseän työtiimin, jossa saat kysyä, olla oma itsesi ja ratkoa asioita yhdessä.- Kokeneita, pitkään talossa olleita työkavereita sekä perehdytystä ja tukea työtehtäviisi.- Joustavan työajan ja pääsääntöisesti arkiaamuihin painottuvan työn. Mahdollisuuden tehdä satunnaisesti etätöitä.- Monipuolisen tehtävän jatkuvasti kasvavassa ravintolayrityksessä.- Mahdollisuuden kehittää ja ideoida toimintatapojamme sekä edetä urallasi.- Työn, jossa oman tekemisesi vaikutus näkyy ihmisten ja ravintoloiden arjessa.- Toimistomme sijaitsee Helsingin Pitäjänmäellä. Työskentelet sekä toimistolla että ravintoloissamme.Etsimme pitkäaikaista työkaveria ja toivomme, että viihdyt meillä pitkään. Olisitko sinä sopiva meidän HR-tiimiimme?Haluaisimme kuulla sinusta!Lähetä persoonallinen hakemuksesi ja CV palkkatoiveineen.Kerro meille, kuka olet, osaamisesi ja mikä sinua innostaa työssä Factoryn HR-tiimissä.Haku on avoinna toistaiseksi.Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetäthän hakemuksesi pian!

jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.description: About the roleAs an Operations Analyst within Group Operations, you will play an important role in shaping and optimizing Instabee's first- and middle-mile transport network. You will work with strategy, network design and data analysis to improve the efficiency, quality and reliability of our transport routes between merchant warehouses and Instabee terminals across our five markets: Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Norway and the Netherlands.Working closely with our local Market teams, you will identify improvement opportunities, analyze network performance and ensure that the right data, insights and tools are available to support well-informed operational decisions. You will also collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to develop scalable solutions that improve our transport operations and create a great experience for our merchants.You will be part of the First and Middle Mile team within Group Operations, reporting to the First and Middle Mile Manager, who will support your onboarding, learning and professional development.What you’ll doIn this role, you will:    Analyze and design first- and middle-mile transport networks to identify opportunities for improved efficiency, quality and cost performance.    Work closely with local Market teams to understand operational needs, evaluate current performance and drive improvements across our markets.    Develop and maintain the data landscape for first- and middle-mile operations, integrating data from different tools and systems to create valuable insights.    Monitor operational performance and ensure high-quality and reliable transport operations.    Collaborate with colleagues across Tech, Commercial and Integration to ensure that tools and solutions are developed in line with operational needs and provide a great merchant experience.    Build dashboards and analytical tools to support data-driven decision-making and enable best-practice sharing across markets.What we're looking forWe believe you are a curious and analytical person who enjoys solving complex problems and understanding how different parts of a system connect. You combine a strategic mindset with a structured and hands-on approach, and are motivated by turning data and insights into tangible improvements.We also believe you have:    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex challenges and strategic goals into actionable improvements.    A structured and data-driven approach, with great attention to detail and an ability to prioritize initiatives based on their potential impact.    An interest in data analysis and experience working with tools such as SQL and Excel/Google Sheets. Experience with Tableau is a plus.    The ability to evaluate complex, interconnected systems and identify opportunities for optimization.    Strong communication and collaboration skills, allowing you to build relationships and work effectively with stakeholders across different teams and markets.    A genuine curiosity and interest in logistics, transport and operational development.What you’ll getWe can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:    🏢 Brand-New Office — More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.    👶 Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.    🎂 A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!    ⏰ Hybrid setup and flexible working hours.Get to know usIn 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.

jobs.title: Sygeplejersker til den Kommunale Sygepleje
jobs.employer: Sundhed og Omsorg, Sygeplejen og Rehabilitering
jobs.description:
Vi søger 3 fastansatte sygeplejersker og 1 barselsvikar til den Kommunale Sygepleje på Bornholm

Har du lyst til at arbejde tæt på borgerne og gøre en reel forskel i deres hverdag? Trives du med selvstændigt ansvar, stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde og en hverdag, hvor to dage sjældent er ens? Så er en stilling i Den Kommunale Sygepleje på Bornholm lige noget for dig.

Vi søger autoriserede sygeplejersker til faste stillinger på 37 t/u.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt i dagvagt. Efter en grundig introduktion indgår du også i aften- og i sjældne tilfælde nattevagter. Der er typisk 2-4 aftenvagter om måneden, afhængigt af dine ønsker, mens nattevagter kun forekommer undtagelsesvist. Weekendvagt planlægges som udgangspunkt hver 4.-6. weekend.

Bliv en del af et stærkt fællesskab

Som sygeplejerske i Den Kommunale Sygepleje bliver du en del af en engageret og kompetent afdeling, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe trygge, sammenhængende og kvalificerede borgerforløb.

Vi leverer sygepleje til borgere i eget hjem, på Bornholms plejecentre og på de midlertidige pladser.Vores tilgang er rehabiliterende og helhedsorienteret, og vi lægger vægt på, at borgeren oplever høj kvalitet, kontinuitet og medinddragelse.

Den Kommunale Sygepleje er organiseret i teams fordelt over hele Bornholm, og vi forsøger så vidt muligt at tage hensyn til individuelle ønsker om geografisk tilknytning.

Vi samarbejder tæt med hjemmeplejen, terapeuter, plejecentre, visitationen, praktiserende læger og hospitalet. Som en del af Ældrereformen og de faste teams, deltager vi i tværfaglige møder med fokus på tidlig opsporing, forebyggelse og koordinering af den samlede indsats omkring borgeren.

Et meningsfuldt arbejde tæt på borgeren

Du bliver en del af en hverdag med både akutte og planlagte sygeplejeopgaver. Opgaverne spænder bredt og omfatter blandt andet sårbehandling, kompressionsbehandling, medicinhåndtering, palliation, komplekse borgerforløb og klinisk vurdering i tæt samarbejde med læger og hospital.

Du møder borgere i mange forskellige livssituationer, og får mulighed for at opbygge nære og tillidsfulde relationer til både borgere og pårørende. Du arbejder selvstændigt, men står aldrig alene – faglig sparring og kollegial støtte er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Udføre sygeplejefaglige opgaver i borgernes eget hjem

  • Varetage og koordinere komplekse og akutte sygeplejeopgaver

  • Identificere ændringer i borgerens helbred og handle proaktivt

  • Indgå i tværfagligt samarbejde med terapeuter, læger og sosu. personale.

  • Deltage i udvikling og kvalitetssikring af det sygeplejefaglige arbejde

  • Vejlede og undervise borgere, pårørende og kolleger

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra primær sektor, men det er ikke et krav

  • Interesse for at arbejde med borgernær sygepleje

  • Kan arbejde struktureret med klinisk beslutningstagen i samarbejde med det tværfaglige team

  • Kan tage ansvar for det kliniske lederskab

  • Er god til at skabe tillid og møde mennesker med respekt

  • Er vant til dokumentation og digitalt journalføringssystem

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende og afvekslende hverdag i en sektor i udvikling

  • Et godt og engageret kollegafællesskab med plads til faglig sparring

  • Grundig introduktion og mentorordning

  • Mulighed for kompetenceudvikling og efteruddannelse

  • Indflydelse på arbejdsplan og fleksibilitet i hverdagen

  • En ledelse der er synlig og lydhør

Vil du med på holdet?

Send din ansøgning samt dokumentation for uddannelse, via "Søg Jobbet" knappen, så vi har modtaget den senest d. 17.11.2026. Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt d. 23.11.26

Har du spørgsmål? Du er velkommen til at kontakte os – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst og efter principperne i lokal løndannelse.

Der vil blive indhentet børneattest og straffeattest ved ansættelse.Kørekort til kategori B - Almindelig bil er et krav.

Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge. 

Praktisk information

Send din ansøgning og CV samt dokumentation for uddannelse, via "Søg Jobbet" knappen. 

Ansøgningsfrist

17-11-2026

Samtaletidspunkt

23.11.2026

Ansættelsesdato

01-01-2027

Kontaktperson

leder af Sygeplejen område 3Tanja Berg Rylander Christensen56924632 / 20159933

Arbejdssted

Sygeplejen og RehabiliteringUllasvej 17, 3700 Rønne

En arbejdsplads, der binder øen sammen

BRK er en unik kommunal arbejdsplads, fordi øen er en selvstændig region. Vi arbejder derfor med strategier og opgaver inden for erhverv, turisme og trafik, som er ansvarsområder danske kommuner normalt ikke varetager. På brk.dk kan du læse mere om kommunen, der med 3.600 ansatte er øens suverænt største arbejdsplads.

BRK er en røgfri arbejdsplads. 

Vi hjælper dig på plads

Det er en stor beslutning at flytte til ’solskinsøen’ – derfor står du heller ikke alene med den. Vi har nemlig en tilflytterkonsulent, der hjælper med bolig, job til din ægtefælle og skole- eller fritidstilbud til familiens mindste. Læs mere her.

jobs.title: Har du lyst til et arbejde med sundhedsfaglige opgaver, omsorg og meningsfulde aktiviteter? Olivia Danmark søger 2 faste SSA-vikarer til en ung kvinde med multiple funktionsnedsættelser (bosat i Assens Kommune) – med mulighed for faste timer på sigt.
jobs.description:
Vil du have et arbejde med stor fleksibilitet i vagtplanlægningen, tid til nærvær og plads til faglighed? Et arbejde, hvor du kan være med til at skabe en hverdag fyldt med musik, bevægelse og små eventyr – og samtidig gøre en meningsfuld forskel for en ung kvinde med multiple funktionsnedsættelser? Så er det måske lige dig, vi leder efter!

Hos Olivia Danmark søger vi to engagerede social- og sundhedsassistenter som fast tilknyttede vikarer til et team omkring en ung kvinde, som bor hos sine forældre i Assens Kommune.

Vi har plads til både dig, der ønsker fleksible vagter ved siden af dit øvrige liv, og dig, der gerne vil være en del af teamet med mulighed for faste timer på sigt.

Her er hverdagen præget af både sundhedsfaglige opgaver, omsorg og meningsfulde aktiviteter. Vi lægger vægt på at skabe tryghed, livskvalitet og gode oplevelser med udgangspunkt i den unge kvindes behov og dagsform.

Derfor skal du vælge os 

  • Tid til nærvær og fordybelseHer får du mulighed for at arbejde med ét menneske og lære hendes behov, kommunikation og rutiner godt at kende. Der er tid til både den faglige opgave og de små øjeblikke, der gør en forskel.

  • En hverdag med musik, bevægelse og oplevelserDen unge kvinde holder af musik, sang, massage, bevægelse og forskellige former for sansestimulering. Hun nyder også ture ud af huset, og som hjælper har du stor frihed til at planlægge aktiviteter og oplevelser med udgangspunkt i hendes dagsform.

  • Et godt arbejdsfællesskabDu bliver en del af et team med dygtige og engagerede kolleger, gode fysiske rammer samt et tæt samarbejde med både hjemmesygeplejen og en dejlig familie.

  • God overenskmst med FOA, som du kan se her.

Fleksibilitet, der passer til din hverdag

Som fast tilknyttet vikar bestemmer du selv, hvilke ledige vagter du ønsker at byde ind på. Det giver dig frihed til at tilpasse arbejdet til dit øvrige liv – uanset om du ønsker ekstra timer ved siden af et andet job, studie eller blot en fleksibel hverdag.

Vi søger dig, der har mulighed for at tage vagter løbende, så du bliver en tryg og genkendelig del af teamet og bevarer dit kendskab til borgeren og arbejdsopgaverne.

Arbejdstider og vagter

  • Hverdage, dagvagt: Kl. 06.30–17.30

  • Hverdage, nattevagt: Kl. 22.00–06.30

  • Weekender, nattevagt: Kl. 22.00–06.30

Der tilbydes vagter ved ferie, sygdom og øvrigt fravær fra teamet samt ved behov for ekstra vagter på ordningen. Timetallet varierer, og der er ikke et fast garanteret timetal.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er en omsorgsfuld og fagligt engageret social- og sundhedsassistent, som trives med selvstændigt arbejde og gode relationer.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent.

  • Kan kommunikere sikkert på dansk i både skrift og tale, da arbejdet indebærer sundhedsfaglig dokumentation og tæt samarbejde med familien og hjemmesygeplejen.

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og overholder dine aftaler.

  • Har respekt for, at din arbejdsplads samtidig er et privat hjem.

  • Har mulighed for at tage vagter løbende og ønsker at blive en stabil del af teamet.

  • Erfaring med borgere med multiple funktionsnedsættelser er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Du får oplæring i borgerens behov, sundhedsfaglige opgaver og gældende instrukser. Opgaverne varetages på delegation fra Assens Kommunes hjemmesygepleje, og du vil få relevant undervisning og kompetence afklaring.

Du bliver ansat på vilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: VVS-installatør søges til Hafnia Bad ApS
jobs.description:

Stillingstype: Fuldtid

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til kontakt@hafniabad.dk

jobs.title: Projektleiter/in Brandschutz 80-100%
jobs.description:
Die EL-TECH Engineering AG ist ein zuverlässiger und kompetenter Fachplaner Elektro und Brandschutz für eine anspruchsvolle Kundschaft aus den Bereichen Bauwesen und der Industrie.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Engineering-Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als

Projektleiter/in Brandschutz 80-100%

  • Sie möchten Brandschutzprojekte eigenverantwortlich leiten und praxistaugliche Lösungen entwickeln?

  • Sie übernehmen gerne Verantwortung und behalten Qualität, Termine und Kosten im Blick?

  • Sie schätzen den Austausch mit Bauherrschaften, Behörden und Planungspartnern?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie führen unsere Brandschutzprojekte von der ersten Beratung über die Konzepterarbeitung bis zur Abnahme. Dabei sind Sie die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle Projektbeteiligten und stellen eine fachgerechte Umsetzung sicher.

  • Selbstständige Leitung und Bearbeitung von Brandschutzprojekten unter Einhaltung der vereinbarten Qualitäts-, Termin- und Kostenziele

  • Erarbeitung von Brandschutzkonzepten und Nachweisen gemäss den geltenden Schweizer Brandschutzvorschriften VKF

  • Übernahme der Qualitätssicherung im Brandschutz entsprechend Ihrer Qualifikation und den Projektanforderungen
