jobs.description: Johda tiimiä, kehitä asiakkuuksia ja vaikuta tulevaisuuden tekemiseenHaluatko yhdistää ihmisten, asiakkuuksien ja taloushallinnon johtamisen tehtävässä, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan? Haemme palvelupäällikköä Rovaniemelle johtamaan osaavaa asiantuntijatiimiämme sekä kehittämään asiakkuuksiamme ja toimintaamme. Tässä tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan sujuvaa arkea tiimillesi, vahvistamaan asiakaskokemusta ja viemään käytäntöön uusia toimintatapoja. Saat vastuuta, mutta ympärilläsi on myös osaava kollegaverkosto ja tuki onnistumiseesi. Työntekopaikkasi sijaitsee Rovaniemellä.Matkailualan liiketoiminnan tuntemuksesta ja erityisesti alan yritysten taloushallinnon tai kirjanpidon kokemuksesta on tehtävässä hyötyä. Se ei kuitenkaan ole ehdoton edellytys tehtävässä onnistumiselle. Toimialaosaaminen tarjoaa myös mahdollisuuksia oman osaamisen ja vastuun laajentamiseen tulevaisuudessa.Mitä työ pitää sisällään?- Tiimin toiminnan johtaminen annettujen tavoitteiden mukaisesti- Töiden organisointi ja resursointi- Asiakkuuksien johtaminen, kehittäminen ja asiakashuolenpito- Asiantuntijoiden sparraus ja osaamisen kehittäminen- Palvelun laadun varmistaminen- Toimintatapojen ja palveluiden kehittäminen sekä muutosten jalkauttaminen omassa tiimissäMitä tarjoamme sinulle?- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan sekä ihmisiin, asiakkaisiin että toiminnan kehittämiseen- Mahdollisuuden kasvattaa omaa vastuutasi ja osaamistasi tehtävän mukana- Osaavan ja tukevan kollegaverkoston, esihenkilön sekä hallinnon palvelutiimien tuen- Mahdollisuuden kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi osaamista- Joustavat työskentelytavat ja työajat sekä mahdollisuuden hybridityöhön- Kilpailukykyiset edut: laajennettu työterveys, suoritukseesi perustuva tulospalkkio sekä joustavat hyvinvointiedut (liikunta, kulttuuri, hyvinvointi, työmatkat...)Tunnistatko itsesi tästä?- Sinulla on kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja asiakkuuksien johtamisesta- Ymmärrät taloushallinnon toimintaympäristöä ja asiantuntijatyön arkea- Osaat organisoida, priorisoida ja delegoida- Johdat mielelläsi esimerkillä ja saat muut innostumaan ja onnistumaan- Viestit selkeästi ja rakennat sujuvaa yhteistyötä niin tiimin kuin asiakkaidenkin kanssa- Haluat aidosti kehittää toimintaa ja viedä asioita eteenpäinTehtävässä eduksi katsotaan- Matkailualan liiketoiminnan tai alan yritysten taloushallinnon tuntemus. Se on tehtävässä hyödyksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä.Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä, jossa- yhdessä tekeminen näkyy arjessa- tukea saa aina, ja ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava- arvostamme kehittämishalua, vastuullisuutta ja aitoa kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseenToimimme Aallon arvojen mukaisesti: Osaan, Palvelen, Huolehdin, Kehityn. Yhdessä muodostamme tilitoimiston – monimuotoisen työyhteisön, työpaikan ja asiantuntijaorganisaation, jossa jokainen meistä voi työskennellä ylpeyttä, tyytyväisyyttä ja turvallisuutta tuntien. Yhteistyö kanssamme perustuu molemminpuoliseen kunnioitukseen, luottamukseen ja rehellisyyteen. Uskomme menestyksen kumpuavan tyytyväisistä asiantuntijoista, jotka mahdollistavat tyytyväiset asiakkaat. Strategiamme ydinajatus kulminoituu Aallon sloganiin Tilitoimistoni.Kiinnostuitko? Lähetäthän hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian – käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Voit hakea helposti LinkedIn -profiililla tai CV:llä.Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:LiiketoimintajohtajaKirsi Mattila-Suokirsi.mattila-suo@aallon.fiTavoitat minut puhelimitse numerosta 0503687024 seuraavina aikoina: Keskiviikkona 4.11. klo 14-15, maanantaina 9.11. klo 12-13 ja perjantaina 13.11. klo 12-13.30

jobs.title: Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S
jobs.description:
Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S

Har du øje for kvalitet, teknisk forståelse og lyst til at arbejde tæt på byggeprocessen?

Hos Firesafe Danmark A/S søger vi to kvalitetssikringsmedarbejdere til at styrke vores kvalitetssikring inden for passiv brandsikring og isolering. Vi søger strukturerede og kvalitetsbevidste medarbejdere med teknisk forståelse.

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du kombinerer praktiske kvalitetstilsyn på byggepladsen med teknisk opfølgning og dokumentation. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med montører, projektledere og øvrige kolleger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

·         Udføre løbende kvalitetstilsyn og kontrol af passiv brandsikring og isoleringsarbejde.

·         Kontrollere, at arbejdet udføres i overensstemmelse med tekniske tegninger, montagevejledninger og gældende krav.

·         Identificere kvalitetsafvigelser og følge op på nødvendige udbedringer.

·         Udarbejde og vedligeholde kvalitetsdokumentation samt registrere og følge op på opgaver i Dalux og BIM.

·         Vejlede montører i korrekte arbejdsmetoder og tekniske løsninger, herunder demonstrere korrekt udførelse.

·         Samarbejde med ledelsen om tekniske afklaringer, koordinering og kvalitetsopfølgning.

Vi forventer, at du:

•         Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for kvalitetssikring.

•         Kan læse og forstå bygningstegninger og teknisk dokumentation.

•         Arbejder selvstændigt, systematisk og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

•         Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

•         Er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer og har lyst til at arbejde med kvalitetsdokumentation.

•         Kan vejlede montører og følge op på kvaliteten af det udførte arbejde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har:

•         Erfaring med kvalitetssikring og kontrol i byggebranchen.

•         Kendskab til passiv brandsikring, isolering eller lignende teknisk arbejde.

•         Erfaring med Dalux og BIM.

•         Gode danskkundskaber og kendskab til flere sprog.

Der stilles ikke krav om en bestemt uddannelse, dog er det en fordele hvis man har en teknisk baggrund. 

Vi tilbyder

•         Fast fuldtidsstilling på minimum 37 timer om ugen.

•         Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

•         Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring samt pension og øvrige vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

•         Firmatelefon, computer og andet relevant udstyr i forbindelse med arbejdet.

•         En varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og administrative opgaver.

•         Et arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Om Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S arbejder med passiv brandsikring og relaterede tekniske ydelser på byggeprojekter. Vi bidrager til at beskytte mennesker, bygninger og værdier gennem korrekt udførelse og dokumentation af brandtekniske løsninger.

Hos os bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus.

Ansøgning

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig?

Send dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge jobbet til info@firesafe.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

  

Quality Assurance Employee Wanted at Firesafe Danmark A/S

Do you have an eye for detail, a strong technical understanding, and a passion for ensuring high quality workmanship on construction sites?

Firesafe Danmark A/S is looking to recruit two Quality Assurance Employees to strengthen our quality assurance team within passive fire protection and insulation works.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

How to Apply

Interested in joining our team?

Please submit your CV along with a short description of your motivation for applying to info@firesafe.dk

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk for further information.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Raskaskoneasentaja, Kankaanpää
jobs.description: Raskaan kaluston asentaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Etsitkö vakaata työpaikkaa, jossa on reilu meininki, mahdollisuus kehittyä ja osaamista arvostava palkkaus?Asiakkaamme on pitkään toiminut ja hyvämaineinen huoltokorjaamo, joka etsii nyt tiimiinsä kokoaikaista ja vakituista raskaan kaluston asentajaa. Tässä roolissa pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti kuorma-autojen, perävaunujen ja erilaisten työkoneiden parissa. Työskentelet pääasiassa arkipäivisin klo 7.00–17.30 välillä. Toivomme kuitenkin joustavuutta, sillä työpäivien pituudet saattavat vaihdella työtilanteen mukaan. Tulevaisuudessa yrityksessä on mahdollista siirtyä 2-vuorotyöhön, ja toisinaan töitä tehdään myös viikonloppuisin. Saat vahvan tuen ja perusteellisen perehdytyksen – meillä kaveria ei jätetä yksin. Palkkaus määräytyy AKT:n huoltokorjaamoalan työehtosopimuksen ja kokemuksesi mukaan. Erikoisosaamisesta olemme valmiita maksamaan erillistä ekstraa.Mikäli muutat työn perässä toiselta paikkakunnalta, voimme auttaa sinua asunnon hankinnassa. Odotamme sinulta alan koulutusta ja jonkin verran aikaisempaa työkokemusta raskaan kaluston parista, oikeaa asennetta ja vastuuntuntoa sekä tiimihenkeä. Suomen kielen C1 (Taitavan kielitaidon perustaso) vaaditaan työturvallisuuden vuoksi, sekä sujuvaan kommunikointiin muiden työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden kanssa. Mikäli tämä työ kiinnostaa sinua, laita hakemuksesi tulemaan samantien sillä käymme niitä läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Toivomme sinulta:- Hyvää asennetta ja halua sitoutua mukavaan työpaikkaan ja työympäristöön- Joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen- Voimassa olevaa Työturvallisuuskorttia- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa- Ajokorttia c-kortti iso plussa hakijalle- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja ahkeruutta- Mielellään kokemusta raskaan kaluston asennuksista  Tarjoamme sinulle: - Luotettavan ja hyvän työnantajan- Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön- Laadukkaat työvarusteet- Mahdollisuuden työllistyä pitkäaikaiseen työhön- Työterveyshuollon Palkkausperuste: Tuntipalkka 16,47-19,85 €/hBenevanilla arvostamme: - Luotettavuutta - tehdään mitä sovitaan- Asennetta -teet aina parhaasi ja olet oma-aloitteinen- Työturvallisuutta - arvostamme työntekijöitä, joille työturvallisuus on tärkeää- Uskallus tarttua uusiin haasteisiin

jobs.title: Ingénieur DevOps (H/F)
jobs.description: L'Ingénieur(e) DevOps contribue à la conception, à l'automatisation et à la fiabilisation des infrastructures Luminess. Il/elle garantit la disponibilité, la sécurité et la performance des plateformes, en lien direct avec les équipes de développement. Votre mission- Concevoir et configurer les environnements selon l'architecture définie (performance, sécurité, coûts),- Automatiser les plateformes via l'IaC (Terraform, Puppet) et les pratiques internes (CI/CD, supervision, sauvegarde),- Déployer les architectures (OnPremise ou Cloud Outscale),- Réaliser les recettes techniques et assurer la transition vers le Run,- Mettre en œuvre la conteneurisation (Kubernetes) et les modules de déploiement,- Structurer et documenter : templates, guidelines, process,- Industrialiser : monitoring, sauvegardes, patch management, conformité sécurité,- Améliorer en continu les outils et pratiques,- Accompagner les nouveaux collaborateurs et contribuer à la montée en compétence de l'équipe,- Collaborer avec les équipes de développement pour garantir cohérence et qualité.Qui vous êtesProfil recherchéNous accueillons différents parcours :- SysOps / DevOps senior (5 ans min.), expert cloud et automatisation,- Développeur Python ou PHP ayant de bonnes connaissances réseaux souhaitant évoluer vers les infrastructures,- Ingénieur systèmes ou réseaux orienté cloud, à l'aise avec les environnements virtualisés ou conteneurisés.Votre expérience peut venir d'une ESN, scaleup, éditeur logiciel, infogérance, cloud provider ou DSI interne. Vous maîtrisezArchitecture cloud (Outscale / Azure/ AWS), Kubernetes /Docker, IaC (Terraform, Puppet), VM & sauvegardes, Pipeline CI/CD (Jenkins, Git/Gitflow), Linux, sécurité, performance, serveurs web.Outils : Nutanix, Cloud Outscale, Apache, Rundeck, PostgreSQL/MySQL.Le poste est indiqué sur Laval mais en fonction de votre lieu de résidence il peut-être basé sur Rennes, Compétences personnellesAdaptabilité, communication claire, esprit analytique, pédagogie, travail en équipe, rigueur, sens du service et partage de connaissances.Le groupe LuminessConfiance / Audace / Responsabilité / ExcellenceRejoignez un acteur en pleine transformation au cœur des enjeux de l'IA, de la confiance numérique et des parcours métierChez Luminess, nous avons une ambition claire : devenir un partenaire de référence de la transformation des parcours métier critiques des secteurs Banque, Assurance, Mutuelles et Public.Pour y parvenir, nous ouvrons un nouveau chapitre de notre développement.Nous investissons massivement dans l'intelligence artificielle, l'automatisation, la confiance numérique et la transformation des parcours métier afin d'accompagner les plus grandes organisations françaises dans leurs enjeux les plus stratégiques : amélioration de l'expérience client, conformité réglementaire, lutte contre la fraude, accélération des décisions et excellence opérationnelle.Notre objectif est ambitieux : accélérer fortement notre croissance d'ici 2030 en renforçant notre présence sur nos marchés stratégiques et en développant de nouvelles offres à forte valeur ajoutée.

jobs.title: Herning - Lager - Tungt arbejde
jobs.description:
Lagerarbejdere søges til Herning – 2 ledige stillinger

Er du typen, der trives med et aktivt arbejde, hvor dagene går stærkt, og hvor du kan se resultatet af din indsats? Har du lyst til at blive en del af et godt lagerteam med hurtig opstart, så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

  • Manuel håndtering af varer

Vi tilbyder

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med hjælpsomme kollegaer

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send dit CV til mail@vikarringen.dk og husk at skrive "TUNGT" i emnefeltet.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet de rette kandidater. Derfor anbefaler vi, at du sender din ansøgning allerede i dag.

jobs.title: QEHS Engineer
jobs.description: Are you a proactive quality, environmental, health and safety professional who enjoys improving processes and working closely with production?**We are looking for a forward-thinking QEHS ENGINEER to join our team in Mäntyharju, Finland!**At Exel Composites, quality, health & safety, environmental responsibility and continuous improvement are integral parts of our daily operations. As our new QEHS Engineer, you will play an important role in developing these areas at our Mäntyharju manufacturing site. You will work closely with production and collaborate with application engineering, supply chain, and other functions. You will also interact with customers, suppliers, auditors and authorities as part of your responsibilities.This is a permanent position located at Exel Composites manufacturing site in Mäntyharju, Finland. The position reports to the Site Leader, Mäntyharju.**YOUR ROLE**You will coordinate and develop daily quality, environmental, occupational health and safety activities, ensuring compliance with customer, legal and certification requirements. The role also includes supervising the Mäntyharju laboratory team.Your key responsibilities include:- Maintain QEHS systems and documentation, and coordinate audits and follow-up with the QEHS Manager Finland. - Coordinate risk assessments, incident investigations, safety walks and follow-up actions. - Manage customer complaints, nonconformities and CAPA, including root-cause analysis, reporting and follow-up. - Support production, supplier and new-product quality, improve processes and reduce scrap through continuous improvement. - Monitor environmental compliance and support waste, chemical, emissions and environmental incident management. - Support occupational health, ergonomics and wellbeing with occupational health services. - Organise safety and quality training and inductions, monitor and report QEHS performance. - Act as the site's QEHS contact for customers and authorities within your remit, supporting visits and inspections. **WHAT YOU BRING**You take a practical, solution-focused and organised approach, turning analysis into improvements and involving others in change. You work comfortably in a manufacturing environment.You have:- B.Sc. degree in engineering, mechanical engineering, chemistry or another relevant field. - Experience working in an industrial environment. - Knowledge of quality and production-improvement methods and relevant legal and certification requirements. - Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems, together with auditing skills. - Strong analytical, root-cause problem-solving and reporting skills. - Good communication skills, with the ability to drive practical improvements. - Good Finnish and English language skills, both written and spoken. **WHAT WE VALUE**The following are considered advantages:- Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, statistical tools, or quality-management and ERP systems. - QEHS experience in manufacturing, particularly chemicals or composites. - Experience with environmental permits, authorities, supplier quality, customer audits or new-product development. - Previous supervisory or team-leadership experience. **WHAT WE OFFER**We offer a varied, hands-on role where you can make a tangible impact on quality, safety and environmental performance at our Mäntyharju site. Working with advanced composite technologies in an international environment, you will collaborate across functions and locations to improve production processes and everyday practices. Your responsibilities will span operational improvement, management systems, audits and stakeholder cooperation, with scope to shape the role around your skills and experience.**INTERESTED?** We look forward to receiving your application and CV, including your salary expectations, by November 22, 2026.

Your responsibilities will encompass supporting the data centers IT infrastructure, troubleshooting and resolving hardware issues, and ensuring the smooth operation of critical systems. jobs.title: Kaupallinen ja tekninen päällikkö, Tammer Diesel
jobs.description: _Tammer Diesel on Tampereella vuonna 1954 perustettu perheyritys. Tammer Diesel työllistää noin 70 henkilöä ja liikevaihto on noin 12 milj. €. Lue lisää www.tammerdiesel.fi_Etsimme nyt **KAUPALLISTA JA TEKNISTÄ PÄÄLLIKKÖÄ** eläköitymisen vuoksi Tampereelle.Tässä tehtävässä yhdistyvät strateginen vastuu ja käytännön tekeminen. Olet mukana rakentamassa liiketoiminnan suuntaa, mutta ennen kaikkea viet asioita eteenpäin: hankit uusia asiakkaita, kasvatat nykyisiä asiakkuuksia, kehität kaupallisia toimintamalleja ja varmistat, että tekninen osaaminen muuttuu asiakkaille lisäarvoa tuottaviksi ja liiketoiminnallisesti kannattaviksi ratkaisuiksi. Osallistut johtoryhmän jäsenenä yrityksen strategiatyöhön ja vastaat kasvuun liittyvien strategisten kokonaisuuksien edistämisestä.**Tehtävässä:**- johdat neljän hengen myyntitiimiä ja osallistut itse aktiivisesti myyntityöhön, asiakastapaamisiin ja kaupallisiin neuvotteluihin - vastaat aktiivisesta uusasiakashankinnasta ja uusien yritysasiakkuuksien rakentamisesta - vastaat myynnin tavoitteellisesta kehittämisestä, kannattavasta kasvusta ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä - viet palvelu- ja tuotekehitystä systemaattisempaan suuntaan ja kehität tapoja muuttaa teknistä osaamista selkeiksi, monistettaviksi ja kaupallisesti kannattaviksi ratkaisuiksi - kehität tarjouslaskentaa, konseptisuunnittelua ja tarjousten muodostamista yhdessä asiantuntijoiden kanssa - kehität myynnin, tarjouslaskennan, hinnoittelun ja tuotehallinnan prosesseja sujuvammiksi ja tehokkaammiksi - varmistat, että ERP-järjestelmä tukee käytännön myyntityötä, tuotehallintaa ja hinnastojen hallintaa mahdollisimman hyvin Tehtävässä menestyy parhaiten henkilö, jolla on vahva tekninen ymmärrys (polttomoottorit /koneenrakennus /huoltotoiminnot) sekä kaupallinen draivi. Tunnistat kasvumahdollisuuksia, rakennat luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita ja osaat viedä myyntiprosessia tavoitteellisesti eteenpäin. Ymmärrät myös, miten tarjouslaskenta, hinnoittelu, tuotteistaminen ja toimivat prosessit vaikuttavat myynnin onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan kannattavuuteen.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**- vahvaa teknistä osaamista ja kykyä hahmottaa teknisiä kokonaisuuksia - kokemusta B2B-myynnistä, suurasiakkuuksista tai teknisestä ratkaisumyynnistä. Kokemus B2C-myynnistä katsotaan eduksi. - kokemusta prosessien, palveluiden tai tuotteiden kehittämisestä ja kaupallistamisesta - osaamista nykyaikaisten markkinointikanavien hyödyntämisestä - hyviä johtamistaitoja ja kykyä saada tiimi onnistumaan yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamisessa - analyyttistä ja kehittävää työotetta sekä ymmärrystä liiketoiminnan tunnusluvuista - rohkeutta tarttua toimeen, tehdä päätöksiä ja viedä asioita eteenpäin myös silloin, kun valmista toimintamallia ei vielä ole - suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa **Miksi tämä tehtävä on kiinnostava?**Tammer Dieselillä saat vastuullisen työtehtävän johtoryhmän jäsenenä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten myydään, mitä asiakkaille tarjotaan ja miten tulevaisuuden kasvua rakennetaan. Saat keskeisen roolin strategisessa työssä ja toimit tiiviisti myös hallituksen kanssa. Työsuhde-etuihin kuuluu kattava vakuutus, liikunta– ja lounasetu sekä huollot ja varaosat henkilökuntahintaan. Asiakkaat sijaitsevat pääosin Suomessa, joten tehtävässä pääset tapaamaan asiakkaita ja tekemään yhteistyötä heidän kanssaan ilman jatkuvaa matkustamista. Asiakastyö onnistuu pääosin päivämatkoilla.Jos liiketoiminnan vahvistaminen, myynti, tuote- ja palvelukehitys sekä sisäisäisten prosessien määrätietoinen kehittäminen kuulostavat sinun paikaltasi, niin jätäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian mutta viimeistään 17.11.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Helmihunter Kati Kulin, puh. +358 40 7160 379.

jobs.title: Souschef til køkken i Pincho Nation Horsens
jobs.description:
Er du klar til et job, hvor du kan vokse, bidrage til et fedt arbejdsmiljø og lede og motivere personale? Vi søger en Souschef til vores køkkenteam!

Om osVi er Pincho Nation, et sprudlende og anderledes restaurantkoncept med små tapasretter, ekstraordinære drinks og en oplevelse lidt ud over det sædvanlige. I vores kommende restaurant i Horsens lægger vi stor vægt på gæsteoplevelse, kvalitet, og teamwork. Hos os får du mulighed for at udvikle dig og være en vigtig del af vores team. Vi er passionerede omkring at skabe magiske oplevelser, og vi leder efter en, som deler denne passion.

Din rolleSom Souschef vil du arbejdet tæt sammen med Head Chef. Det er dit job at administrere og lede restaurantens køkkenproduktion når Head Chef ikke er der. Du er ansvarlig for at sikre at service forløber godt og effektivt, og at gæsteservice, hygiejne og produktivitet følger Pincho Nations standarder, såvel som resten af køkkenpersonalet. Som Souschef får du chancen for at udvikle både dit team, men også ansatte individuelt. En af vores kerneværdier er “people before business". Derfor bør det altid være en hovedprioritet for vores ledere at sikre en god produktkvalitet og samtidigt lede dit team på en omsorgsfuld og motiverende vis.

Hvem er du?Vi leder efter en, der:

  • Er motiveret for at arbejde i restaurationsbranchen og gerne vil være en del af vores koncept.

  • Ønsker at bidrage til et godt og positivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Er ansvarlig, engageret og trives i et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø.

  • Har erfaring fra lignende roller.

Hvad vi tilbyder:

  • Fællesskab og godt arbejdsmiljø: Vi sætter stor pris på et positivt arbejdsmiljø, og vi er altid klar på at hygge os sammen både på og udenfor arbejdet.

  • Løn: Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Medarbejderfordele: Personalerabat i alle vores restauranter, inkl. restauranter uden for Danmark, samt personaleevents.

Er du klar til at søge?Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! Send din ansøgning og CV og fortæl os, hvorfor du har lyst til at være en del af vores team.

Ansøgninger behandles løbende, og vi afholder samtaler løbende. Stillingen besættes, så snart vi finder den rette kandidat, så vi opfordrer dig til at sende din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Ansættelsesstart er 1. februar 2027.

Pincho Nation is a vibrant and unique restaurant concept offering small tapas dishes, extraordinary cocktails, and an experience beyond the ordinary. In our coming restaurant in Horsens, we place great emphasis on guest experience, quality, and teamwork.

  • Is motivated to work in the restaurant industry and excited to be part of our unique concept.

  • Wants to contribute to a positive and supportive working environment.

  • Is responsible, committed, and thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic workplace.

  • Has experience from a similar leadership role in a professional kitchen.

  • Enjoys coaching, developing, and motivating others.

What We Offer

Great Team Spirit and Work Environment

We highly value a positive workplace culture and enjoy spending time together both during and outside of work.

Salary will be based on qualifications and experience.

  • Staff discounts at all Pincho Nation restaurants, including locations outside Denmark.

  • Employee events and social activities.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional development within a growing restaurant concept.

We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.title: Client Accounting Division Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. Because of our demonstrated value, our clients have raised more than $17.8B!

At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees.

We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us!


Role Summary

The Client Accounting Division Manager runs their division as a self-contained business unit within Burkland. The role owns the division's P&L and staffing, and is accountable not only for its own scorecard but for the aggregate performance of every KPI held by roles within the division. Success is measured by both business and people outcomes: revenue, margin, utilization, service quality, and client retention, alongside the growth and engagement of the people doing the work. The division supports consumer and product-based startups, so the manager brings deep inventory and cost accounting expertise to guide the teamâs technical work and client advice.

This is a hands-on people leadership role. The manager is expected to understand strengths and development needs of each team member in their business unit, set clear expectations, give consistent feedback, address performance issues early, and build a team that can deliver both accounting and proactive advisory work at a high standard. The manager also owns key client relationships and serves as the first-line escalation point for client issues, with a defined handoff path for anything beyond their resolution.

This job description outlines the core of the role, but it isn't meant to cover everything you'll do. As Burkland grows, your responsibilities may shift and new projects, tasks, or priorities may be added along the way. We hope you'll see that as a chance to stretch, learn, and broaden your contributions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Division Performance and KPI Accountability

  • Own the business unit's P&L, including revenue, margin, and utilization targets.

  • Drive aggregate performance across all KPIs assigned to Accounting Associates and Client Accounting Advisors, in addition to the manager's own scorecard.

  • Track division performance regularly, identify gaps early, and take corrective action at the individual and team level.

  • Report on division results to the Director of Accounting Advisory, including risks, trends, and planned actions.

  • Manage capacity and workload distribution across the division as well as assigning clients.

  • Contribute to pricing and fixed-fee scoping, and monitor engagement profitability.

  • Maintain awareness of AR and collections for division clients and address issues with the appropriate teams.

People Leadership and Staffing

  • Set clear role expectations and performance goals tied to the KPIs each team member owns.

  • Lead regular, structured 1:1s focused on goals, workload, development, and wellbeing, not only status updates. Use them to give direct, ongoing feedback that recognizes strong work and addresses gaps as they appear, rather than waiting for review cycles.

  • Create clear growth plans and provide ongoing coaching to develop each team member, in partnership with the Director and People Team

  • Conduct performance reviews, manage performance concerns directly, and contribute to compensation and promotion recommendations.

  • Monitor team capacity and engagement to support retention and prevent burnout.

  • Apply company policies consistently, manage time-off and leave requests, and bring performance concerns, employee relations matters, and escalations to the Director and People Team for guidance and resolution.

  • Plan staffing against current and forecasted client demand and build the business case for new headcount.

  • Lead hiring for the division through interviewing and selection, and onboard new team members so they reach full productivity within expected timelines.

Inventory Accounting and Technical Oversight

  • Oversee inventory valuation, reconciliation, and physical and cycle count processes across the divisionâs client portfolio, making sure variances are investigated and resolved quickly.

  • Set standards for costing methods (FIFO, LIFO, weighted average) and ensure the team applies them correctly by client and industry.

  • Ensure the team delivers accurate GAAP financial statements, inventory reporting, and COGS and gross margin analysis tailored to each clientâs business model.

  • Guide ERP and inventory software implementations, migrations, and improvements (partnering with ERP specialist where needed), and ensure client records stay audit-ready (as appropriate for the engagement size and scope).

  • Coach the team to help clients reduce shrinkage, obsolescence, overstocking, and stockouts, and to improve working capital through metrics like inventory turnover and days on hand.

  • Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations

Client Relationships and Service Quality

  • Act as an escalation point for client relationship issues.

  • Oversee quality control to ensure deliverables meet firm standards.

  • Shift the team's work from solely report delivery toward proactive advisory.

Growth and Operations

  • Own growth of the division's book of business through business development efforts to expand existing client relationships and identify service-expansion opportunities

  • Maintain accurate, current portfolio information in Knownwell

  • Drive full adoption of firm tools, systems, and processes, including AI-enabled workflows

Group and Company Success

A One Burkland mindset:

Our clients are best served when teams work together, not in silos. Partner closely with Tax, CFO, HR, and other service lines to create consistency, share knowledge, and deliver a seamless client experience across Burkland.

  • Comfort with an increasing pace of change:

Today's pace is the slowest we will experience going forward, not a finish line before things settle. As AI and related tools evolve, our processes evolve with them. This allows for more chances to learn, grow, and shape how the work gets done.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-driven efficiency:

Proactively look for smarter ways of working as new tools come online. This is about changing how the work gets done, not reducing the need for skilled people to do it.

  • A constructive attitude:

Attitude is contagious in both directions, across the team and with clients. Approach change with curiosity and enthusiasm. Help to set that tone for others rather than defaulting to resistance.

  • Full adoption of firm tools and processes:

Systems are critical to growth and often fail to be effective when only part of the team uses them well.

  • Delivery and proactive advisory:

Build real understanding of where each client's business is headed and advise ahead of it. Clients need the why behind their numbers, not just the numbers.

Core Competencies & Skills

  • Financial Acumen â cost management, margin analysis, fixed-fee scope adjustments, and AR/collections awareness.

  • Client Relationshipsâ Client relationship management, escalation handling, and spotting cross-sell and service-expansion opportunities.

  • Advisory mindset â Moving teams from report delivery alone to proactive advisory.

  • Leading Change â Champions of change, including AI-driven efficiency, leading by example in the consistent adoption of firm tools, systems and processes and reinforcing them across the team.

  • AI Fluency â Hands-on comfort using AI tools in accounting and operational work, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human review is required, and how to protect client data.

  • Cross-functional collaboration â Build strong working relationships across Service Delivery, partnering with other teams on shared client work and aligning with Growth on new client onboarding and cross-sell opportunities

  • Inventory and Cost Accounting Expertise â Deep knowledge of inventory accounting, costing methods, COGS, and GAAP, with the ability to guide a team through complex inventory work and system implementations. Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations as well as eCommerce operations and cash flows through Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and other marketplace solutions.

Minimum Requirements / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, accounting, finance, or a related field, and 5+ years of progressive professional experience

  • Direct people management experience, including conducting performance reviews, managing underperformance, and developing team members

  • Exceptional client relationship management skills and the ability to understand client needs

  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality results

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, team members, and leadership

  • Curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and an eagerness to take on new challenges involving emerging technology and industries

  • Strong command of GAAP and cost accounting, including inventory accounting (FIFO, LIFO, landed costs, shrinkage, and valuation adjustments)

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or CMA credential

  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to a team budget, P&L, or book of business

  • Prior experience leading a team within a professional services or client accounting environment

  • Hands-on ERP and inventory system experience (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Cin7, Fishbowl, or similar)

  • Experience leading or overseeing ERP or inventory software implementations

Â 

Physical & Environmental Demands

This is a remote position. Work is primarily performed at a computer for extended periods, requiring the ability to use a keyboard, view a screen, and communicate via video and phone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EEO Statement

Burkland Associates is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Burkland Associates is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or another legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please visit our careers page https://burklandassociates.com/careers/. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (London)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Replit is experiencing extraordinary demand and seeking an Enterprise Account Executive with strong communication skills to drive our hyper-growth. Candidates with SaaS experience, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.



This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for driving sales and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ushering in a change in the nature of the firm on par with the PC era

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects and customers, guiding them through the buying journey

 - Conduct compelling product demonstrations and help realize the art of the possible by orchestrating non-engineering hackathons

 - Articulate Replit's value proposition and align it with customers' business objectives

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure technical accuracy and successful delivery

 - Prepare tailored quotes and skillfully negotiate deals

 - Maintain accurate customer and forecasting data in Replit’s CRM (Hubspot)

 - Foster strong relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities for expanded adoption

 - Optimize customers' use of the Replit platform through ongoing collaboration and support

 - Gather and communicate valuable customer feedback, championing their interests within Replit



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Experience in AE or SE/technical sales role, preferably in SaaS or developer tools

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas

 - Experience with, or direct observations of full-cycle sales, from prospecting to closing deals to managing existing customers

 - Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot)

 - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet

 - Self-motivated with excellent time management and organizational skills

 - Passion for technology and staying current with industry trends

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus

 - Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for client meetings and events
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
   
   


TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE:

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM

 - ZoomInfo

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

 - You’re not based in London area

 - You lack an understanding of the software development lifecycle; have little to no coding knowledge

 - You’re not passionate about AI

 - You don’t enjoy being in client facing roles where 80% of your day is talking to others





Note: This role will begin as remote, with plans to transition to a hybrid model once we establish a local office presence.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

  • KV- tehničkog usmjerenja
  • Jedna godina radnog iskustva na poslovima traktoriste
  • Vozačka dozvola B ili G kategorije
  • Stručno osposobljavanje za rukovatelja traktorom
  • Izobrazba o održivoj uporabi pesticida za korisnika

NUDIMO:

  • ugovor na određeno vrijeme uz mogućnost zasnivanja stalnog radnog odnosa,
  • mogućnost napredovanja i dodatnog usavršavanja,
  • timski rad, dinamično i stabilno poslovno okruženje

jobs.description:
MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA- MEHATRONIČAR/MEHATRONIČARKA

Kao obiteljsko poduzeće znamo da su ljudi ti, koji svojim znanjem i vještinama pridonose našem uspjehu. Isto im vraćamo sa stimulativnim primanjima i korporativnom kulturom u kojoj se žive obiteljske vrijednosti. Želimo biti više od skupine timova u jednom poduzeću. Međusobna suradnja znači za nas međusobnu povezanost. Svi smo složni u uvjerenju da zajedno postižemo velike stvari.

Kao poduzeće. Kao tim. Kao obitelj.

Očekuju te sljedeći zadaci:

  • Redovito održavanje strojeva u proizvodnom pogonu
  • Utvrđivanje i otklanjanje kvarova na strojevima
  • Izvođenje servisa, remonta i montaže strojeva
  • Briga o zalihi rezervnih dijelova
  • Godišnje provođenje ispitivanja elektro uređaja

Što donosiš sa sobom:

  • Završena škola: elektrotehničar, elektromehaničar, mehatroničar ili električar, stručnjak za pneumatiku i hidrauliku
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo minimalno 2 godine u području održavanja pneumatskih i hidrauličnih strojeva
  • Pouzdanost i samostalnost u obavljanju radnih zadataka
  • Izraženi timski duh
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Poželjno poznavanje engleskog ili njemačkog jezika u govoru i pismu

Što te očekuje:

  • Rad u internacionalnom okruženju
  • Stimulativna primanja
  • Mogućnost napredovanja
  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme
  • Poticajna i prijateljska radna atmosfera
  • Uvođenje u posao pod vodstvom mentora
  • Dvosmjenski rad
  • Vrhunska oprema i postrojenje
  • Veliki benefit paket (npr. team building, božićni domjenak, sportske aktivnosti, osiguranje 0-24, uplata u 3. mirovinski stup i još mnoge pogodnosti)

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Productization Specialist / Product Lifecycle Engineer to join a New Product Introduction (NPI) team responsible for bringing new products successfully from development into production.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

In this role, you will act as a key link between R&D, production, sales, and business operations, ensuring that new products, features, and solutions are implemented efficiently and according to agreed processes. You will play an important role in developing productization practices, supporting projects, and helping the organization scale new products into successful business.

Key Responsibilities:
 Coordinate the implementation of new products into production
 Develop and maintain productization concepts and best practices
 Support R&D, production, and sales throughout different project phases
 Ensure adherence to agreed business processes and transfer-to-business procedures
 Gather and specify requirements for new functionalities and process improvements
 Participate in testing and validation activities

What Were Looking For:
 B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Engineering or a related field
 Minimum 2 years of experience in productization, NPI, manufacturing engineering, or a similar role
 Understanding of electronics and software product development environments

 Ability to define requirements, follow development work, and participate in testing (coding experience is not required)
 Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

- Do you have experience using Azure DevOps or similar lifecycle management tools?*
- Have you participated in testing, validation, or implementation activities for new products or processes?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

jobs.description:
India Spice is a passionate Indian restaurant and catering kitchen with a deep love for rich flavors, authentic spices, and traditional culinary craftsmanship.

We are best known for our vibrant North and South Indian specialties, aromatic curries, andtandoor dishes, but most importantly, we believe in making authentic food from scratch,using fresh, high-quality ingredients and taking pride in the tradition behind everything we serve.

For us, India Spice is about more than serving great meals. It is about warm hospitality, creating memorable dining experiences, and treating our guests, team members, and partners with respect. We are an ambitious, growing business, but we also want India Spice to be a workplace where people take pride in what they do, enjoy coming to work, and feel a shared responsibility for our quality and standards.

Currently, our operations cover our busy restaurant service, takeaway, and event catering, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization and operational flow of our kitchen.

As our Kitchen Manager, you will play a central role in keeping the kitchen structured, efficient, and running smoothly across daily prep, restaurant service, and catering orders.

Key Responsibilities:

• Overall coordination and operational organization of the kitchen

• Maintaining strict hygiene and food safety standards according to Danish Fødevarestyrelsen regulations

• Staff scheduling and daily task delegation for kitchen and prep staff

• Overseeing kitchen maintenance, ensuring equipment, tandoors, and workstations remain clean and in peak condition

• Purchasing, ordering ingredients, spices, packaging, and operational supplies

• Inventory management and stock control to ensure availability for high-volume weekends and large catering orders

• Establishing clear prep routines, portion control, and workflow improvements as our catering demands expand

• Collaborating closely with our chefs and front-of-house team to ensure consistent food quality and punctual service

Qualifications & Qualities:

• Experience working in a professional kitchen, catering operation, or food production environment is an advantage, but having the right mindset is what matters most.

• You are structured, dependable, and punctual, with natural ownership over your responsibilities.

• You are proactive, notice details quickly, and thrive when bringing order and smooth routines to a fast-paced environment.

• You communicate clearly and comfortably in English (Danish is a plus, but not required).

Practical Information

• Position: Kitchen Manager

• Hours: Full-time (37 hours per week)

• Location: Søborg Hovedgade 118, 2860 Søborg

• Salary: Competitive, based on qualifications and experience

• Start Date: As soon as possible / By agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV to info@indiaspice.dk with the subject line "Application: Kitchen Manager – India Spice".

If you have any questions regarding the role or India Spice, feel free to contact us at info@indiaspice.dk.

We review applications continuously and look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to the India Spice family.

Support Engineer I (FC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Barchef søges til Sukiaba på toppen af det ikoniske Bella Sky
jobs.description:
Barchef – SUKAIBA

Vil du stå i spidsen for en af Københavns mest spektakulære cocktailbarer?

På toppen af Bella Sky finder du Restaurant Sukaiba – en Restaurant og Cocktail bar som er en del af Norrlyst Koncernen, hvor gastronomi, udsigt og atmosfære smelter sammen i en helstøbt gæsteoplevelse.

Her forenes asiatisk inspireret gastronomi med ambitiøse vin- og cocktailparringer og en professionel servicekultur, hvor kvalitet, kreativitet og værtskab går hånd i hånd.

Vi søger nu en passioneret og visionær Barchef, der vil tage ejerskab over vores cocktailbar og være med til at udvikle den til noget helt særligt. En fagligt stærk profil, der brænder for cocktails, værtskab og ledelse, og som kan skabe retning, engagement og høj kvalitet i baren.

ROLLEN

Som Barchef får du det overordnede ansvar for cocktailbarens daglige drift, udvikling og personale. Du bliver den faglige drivkraft bag baren og får en central rolle i at sætte standarden for både kvalitet, kreativitet og gæsteoplevelser.

Du arbejder i tæt samarbejde med Restaurantchefen og indgår som en vigtig del af restaurantens samlede ledelsesteam. Med reference til Restaurantchefen har du selvstændigt ansvar for cocktailbaren og dens medarbejdere.

Dine ansvarsområder omfatter:

  • Det overordnede ansvar for cocktailbarens daglige drift og performance

  • Ledelse, udvikling og motivation af barens bartendere

  • Rekruttering, onboarding og oplæring af nye medarbejdere i samarbejde med Restaurantchefen

  • Udvikling og løbende fornyelse af cocktailkortet med fokus på kreativitet, kvalitet og sæsonens råvarer

  • Sikring af høje faglige standarder inden for cocktails, præsentation og værtskab

  • Ansvar for barens indkøb, lagerstyring, vareforbrug og omkostningsoptimering

  • Udvikling af nye cocktailkoncepter og kreative drinksoplevelser

  • Sikring af struktur, arbejdsrutiner og effektive arbejdsgange bag baren

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkkenet og Restaurantchefen om vin- og cocktailparringer samt restaurantens samlede gæsteoplevelse

  • Aktiv deltagelse i driften, hvor du går forrest og viser vejen for dit team

Du er både en kreativ cocktailprofil og en stærk leder. Du formår at kombinere passionen for håndværket med struktur, økonomisk forståelse og evnen til at udvikle mennesker.

VI SØGER DIG, DER

  • Har minimum 3 års erfaring fra cocktail- eller restaurantbranchen

  • Har solid erfaring med cocktailhåndværk og en naturlig interesse for nye teknikker, smage og trends

  • Gerne har erfaring fra en lignende rolle som Barchef, Assistant Bar Manager eller Lead Bartender

  • Har erfaring med personaleledelse eller et naturligt talent for at motivere og udvikle andre

  • Har forståelse for økonomi, vareforbrug, lagerstyring og indkøb

  • Brænder for værtskab og for at skabe ekstraordinære gæsteoplevelser

  • Arbejder struktureret og tager naturligt ansvar for både kvalitet og drift

  • Er kreativ, initiativrig og ikke bange for at udfordre det eksisterende

  • Er en holdspiller med positiv energi og en professionel tilgang til samarbejde

Du har ambitioner på barens vegne og motiveres af at skabe noget, der skiller sig ud. Du går op i detaljen, men forstår samtidig betydningen af det store billede.

VI TILBYDER

  • En central lederstilling med selvstændigt ansvar for cocktailbaren

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på barens identitet, cocktailkort og udvikling

  • Stor kreativ frihed til at eksperimentere og udvikle nye cocktailoplevelser

  • Mulighed for at udvikle og forme dit eget barteam

  • Et tæt samarbejde med Restaurantchefen og resten af restaurantens ledelsesteam

  • En dynamisk og ambitiøs arbejdsplads med højt til loftet

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En del af en kvalitetsdrevet koncern med stærke værdier og udviklingsmuligheder

  • Konkurrencedygtig lønpakke

HVORFOR VÆLGE SUKAIBA?

Hos Sukaiba er ambitionerne høje, men fællesskabet er mindst lige så vigtigt. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem engagement, gensidig respekt og en fælles passion for det, vi laver.

Vi ønsker at skabe en cocktailbar, hvor kreativitet, kvalitet og personlighed går hånd i hånd – og hvor både gæster og medarbejdere har lyst til at komme igen.

Vi er en del af Norrlyst Koncernen, hvor der er gode muligheder for sparring, udvikling og karriere på tværs af organisationen.

PRAKTISK

Stillingen er på fuld tid med opstart hurtigst muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Supplier Development Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Supplier Development Engineer with main responsibilities around different commodities – castings, forgings and metal constructions. The preferred location for this position is Vaasa, Finland, but other Wärtsilä locations in Finland and Trieste, Italy are negotiable. We offer the possibility of hybrid remote work.Your role and responsibilitiesAs a Supplier Development Engineer, youll be working as part of an impactful Supplier Development team and Category team with diverse expertise, and your work will consist of: * Managing new product introduction and leading proactive quality assurance activities for the selected commodity (castings, forgings or metal constructions) * Analysing supplier performance and capabilities, identifying development opportunities and driving impactful development actions * Developing and executing supplier development action plans to improve supplier performance * Supporting suppliers with their operational development initiatives in relation to quality, delivery and cost * Executing supplier audits and audit follow-up according to the supplier development action plan and verifying the impactRequirements for the position: * Strong technical expertise in castings, forgings or metal constructions, with a solid understanding of the relevant manufacturing processes, technologies, and key factors affecting product quality and manufacturability * Good understanding of quality management principles, processes, and tools * Excellent communication skills * Strong personal drive for identifying development potential and proven skills in leading improvement projects or initiatives successfully within cross-functional teams * Performance-focused mindset and capability to make an impact on increasing the performance level * A systematic way of working and excellent problem-solving skills * Capability to apply lean principles and statistical process control in daily work to drive improvementTo be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have: * M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Engineering or Economics, or equivalent education * Fluency in English, both verbal and written * Willingness to travel * Experience within the Production Part Approval Process / experience in quality management, for example in manufacturing processes * Previous auditing experience or a lead auditor qualification (e.g., ISO 9001) * Strong experience with Six Sigma (Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent)Why you and us?We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking for a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.Contact & next stepsWe hope to hear from you soon through your application submitted via our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.For further questions, please reach out to Henna Mäkinen, Supplier Development Manager, at henna.makinen@wartsila.com regarding this position (only for questions from direct job applicants; applications by email will not be recorded or responded to).Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!The primary location for this role is Finland, but this role can also be based in Italy where the annual salary range would be 40 000 EUR – 47 743 EUR in accordance with the salary provisions in the applicable National Collective Labor Agreement for workers in the metalworking and plant installation industry (CCNL Metalmeccanico).At Wärtsilä, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. The salary range shared reflects the expected compensation for this role in that location, based on market data and our job architecture. The final salary will be influenced by factors such as the scope and responsibilities of the role, the required competencies, and your relevant education, skills, and experience, and the salary provisions in the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement. We also take internal equity into account to ensure a fair and consistent approach across our organisation.

jobs.title: Nordic Certification Coordinator
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at koordinere certificeringsaktiviteter på tværs af Norden og sikre en professionel og effektiv service til vores kunder?

Control Union Denmark A/S søger en struktureret og serviceminded Nordic Certification Coordinator, som får en central rolle i koordineringen af vores certificeringsaktiviteter. Du bliver en del af en international virksomhed og får en alsidig hverdag med kontakt til kunder, auditorer og kolleger i både Danmark og de øvrige nordiske lande.Som Nordic Certification Coordinator bliver du et vigtigt bindeled mellem kunder, auditorer og vores interne organisation. Du får ansvar for at koordinere certificeringsforløb og sikre, at opgaver, dokumentation og deadlines bliver håndteret korrekt og effektivt.Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Koordinering og planlægning af audits og certificeringsaktiviteter

  • Daglig kontakt med kunder, auditorer og kolleger i Norden

  • Opfølgning på igangværende certificeringsforløb og deadlines

  • Behandling, kontrol og arkivering af dokumentation

  • Vedligeholdelse af kunde- og certificeringsoplysninger i relevante systemer

  • Udarbejdelse og udsendelse af tilbud, aftaler og certifikater

  • Koordinering med internationale kolleger og øvrige Control Union-kontorer

  • Besvarelse af kundehenvendelser og administrativ support

  • Deltagelse i kundebesøg, messer, træning og relevante arrangementer

  • Bidrag til løbende forbedring af interne arbejdsgange og processer

Opgaverne kan udvikle sig i takt med virksomhedens aktiviteter og dine kompetencer.Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med koordinering, administration, kundeservice eller certificering

  • Arbejder struktureret og har et godt overblik

  • Er detaljeorienteret og følger opgaver helt til dørs

  • Kommunikerer professionelt og imødekommende med både kunder og kolleger

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå aktivt i et internationalt team

  • Har gode IT-kundskaber og let ved at sætte dig ind i nye systemer

  • Behersker engelsk på et godt professionelt niveau, både mundtligt og skriftligt

  • Har mulighed for at deltage i kundebesøg, messer, audits og andre aktiviteter, hvor der kan forekomme rejseaktivitet

Erfaring fra certificerings-, audit-, kvalitets- eller fødevareområdet er et krav.Vi tilbyder:

  • En alsidig stilling med stor kontaktflade i en international organisation

  • Mulighed for at arbejde fra vores kontor i Randers samt fra hjemmekontor efter aftale

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • Fleksibilitet i tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdsdagen

  • Pensionsordning med sundhedsforsikring

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Et samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for selvstændigt ansvar

Der kan i perioder forekomme arbejde uden for almindelig arbejdstid i forbindelse med blandt andet rejser, messer, træning og uddannelse.Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til rm@controlunion.dk senest 30.11.2026.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og forbeholder os retten til at afslutte rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Tiltrædelse: Efter aftaleArbejdssted: Randers,og mulighed for hjemmearbejdeAnsættelsesform: Fuldtid, 37 timer om ugen

jobs.title: Technical Writer, Fixed term
jobs.description: **Contract type:** Fixed-term**Location & Travel:** Helsinki (Remote first, Occasional travel to the Helsinki area is required.)**Career Opportunity:** This fixed-term position may lead to a permanent offer in customer support, quality assurance, or project deliveries based on performance, aspirations, and business needs.AILiveSim provides an advanced simulation platform that integrates AI, robotics, and video game technology. Located in Helsinki, we serve a variety of industries, including maritime, defence, aeronautics, and mobile machines. With controlled simulations, we accelerate the development cycles and provide scalable solutions for training, testing, and validating autonomous systems and AI algorithms.To support our growing user base and ensure our platform is as accessible as possible, we are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer. In this role, you will be responsible for translating complex technical concepts into clear and easy-to-understand documentation. This is an opportunity to work closely with cutting-edge AI, robotics, and simulation technology while shaping how our clients and developers interact with our platform.**Key Responsibilities**- **Documentation Creation:** Write, edit, and maintain high-quality product, technical documentation, including user manuals, tutorials, and both customer- and AI-facing documentation resources. - **Knowledge Delivery Processes:** Define and develop various ways to convey information, documentation, example scripts, tutorials and configuration files manually or with AI code assistants. - **Content Organization:** Structure and organize technical content to ensure it is highly searchable, intuitive, and user-friendly for both internal teams and external clients. - **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Work closely with software engineers, product specialists, and the sales team to deeply understand new platform features, updates, and user needs. - **Standardization & Review:** Establish documentation standards and review existing technical materials for clarity, accuracy, and consistency across all company channels. - **User-Centric & Adaptive Approach:** Gather feedback from users and internal teams to continuously improve the usability and comprehensiveness of our documentation, evolving content based on user profiles and technical requirements. **Requirements**- **Technical Writing Experience:** Track record in writing software or technical documentation. - **Communication Skills:** Excellent written and spoken English skills, with a talent for breaking down complex, highly technical concepts into simple, readable language. - **Technical Abilities:** Comfort and enthusiasm for learning complex software systems, with the ability to quickly grasp concepts related to 3D simulation tools, robotics, and AI. **Valuable Assets**- Experience reading or working with programming languages (such as C++ or Python) and documenting APIs. - Interest or background in AI, robotics, 3D graphics, game technologies (e.g., Unreal Engine), or autonomous systems. - Experience creating visual aids, diagrams to supplement written documentation. - Experience creating AI readable documentation, such as instruction files, schemas, Model Context Protocols **How to Apply** To apply, please send your CV, cover letter, and a link to your portfolio or writing samples with "Technical Writer" in the subject line to Jobs@ailivesim.com.Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position will be filled as soon as a qualified candidate is identified.
