jobs.title: Deal Desk
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Linear is in a unique position—we are profitable, which gives us the flexibility to invest thoughtfully as we grow. We want to build a company that scales well—not just in our product, but in how we run our GTM programs. In this role, you’ll design and evolve the systems and process that power our deal desk process. This person will help build the mechanics behind our sales-led deals: quotes, order forms, pricing, discount approvals, and contract terms. A strong candidate has run quote-to-cash at a SaaS company and can spot where the process is slow, manual, or leaky.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America (west coast). We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Own the quote-to-order-form workflow: accurate quotes, correct terms, and a clean path from verbal yes to signed and billed

 - Build and run the deal approval and discount matrix, so Account Executives know what they can self-serve and what needs sign-off

 - Be the single point of contact for deal structuring questions that today land on Account Executives mid-deal

 - Partner with Finance and Legal to keep the order-to-cash process clean, controlled, and free of revenue leakage

 - Support usage-based and consumption deals as AI billing rolls out, from how they are quoted through the hand-off to billing

 - Find and remove manual work: automate what can be automated, document what needs to be documented

 - Help us get and stay audit ready by making sure deals are recorded correctly

What we're looking for

 - 3-5 years in deal desk, order management, revenue operations, or quote-to-cash, ideally at a high-growth SaaS company

 - Strong command of the full quote-to-cash cycle, from pricing and approvals through order form and billing hand-off

 - Comfortable building process from scratch: workflows, approval logic, controls, and documentation, without a playbook handed to you

 - Sound judgment on the tradeoff between deal speed and control, and on sensitive pricing and deal information

 - A clear communicator who can hold a deal conversation with an Account Executive, Finance, and a customer, and have each one walk away with what they need

 - Proficiency with CRM and quoting tools; experience with usage-based billing, multi-currency, or CPQ is a strong plus

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Compensation

For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $172,000—$220,000. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Product Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Product Infrastructure team works on creating abstractions and data models that solve enduring problems across the stack. We solve problems that span multiple product surfaces and typically stretch across both front-end and backend and unblock new product avenues that were previously challenging to create.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Shape and build the core frameworks that enable reading and writing data in Notion, integrating feedback from internal customers along the way, using whatever tools are required for the job, such as AWS, Postgres, NodeJS, TypeScript, React on the frontend.

 - Design new systems and abstractions that improve developer productivity, reliability, and performance by handling entire classes of problems up-front for product engineers.

 - Solve hard technical challenges such as designing abstractions for efficient traversal of the user content graph, building a system to sync user content for offline use, or scaling our permission model to serve large customers with complex content.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Thoughtful problem-solving: For you, problem-solving starts with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You can decompose tricky problems and work towards a clean solution.

 - Pragmatic and business-oriented: You care about business impact and prioritize projects accordingly. You're not just going after cool stuff—you understand the balance between craft, speed, and the bottom line.

 - Strive for simplicity: You think critically about the implications of what you're building, and aim for the most simple and well-crafted design. You understand the consequence of complexity, and are motivated to eliminate them.

 - Not ideological about technology: To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go.

 - Empathetic communication: You communicate nuanced ideas clearly, whether you're explaining technical decisions in writing or brainstorming in real time. In disagreements, you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and compromise when needed.

 - Team player: For you, work isn't a solo endeavor. You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to accomplish shared goals, and you care about learning, growing, and helping others to do the same.





NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have leveraged the features of typed languages (e.g. TypeScript, Flow) to drive code migrations, or have implemented your own data modeling paradigms (e.g. writing your own ORM, sync engine, or query language).

 - You have seen how fundamental abstractions scale within a large codebase, and are curious about how different organizations solve similar problems (e.g. TAO by Meta, Zanzibar by Google).

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.

 - You have interests outside of technology, such as in art, history, or social sciences.

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. 

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in Spanish. 

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to commercial accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

Replit is the fastest way to turn ideas into software. With our powerful AI-powered Agent and Assistant, anyone can create and launch apps from natural language in just one click. Build and deploy full-stack applications directly from your browser—no setup required. Never written a line of code in your life? No problem. Replit makes software creation accessible, collaborative, and lightning-fast. Join us in our mission to empower the next generation of builders.

We are seeking a Strategic Finance professional to join Replit's growing team in Foster City, CA. In this critical role, you'll work in a lean team supporting high-impact strategic and operational initiatives across the business to drive data-driven decision making. You’ll partner directly with executive leadership and the Board to align financial strategies with our ambitious growth objectives. This role reports to the Head of Finance.




ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

You'll contribute to critical projects across three main core areas:

Internal Strategic & Operational Initiatives

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to build financial models and analyses that drive organizational decision-making

 - New product launches: Build and present financial models, business cases, and investment analyses for new product launches

 - GTM Finance: Partner with go-to-market leadership to drive growth through sales capacity planning, funnel and pipeline analytics, pricing strategy and resource allocation

 - Pricing & Packaging: Analyze pricing and packaging strategies using quantitative and qualitative frameworks to recommend optimal approaches

 - Unit Economics: Recommend strategies that balance growth investments with operational efficiency to achieve long-term margin targets

 - International Growth: Analyze global expansion opportunities including localization, regional pricing strategies, go-to-market approaches, and commercial partnerships

 - Enterprise Sales: Partner with sales leadership to scale enterprise sales operations and strategy

Corporate Strategy & Planning

 - Long-Range Planning: Collaborate with FP&A team on forecasting, financial planning, long-range planning, growth headcount planning, and overall financial strategy

 - Board Reporting: Assist in preparing quarterly board materials and presentations

 - Market Insights: Conduct competitive analysis and industry research to inform strategic planning

Corporate Development & Investor Relations

 - Corporate Development: Support corporate development initiatives including M&A, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships from initial sourcing through execution and integration

 - Investor Relations & Fundraising: Support investor relations activities including fundraising, investor communications, and preparation of materials for investors



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3-6 years in investment banking, private equity, consulting, business operations, and/or strategic finance

 - Experience with SQL, Python, or other data analysis tools

 - An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

 - Self-directed with a strong work ethic and ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines

 - Expert-level financial modeling skills and proficiency with business intelligence tools

 - Strong presence and communication skills

 - Exceptional business judgment with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable strategic insights

Join Replit and help shape the financial future of a platform that's revolutionizing how people learn, build, and deploy software with AI.




BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience in strategic finance or related field at a scaling technology company

 - Current Replit user

 - Background in AI or enterprise technology companies

 - Understanding of compute and infrastructure costs in tech environments


This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in French.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets

ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

 


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.

 


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - 1-3 years of Experience in selling technical products to technical buyers

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Native or bilingual-level Korean fluency and business-level English proficiency

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to commercial accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.



This role will be based in Munich, Germany. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

jobs.title: Head of Security
jobs.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

jobs.title: Notino Experience Program Manager - EMEA & APAC, Early Career
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This early-career Notino Experience Program Manager role is for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and turns it into momentum. You’ll wear many hats across the People team, but your core job is to jump in, chart the path, and drive high-impact projects based on business priorities—bringing clarity, aligning cross-functional partners, and executing quickly so the team can deliver meaningful employee experiences across EMEA and APAC.

You’ll succeed here if you’re deeply curious, eager to grow, and excited to hone your craft in People. This is a launchpad opportunity to learn from strong leaders, build expertise across the full spectrum of People work, and help shape moments that matter—bringing energy, optimism, and genuine care for people while helping build a workplace where everyone can do the best work of their careers.

As the regional anchor for how Notion’s global people & environment programs come to life outside the U.S., you’ll sit at the intersection of global vision and local execution. Based in Dublin and reporting to the Notino Experience & Environment Lead for APAC & EMEA, you’ll partner closely with the Global Experience Programs team in AMER and environment teams across Dublin, Sydney, Tokyo, Seoul, and Hyderabad—translating global programs into locally relevant, high-quality experiences and building the operational infrastructure to deliver them consistently at scale.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own regional program operations. Take end-to-end ownership of key people programs across EMEA and APAC — from onboarding and performance cycles to engagement surveys and talent retention initiatives. You'll research, plan, launch, and iterate.

 - Bridge global and local. Act as the connective layer between the Global Experience Programs team and on-the-ground environment teams. You'll translate global frameworks into locally relevant experiences.

 - Build the infrastructure. Create processes, playbooks, and agents that make local execution easier and more consistent across markets. Think onboarding workflows, program calendars, and repeatable delivery frameworks.

 - Elevate Affinity Groups. Partner with Affinity Group leads across the region to strengthen their programmes, provide operational support, and help surface retention and engagement insights from within those communities.

 - Use data to drive decisions. Build and maintain dashboards that track program health, adoption, and outcomes. Use what you learn to run experiments, course-correct quickly, and demonstrate ROI.

 - Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with People Partners, NoE , Recruitment and business leaders to align people programs with organisational goals and ensure an inclusive, well-supported employee experience.

 - Champion the Notion Experience. Help craft and bring to life a more distinct Notino Experience brand across EMEA and APAC — reimagining how we work, how we connect, and what it feels like to be a Notino in your region.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Programatic: experience running people programs end-to-end, across multiple markets & time zones.

 - AI-native mindset: you’re “AI‑pilled” in the best way: you proactively use AI tools to speed up research, ops, and communication, and you’re excited to build AI agents/playbooks.

 - Project management: strong skills and the ability to hold many moving pieces.

 - Stakeholder trust: you build trust naturally across levels, from team members to executive partners.

 - Bias toward action: you’re resourceful, scrappy when needed, and energised by a fast-moving environment.

 - Change management: experience driving change at a high-growth company — you know how to bring people along, not just roll things out.

 - Executive presence: you’re comfortable presenting to and partnering with senior leaders.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with or enthusiasm for Notion

 - Experience working across APAC and EMEA markets, with an understanding of cultural nuance in employee experience.
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €45,000 - €70,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
INNERGY is transforming the woodworking industry with purpose built, cloud based ERP software designed exclusively for custom manufacturers. Our platform helps businesses operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently while seamlessly connecting design, production, and delivery for teams creating architectural millwork, cabinetry, and casework.

What truly sets INNERGY apart is our people. Founded in 2016, we are a globally distributed team of 200 plus professionals united by deep software expertise and a shared passion for solving meaningful, real world problems. We value collaboration, creativity, and ownership, and we are intentional about building not only powerful products, but also a culture where people feel supported, heard, and inspired to do their best work.

With strong momentum and the recent acquisition of Microvellum, a trusted leader in design to manufacturing solutions for the woodworking industry, INNERGY is entering an exciting new phase of growth. This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

We're looking for a versatile, hands-on Marketing Specialist who thrives as a generalist and can move fluidly between product marketing content, web production, and performance channels. You'll be the kind of marketer who can write a compelling product page in the morning, build and publish it in WordPress over lunch, and optimize a paid search and social campaign by the afternoon. You're equally comfortable thinking about messaging and positioning as you are reading a CPL report.

This is a high-impact role for someone who wants ownership across the funnel and the chance to directly influence pipeline at a fast-growing vertical SaaS company. If you like wearing multiple hats, learning a niche industry deeply, and seeing your work drive measurable results, you'll fit right in.

Duties & Responsibilities include:

Product & content marketing

  • Translate product features and capabilities into clear, benefit-driven messaging that resonates with millwork and cabinetry business owners.
  • Write and produce marketing content across formats â landing pages, web copy, emails, case studies, one-pagers, ad copy, and campaign assets.
  • Partner with product and sales to keep positioning sharp and messaging consistent across the buyer journey.

Web production (WordPress)

  • Build, edit, and publish web pages in WordPress â from landing pages to product and resource pages â with an eye for layout, conversion, and on-page experience.
  • Maintain and improve the website over time: updating content, fixing issues, A/B testing, and ensuring pages stay fast, on-brand, and conversion-ready.

Paid social & paid search

  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across search (Google Ads) and social (LinkedIn, Meta, and others as relevant).
  • Own day-to-day campaign management: audiences, creative, budgets, bidding, and ongoing testing to improve cost-per-lead and ROAS.
  • Report on performance and translate results into clear next steps.

Demand generation

  • Support full-funnel demand gen programs that drive leads and pipeline â across email, webinars, events, content syndication, and nurture.
  • Help build and execute integrated campaigns from concept through measurement.
  • Track and report on funnel metrics, contributing to a continuous test-and-learn culture.

Knowledge and Preferred Qualifications:

  • Attention to detail sets you apart. Youâll be working across multiple projects at once, and get to be responsible for delivering them with a high standard of quality
  • Youâre organized, efficient and deadline driven
  • Experience marketing to manufacturers, the construction/building products space, or other niche/vertical industries.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce).
  • Comfort with analytics tools (GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio) and ad platforms' native reporting.
  • Basic design or creative production skills (Canva, Figma, Adobe Creative Suite).
  • Experience with webinars, events, or field marketing.

Qualifications

  • Ability to travel for maximum of one week at a time. Both domestic and international travel may be required. A valid US passport will be required, if not already in place. Weekend travel may be required during conventions and shows.
  • Your position is not expected to require a significant amount of travel, but we expect that you might be on the road up to 20% of your time.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to work / look at a monitor for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to lift 45lbs or less.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Accessibility & Work Environment

INNERGY is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace. We support reasonable adjustments for individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your role, please let us know.

This role is primarily computer-based and may involve extended periods of screen time and frequent communication through digital tools. Work may be performed remotely or in an office setting, depending on the role and location. We prioritize employee wellbeing, flexibility, and a safe, supportive work environment across all regions.

Equal Opportunity Employer

INNERGY is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity at every level of the organization. We are committed to creating a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Location Eligibility Notice

This is a U.S.-based remote role. Due to current regulatory requirements, we are only able to consider candidates residing in certain U.S. states.

Eligible states include, but are not limited to: Texas, Florida, Missouri, Arizona, Indiana, North Carolina, and Wisconsin.

At this time, candidates located in California, Colorado, New York, Illinois, Washington, or other states with active pay transparency requirements are not eligible for consideration.

jobs.title: Clinical Coordination Manager
jobs.description:
Department: Support Operations

Reports To: Director, Support Operations

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and ongoing training refreshers
  • Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
  • Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
  • Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

  • Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early
  • Ensure accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked in accordance with provider availability, market zoning, and scheduling priorities
  • Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
  • Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets
  • Ensure schedules are entered timely and accurately while production-based scheduling remains focused appropriately

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze recurring scheduling barriers, backlog trends, fall-aparts, and schedule-health concerns to identify operational gaps and root causes
  • Develop preventive strategies and implement workflow or SOP improvements within Clinical Coordination
  • Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
  • Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex scheduling needs or facility and provider concerns
  • Independently address department concerns, communicate risks and updates, and escalate to the Director when additional leadership support is needed

Data, Reporting & Accountability

  • Monitor and report team performance and operational health indicators, including:
  • Clinical Days at Goal
  • 0-14-day schedule health and upcoming provider weeks
  • Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
  • Schedule-entry timeliness
  • Reschedule, cancellation, and fall-apart trends
  • Outstanding scheduling barriers and escalations
  • Provide weekly insights, actions taken, next steps, and performance updates to leadership
  • Ensure accurate documentation standards in CareStack and Healier

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
  • Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
  • Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements.
  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
    • Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
    • Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
    • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment
Key Competencies

  • Leadership & team development
  • Delegation, accountability & follow-through
  • Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
  • Schedule-health oversight & workload management
  • Workflow optimization & accuracy
  • Efficient decision-making & prioritization
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Service-minded communication with professionalism and empathy

Work Environment

  • Fully remote role requiring reliable internet access
  • Requires ongoing communication with team members, facilities, providers, and internal departments via virtual platforms
  • Occasional travel for leadership meetings, in-field shadow sessions, or training as needed

Benefits

Compensation: Base compensation $60,000-65,000 annually

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Paid Time Off

jobs.title: Data Analyst Assistant
jobs.description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

jobs.title: Mobile Product Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Quality is our competitive advantage. Every member of our fully remote team is a maker at heart, caring deeply about the quality and feel of our work. While the industry optimizes for speed and metrics alone, we believe that craft and quality have lasting value. Quality creates gravity — it pulls people toward our team and product rather than requiring us to push. This philosophy drives everything we do, from product decisions to hiring choices.

For this role, we expect robust design skills, sharp product thinking, and the ability to engage in technical discussions. We work in small, autonomous project teams, where engineers are paired tightly with designers to explore ideas, build prototypes, deploy internal builds, and ultimately ship to customers. You will be a key element of projects from beginning to end.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Own the experience of our iOS and Android mobile apps, including guiding the adaptation of desktop features to mobile

 - Pair closely with mobile engineers and product leads to initiate and complete mobile-specific projects, no hand-offs

 - Take opportunities to redesign or refine key screens and flows, as well as smaller quality issues and “paper cuts” as you use Linear

 - Create mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to communicate ideas and describe their execution

 - Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique of work-in-progress across both mobile and desktop platforms

 - Use and improve our lightweight design system components

 - Help with hiring new teammates that can elevate our team and product

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years experience designing software, with mobile-specific emphasis

 - Courage to ask questions, experiment, and advocate for what you feel is right

 - Humility to accept feedback, adapt your thinking, and iterate toward the best solution

 - Experience with prototyping directly in code, or with tools like Figma, Origami, etc

 - Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

 - Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Compensation

For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $220,000—$268,250. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.

Learn how we think and work

 - Part I https://linear.app/blog/a-design-reset and Part II https://linear.app/blog/how-we-redesigned-the-linear-ui of how we redesigned the Linear UI

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - Read me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we use AI in design https://designerfund.substack.com/p/ai-design-linear feature of Linear's design team

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen

 - Our recent tender offer: Sharing Linear’s growth with the people building it https://linear.app/now/sharing-growth-with-the-people-building-linear

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is looking for a Head of Demand Engine to build the engine that turns our best product stories, customer proof, and market opportunities into scaled pipeline. You’ll lead demand programs across campaigns, digital, paid strategy, webinars, email, web, and emerging channels. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing on audience and offer strategy, with Performance Marketing on paid execution, and with Field Marketing & Events on the moments that benefit from in-person activation.




This is a senior leadership role with both AMER and global scope. You’ll help set the global standard for how Notion plans, runs, tests, and measures demand programs, while learning from strong regional teams and making the best ideas repeatable across markets. You’ll lead a growing team spanning demand programs and digital demand, with room to expand into areas like partner marketing over time.




This is a build job as much as a run job. We’re looking for someone with real taste who can spot a strong idea, turn it into a sharp program, and build a repeatable engine around what works. You should care about quality and craft, but also love testing, data, systems, and execution. The opportunity is to modernize demand generation at one of the companies defining how teams work with AI.




This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the demand programs strategy, calendar, and operating rhythm across priority audiences, segments, and offers.

 - Turn strong product stories, content, customer proof, and market opportunities into integrated programs that can scale across channels and regions.

 - Build a high-velocity testing practice. Set a high bar for creative and execution, learn quickly, and put more weight behind what works.

 - Serve as the global point person for paid digital demand strategy. Define the audiences, offers, creative, programs, and goals, then partner closely with Performance Marketing on execution and optimization.

 - Lead digital demand across webinars, email, web, review sites, nurture, and new formats, creating new programs where the strategy calls for them.

 - Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps to build a trusted global approach to marketing ROI, attribution, forecasting, MQA/MQL methodology, and campaign reporting.

 - Work closely with Enterprise Product Marketing on audience, offer, and campaign strategy, and with Field Marketing & Events on coordinated execution.

 - Help build our muscle in account-based marketing and partner marketing as those motions develop.

 - Be a trusted partner to Sales and executive leadership. Bring a clear point of view, make the numbers legible, and advocate for what will have the most impact.

 - Hire, coach, and lead a strong team across demand programs and digital demand.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - A track record of building and scaling B2B demand programs that create qualified pipeline.

 - Strong judgment and taste. You can point to specific programs that worked because the audience, offer, creative, and execution were sharp.

 - Deep digital demand experience across paid strategy, email, web, webinars, nurture, and integrated campaigns.

 - A testing mindset and the operating discipline to turn learnings into repeatable programs, systems, and investment decisions.

 - Comfort with data. You can work closely with Marketing Ops and RevOps on attribution, reporting, forecasting, and ROI, and translate the numbers into clear action.

 - Executive presence. You earn trust with Sales and company leaders, hold a strong point of view, and are comfortable making hard calls.

 - Experience leading and developing strong teams in a fast-moving environment.

 - Experience operating across regions, or genuine curiosity and appetite to build globally.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. This model is still being written, and you’ll help write it.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building account-based marketing programs.

 - Experience with partner or ecosystem marketing.

 - Experience working across both product-led and sales-assisted growth motions.




WHY THIS ROLE

This is one of the most visible, highest-impact seats in Notion’s marketing org. You’ll have the mandate to build the demand engine, shape how we measure marketing ROI globally, and work directly with Sales, RevOps, company leaders, and regional marketing teams.



The playbook for B2B demand generation is changing. Buyers expect better content and experiences, AI is reshaping how programs get built, and old attribution models are under pressure. If you want to apply what already works, challenge what doesn’t, and help define a more modern model, this is the job.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $245,000 – $275,000 per year.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.



This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.



You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.



The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

 - Written and spoken Japanese fluency to communicate directly with external customers, partners, and internal teams




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.

 - Business level English proficiency to communicate effectively with global stakeholders and peers.

 - Experience working with Japanese enterprise customers or familiarity with Japan market dynamics and business practices.

You'll be the architect of Notion's UK partner motion — standing up programs, forging relationships, and converting partner activity into measurable pipeline. You'll operate across multiple partner types simultaneously and serve as the connective tissue between our ecosystem and our sales team.

The ideal candidate brings a hunter's instinct to partnerships: proactive, commercially sharp, and energised by the challenge of building something meaningful in a market with real momentum. You'll work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and regional leadership — and you'll be a visible face of Notion in the UK partner community.

 - Own and grow Notion's UK partner ecosystem across value-added resellers, cloud/hyperscaler partnerships, and local services partners

 - Develop and maintain strong executive relationships with partner leadership across the region, becoming a trusted extension of their go-to-market teams

 - Track and report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline; present program performance to internal stakeholders and EMEA regional leadership

 - Support services delivery by local partners on an ad-hoc basis, helping maintain quality and partner satisfaction

 - Identify and qualify inbound partnership opportunities, and proactively surface new partner relationships that can expand Notion's reach in the UK

 - Collaborate with Notion's global and EMEA partner teams to adapt programs to the local market and share learnings across regions
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - 10+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, or alliances in the enterprise SaaS or cloud software industry

 - Demonstrated experience managing both VAR/reseller programs and at least one cloud or hyperscaler partnership — comfort across both partner types is essential

 - A builder's track record: you've stood up partner programs and can point to outcomes you drove

 - Strong demand generation orientation

 - Commercially sharp with the ability to connect partner activity to revenue outcomes

 - Highly collaborative and effective working alongside direct sales teams — you understand what reps need, and you make their lives easier

 - Executive presence and strong relationship-building skills; you're as comfortable presenting to a partner CRO as you are coordinating logistics with a partner marketing manager

 - Experience working in or alongside hyper-growth or startup environments — you're comfortable with ambiguity and moving fast without a complete playbook

 - Based in London with existing knowledge of the UK technology market; willingness to travel across EMEA and occasionally across EMEA

 - Strong organisational and operational discipline — you manage multiple active partner relationships without dropping balls, and you communicate proactively
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with cloud marketplace programs and hyperscaler co-sell motions

 - Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) or bottoms-up SaaS go-to-market models

 - Existing relationships with UK-based VARs, systems integrators, or hyperscaler partner teams

 - Cross-market EMEA experience — e.g. managing partnerships across EMEA regions simultaneously
